7d94d438.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
7d94d438.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians have flexibility in where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, as part of being a distributed-first company.
  
  
Atlassian is seeking an exceptional Solutions Engineer who is passionate about addressing complex customer challenges and securing significant enterprise deals. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the enterprise sales team and regional channel partners to gain a deep understanding of our customers' needs. You will strategize on navigating various scenarios, deliver compelling demonstrations, and ultimately drive business closure. Your expertise will be crucial in ensuring that our solutions effectively meet the demands of our clients, contributing to their success and the growth of Atlassian.
  
  
**Your future team**
With over 300,000 customers worldwide, Atlassian is helping organisations like NASA, IBM, Hubspot, Samsung and Coca-Cola advance humanity through the power of incredible software that unleashes the potential of every team.
  
  
With a focus on value selling, we help our customers understand how our products combine to create enterprise solutions that transform their business’s outcomes. We’re different from other organisations because we approach everything we do using our value of ‘play as a team'. We support each other, celebrate our wins together and share knowledge. Our employees work with Atlassian, not for Atlassian.
  
  
Our team enjoys high earnings potential with the enterprise white space opportunity ahead of us, selling impactful products that are at the forefront of cloud and artificial intelligence utilization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Technical Engagement: Partner with sales to engage in customer discovery, identifying business challenges and desired outcomes while mapping them to Atlassian’s value propositions and solutions.
* Opportunity Identification: Identify opportunities for cross-product and solution expansion to maximize customer value.
* Technical Problem Solving: Investigate and understand client pain points to craft meaningful solutions.
* Product Expertise: Act as a product expert, clearly articulating and demonstrating how Atlassian’s software drives collaboration and productivity.
* Value-Driven Demonstrations: Deliver engaging demonstrations showcasing how Atlassian’s solutions empower teams and drive outcomes.
* Technical Sales Leadership: Guide customers on best practices and implementation strategies to achieve success with Atlassian software.
* Sales Collaboration: Build strong partnerships with sales counterparts to improve engagement and optimize the sales cycle.
* Customer Advocacy: Gather customer feedback and competitive insights, sharing them with product teams to influence improvements.

**Qualifications**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
* 10+ years of experience in Presales, Solution Engineering, or working in customer facing roles for technology vendors or technology driven organizations.
* Deep knowledge of Atlassian’s product suite and ability to articulate its value in solving complex business challenges.
* Proven experience delivering impactful product/solution demonstrations and leading technical evaluations.
* Ability to identify solution expansion opportunities and align with customer goals.
* Highly organized, able to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence technical and business stakeholders, with the ability to present to and persuade varied audiences.
* Collaborative mindset with a passion for solving problems and empowering customers, along with a “roll-up-your-sleeves” approach focused on execution and continuous improvement.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

40c5c3d9.title: Presales Consultant
40c5c3d9.location: Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban, Navi Mumbai, India
40c5c3d9.description:
**About Fynd**

**Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of Indias largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.**

  

**Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.**

**Role Overview**

**Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.**

  

**Responsibilities**

**You own a Fynd TMS customer end to end - from the first solution discussion in the sales cycle, through design and go-live, and then as the person accountable for that account running well and growing.**

**Fynd TMS sells into enterprise retail, distribution and 3PL operations where no two logistics networks look alike. Deals are won on whether we can credibly map a customer's dispatch reality - hubs, zones, rate cards, fleet mix, SLAs, COD, returns - onto the product, and then actually deliver it.**

**Join sales conversations as the product and logistics authority: run discovery on the customer's current dispatch flow, systems landscape and pain points.**

**Build and deliver tailored demos and pilots - not the generic deck, but the customer's own network configured in the product.**

**Own the solution narrative in RFPs, RFIs and proposals; write the solution and scope sections of the SOW.**

**Do gap analysis between customer requirements and current product capability. Decide what is configuration, what is customization, and what is a genuine "no" - and say so early.**

**Size effort and feasibility with engineering before commitments are made, so we don't sell what we can't ship.**

**Run implementation as a project: plan, milestones, RACI, weekly governance with the client.**

**Configure and validate masters - hubs, zones, service areas, rate cards, SLA/TAT rules, vehicle and rider profiles, route optimization parameters.**

**Coordinate integrations with the client's OMS/ERP/WMS and any carrier or 3PL partners; test APIs and webhooks yourself before handing them to the client.**

**Drive data migration, UAT, pilot rollout at a single hub or store cluster, and on-ground training for supervisors, dispatchers and riders.**

**Run hypercare through go-live and stabilization; sit in the control room on day one if that's what it takes.**

**Own adoption and health: are trips actually being planned in the system, is the rider app being used, is EPOD capture clean, are dashboards being looked at.**

**Run monthly and quarterly reviews with the client, tied to their metrics - cost per delivery, vehicle utilization, on-time performance, planning time saved.**

**Be the escalation path for issues; coordinate resolution with support and engineering and close the loop with the client.**

**Spot and drive expansion: new hubs, new geographies, additional modules, additional business units. Own renewal readiness.**

**Feed structured, prioritized product feedback back into the roadmap.**

**Someone who wants a pure sales quota role with no delivery accountability.**

**Someone who wants a pure project management role with no client-facing commercial exposure.**

**Someone who needs a fully documented product and a settled process to work inside.**

**Qualifications**

**Required**

**4–8 years in presales, solution consulting, implementation, or customer success - in logistics technology, supply chain SaaS, or enterprise B2B SaaS sold to operations teams.**

**Working knowledge of at least one of: transportation management, last-mile/mid-mile delivery, dispatch planning, route optimization, fleet operations, or 3PL/carrier operations.**

**Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise implementation from kickoff to go-live - you can walk us through one in detail, including what went wrong.**

**Technical fluency without being an engineer: comfortable with APIs and Postman, reading JSON, basic SQL, Excel modelling. You can debug a bad integration payload well enough to know whose problem it is.**

**Strong verbal and written communication. Requirement docs, review decks and client emails are a large part of this job.**

**Willing to be on the ground - warehouses, hubs, and client offices, not only on calls.**

**Preferred**

**Experience with TMS, WMS, OMS or route-optimization products (Shipsy, LogiNext, FarEye, Locus, Bringg, Blue Yonder, Oracle OTM, or in-house platforms at Delhivery, Ecom Express, Shadowfax, Porter, Zypp and similar).**

**Exposure to retail, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or enterprise logistics buyers.**

**Comfort with route-optimization concepts - constraints, capacity, time windows, solver behaviour.**

**What do we offer?**

**Growth**

**At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we're seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.**

  

**We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.**

  

**Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we'll reimburse the costs to support your development.**

**Culture**

**We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.**

**- Regular community engagement and team-building activities**

**- Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture**

**Wellness**

**Your well-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents.**

**Work Environment**

**We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.**

**Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!**

1fa8c4f8.title: Solution Consultant
1fa8c4f8.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic and client-focused **Solution Consultant** to join our growing team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in accounting, excellent communication skills, and an interest in software implementation and consulting.

In this role, you will be responsible for understanding client requirements, implementing and configuring Zoho Books, providing functional support, and ensuring successful software adoption.

**Prior experience with Zoho Books is an advantage but not mandatory.** We welcome accounting professionals who are interested in transitioning into software consulting.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze client accounting processes, business workflows, and functional requirements.
* Implement, configure, and customize Zoho Books based on client requirements.
* Assist clients with data migration, system setup, and software implementation.
* Provide functional support and troubleshoot accounting software-related issues.
* Conduct client training sessions and demonstrate software functionalities.
* Support clients during implementation and post-implementation stages.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve technical and functional challenges.
* Identify opportunities to improve client accounting processes through automation and software solutions.
* Maintain strong client relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) is mandatory; MBA is preferred.
* Minimum **2–3 years of professional experience** in accounting, accounting software, or ERP implementation.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial processes, and business operations.
* Experience with Zoho Books or similar accounting software will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a background in accounting who wish to transition into software consulting are encouraged to apply.
* **Freshers are not eligible for this position.**

Required Skills

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial workflows.
* Understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting.
* Basic understanding of accounting software and ERP systems.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into software solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Willingness to learn Zoho Books and other business applications.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and client relationship management skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical clients.
* Client-focused approach with strong customer service skills.
* Quick learning ability and adaptability to new technologies.
* Good organizational, time management, and teamwork skills.

Who Should Apply?

We encourage applications from:

Accountants looking to transition into software consulting.  
Accounting professionals interested in ERP implementation.  
Candidates with experience in accounting software and client support.  
Professionals with strong accounting knowledge, communication skills, and a passion for technology.

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to build a career in software implementation and consulting.
* Exposure to diverse clients and business processes.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho Books and other business applications.
* Professional growth and continuous learning opportunities.

**Interested candidates are invited to apply and become part of our growing consulting team!**

Pay: ₹200,000.00 - ₹350,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

3c554f4d.title: Senior Solution Consultant IT - JD Edwards
3c554f4d.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**What you will do**
--------------------

You’ll join a passionate and high-paced team working at the heart of Volvo Group’s transformation. Together, we are building the digital manufacturing system of the future — where data, automation, and people unite to redefine how sustainable power solutions are made and delivered to the world.  
Our department is on a bold journey — transforming and modernizing our IT landscape to enable Volvo’s vision of becoming a fully agile, data-driven company. With strong investments, cutting-edge technologies, and a shared mindset for continuous improvement, we’re creating the digital foundations that will power tomorrow’s production and distribution systems.

We’re reimagining end-to-end processes, driving transformation, and unlocking the full potential of data to shape smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable operations. Our environment is international, multicultural, and full of opportunities to grow — both personally and professionally.  
Our technology stack is diverse and future-oriented, built on a solid mix of COTS and SaaS solutions that we continuously evolve to meet the demands of the next generation of manufacturing.

**Who are you?**
----------------

* 12+ years of experience in the **end-to-end Finance module (AR,AP,GL,Service Billing,India Localization)** processes is a strong advantage, as is familiarity with **ERP(JD Edward) or COTS systems supporting business-critical operations.**
* You’re more than a Solution Consultant — you’re a connector, visionary, and problem-solver who turns business needs into digital realities. You thrive at the intersection of people, data, and technology, ensuring that every solution we build truly matters.
* As a Requirement Solution Engineer, you act as the vital link between our business and development teams. You capture what the business truly needs — and why — translating it into solutions that bring measurable value.
* Every day, you collaborate with stakeholders, architects, and engineers to create digital capabilities that move us toward Volvo Group’s ambition of becoming a fully agile and data-driven organization.
* You take pride in understanding complex business challenges and transforming them into actionable insights.
* You guide teams through the process — from refining requirements and ensuring architectural alignment to maintaining the highest standards in quality, security, and performance.
* You don’t just deliver solutions; you shape experiences that empower the business to grow and evolve.
* Curiosity drives you. You explore emerging technologies, new methodologies, and best practices to find smarter, more sustainable ways of working. You’re comfortable navigating change and thrive in an environment where collaboration, learning, and innovation go hand in hand.
* To succeed in this role, you bring both technical understanding and business insight — and you know how to connect the two. You have hands-on experience working close to the business, identifying needs, and transforming them into digital solutions that truly create value.
* You are used to translating business challenges into clear, actionable requirements and guiding development teams toward successful outcomes. You understand how to balance strategic thinking with operational excellence — seeing the bigger picture while making sure every detail fits.
* You’ve worked closely with Solution Architects, Developers, and Testers, and you know how to bridge communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You bring a strategic mindset and a collaborative spirit. You know how to listen, connect, and inspire. You take ownership of results, lead with curiosity, and always keep the end user in focus. You communicate clearly, work seamlessly across teams and cultures, and make things happen — from concept to delivery.

**Ready for the next move?**
----------------------------

Did we catch your attention - Join our ride today and help us make a difference for the future of sustainable power solutions.

At Volvo Group, we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and connection. Our general principle is that employees work from the office.

Volvo Group never requests any form of payment or fees from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. Any such demand is a scam. To view the authentic job description and apply securely, please visit: Jobs at Volvo Group

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

**Who we are and what we believe in**

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

**Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO)** is a new division. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience.

Joining the new DTO division means being part of a fast-moving digital product-oriented organization where teams truly own what they build from idea to delivery. In DTO, we work in agile, cross-functional teams, mastering the latest technology, and creating outstanding digital experiences that make a real difference for our colleagues and Volvo Group customers around the world. We put people first and build our culture on trust, passion, customer success, change, and performance. If you want to grow, collaborate across functions and entities, and help shape the future of digital products within Volvo Group, DTO is a great place to be.

In some countries and for specific positions within Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations, background checks may be required, in accordance with local laws & regulations. If this is applicable to the role you have applied for, you will be informed.

72db1953.title: Solutions Architect- AI
72db1953.description:
USEReady is a global analytics and data management solutions company that helps enterprises harness the power of data to drive smarter decisions. With a strong presence across North America, USEReady partners with Fortune 500 companies to deliver end-to-end analytics, BI, data engineering, and AI/ML solutions. Our Bangalore office serves as a key hub for our finance, technology, and delivery operations.

**Experience:**
12+ years

**Focus:**
GenAI and agentic solutions presales

**About the Role**

Own technical solutioning for AI and agentic pursuits. Qualify what is real, kill what is not, and design systems that survive contact with enterprise constraints.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Lead AI discovery workshops — separating use cases with genuine ROI from ones that sound impressive and will not clear procurement.

• Design GenAI and agentic solutions end to end: retrieval architecture, agent orchestration, tool and MCP integration, human-in-the-loop design, and evaluation strategy.

• Define accuracy and performance targets in proposals, and define how they will be measured. Ambiguous success criteria are the single biggest source of fixed-price pain.

• Own the technical response for AI pursuits: architecture, estimates, model and platform selection, and total cost of ownership.

• Build demos and PoCs against client-representative data, including synthetic data approaches where client environments are not available.

• Address enterprise concerns directly — data residency, PII handling, model governance, auditability, and alignment to NIST AI RMF or ISO 42001 where clients require it.

• Advise clients on where agents genuinely outperform deterministic pipelines, and where they do not.

**Required Skills & Experience**

• 12+ years in software, data, or ML, with 3+ years building or architecting production LLM-based systems.

• Practical depth in RAG architectures, agent frameworks, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation methodology — you know why systems fail in production, not just how to demo them.

• Familiarity with the major model providers and the tradeoffs between them on cost, latency, and reasoning quality.

• Grounding in the underlying data layer — able to tell when an AI use case is really a data readiness problem.

• Credible with a skeptical CIO and a security review board, not just an innovation team.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.

**Nice to Have**

• Oil & Gas, manufacturing, or financial services domain experience.

• Exposure to AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act).

• Experience in a consulting or systems-integrator environment.

81f27b55.title: Network Architect
81f27b55.description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Position Summary**

Candescent is seeking an experienced and innovative **Network Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and evolution of our enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for developing scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures that support corporate offices, cloud environments, financial institution operations, and emerging business initiatives.

The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. This position serves as the highest level of technical authority for enterprise networking and provides guidance for complex projects, strategic investments, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Network Architecture**

* Develop and maintain the enterprise network architecture roadmap.
* Design highly available, scalable, and secure LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Cloud and B2B Networking and internet edge solutions.
* Create and maintain high-level and low-level network designs, standards, and reference architectures.
* Evaluate existing environments and recommend improvements aligned with business objectives.
* Establish networking standards and governance for all Candescent locations and hosted environments.

**Cloud & Hybrid Networking**

* Design connectivity solutions for Azure, AWS,GCP (Must Have) and hybrid cloud deployments.
* Define architectures for cloud transit networking, DNS, routing, security segmentation, and application delivery.
* Lead cloud networking initiatives on secure multi-cloud connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud engineering teams on network automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives.

**Security Architecture & Compliance**

* Partner with Information Security teams to design secure network solutions.
* Develop architectures supporting Zero Trust, network segmentation, NAC, SASE, ZTNA, and secure remote access.
* Ensure designs meet regulatory and compliance requirements including FFIEC, PCI-DSS, SOX, and corporate security standards.
* Provide technical leadership during security assessments, audits, and risk reviews.

**Strategic Leadership**

* Provide architectural oversight for major infrastructure projects.
* Lead technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and vendor assessments.
* Develop multi-year network technology roadmaps and lifecycle management strategies.
* Influence infrastructure direction through innovation and industry best practices.
* Present architectural recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence**

* Act as the highest escalation point for complex networking issues.
* Review network performance, capacity, resiliency, and availability metrics.
* Guide disaster recovery and business continuity planning efforts.
* Ensure infrastructure designs align with operational supportability requirements.

**Automation & Modernization**

* Promote network automation and orchestration strategies.
* Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement automated provisioning and configuration management.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor Network Engineers and Senior Engineers on architecture and design principles.
* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.
* Foster technical excellence across Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Build strong partnerships with business units, application owners, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise networking experience.
* 5+ years designing large-scale, mission-critical network environments.
* Expert level experience with:
  + GCP Networking
  + Cloud and B2B Networking
  + Palo Alto Networks firewalls
  + Meraki Wireless networking technologies
  + SD-WAN solutions
* Strong experience designing:
  + Fortigate Network firewalls
  + Corporate office networks
  + Hybrid cloud connectivity
  + Individual Financial Institution Networks
* Experience with network security architecture and segmentation strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale infrastructure transformation projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial services or regulated industry experience.
* Experience with:
  + Cisco Wireless / Meraki
  + Palo Alto Networks & SCM
  + Azure networking
  + AWS networking
  + GCP networking (Must Have)
  + Prisma Access
  + Network automation platforms
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code frameworks.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
* Strong written documentation and presentation skills.

**Certifications (Nice To Have)**

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Architect (PCNSA/PCNSE)
* Professional Cloud Network Engineer (PCNE)
* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

**Success Metrics**

The successful Network Architect will:

* Establish enterprise architecture standards and governance.
* Improve network reliability, resiliency, and security posture.
* Reduce operational complexity through standardization and automation.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Support business growth through scalable network design.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for network strategy across Candescent.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

**About the Role**

  

We are looking for a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer with 3-5 years of experience in designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Azure services, cloud security, networking, monitoring, automation, and troubleshooting. The candidate will work closely with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to ensure secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Design, deploy, configure, and manage Azure cloud infrastructure, including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Azure App Services, and related services.
* Manage Azure networking components such as VNets, subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, and DNS.
* Implement and maintain cloud security best practices, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and access policies.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, availability, and resource utilization using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and routine operational tasks using Azure CLI, PowerShell, Azure Automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM/Bicep templates.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with DevOps teams using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Manage backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability configurations using appropriate Azure services.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize service disruptions.
* Optimize Azure resource utilization and cloud expenditure by implementing cost-monitoring, resource-tagging, and cost-optimization practices.
* Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with development, security, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to support application deployments, cloud migrations, and environment management.
* Follow organizational policies and industry best practices for cloud governance, compliance, security, and operational management.

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3-6 years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure.
* Good understanding of core Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Azure App Services, and Azure Monitor.
* Practical experience with Azure networking, identity and access management, security configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep).
* Understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.
* Knowledge of cloud security principles, cost management, and resource governance.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Experience with cloud migration projects and hybrid cloud environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices, incident management, and change management processes.

**Project Role :**
Cloud Migration Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next-generation business outcomes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Infrastructure As Code (IaC)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
Equivalent education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current infrastructure and solutions to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes planning and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and high-performing. The position requires coordinating with various stakeholders to align migration strategies with business goals, while continuously monitoring progress and addressing any challenges that arise during the migration process. The engineer plays a key role in enabling organizations to leverage both private and public cloud technologies to achieve advanced business outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of cloud migration strategies to ensure seamless transition.
* Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to optimize migration efforts.
* Monitor migration progress and proactively identify risks or issues, proposing effective mitigation plans.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* Experience with cloud platforms and automation tools related to Infrastructure As Code.
* Strong knowledge of cloud architecture principles and best practices for migration.
* Ability to design scalable and secure cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure As Code methodologies.
* Familiarity with scripting and configuration management to automate deployment processes.
* Understanding of network, storage, and security considerations in cloud environments.

**Additional Information**

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* Equivalent education is required.

f0c85a16.company: India's Future Investors - Money Entertainment Reality Show
f0c85a16.description:
**Company Description**
India’s Future Investors (IFI) is India’s Money Entertainment Reality Show that combines money intelligence, human behavior, competition, and entertainment. Through immersive challenges and real-world financial scenarios, IFI explores how people think, prioritize, and decide under time constraints and pressure. The show focuses on how MONEY, TIME, and PRESSURE reveal CHARACTER, aiming to find India’s “Money Rockstar.” IFI invites people not only to watch but to participate, compete, and follow the journey as the search for India’s Money Rockstar unfolds. The platform offers a dynamic environment for professionals who want to contribute to an innovative, high-energy media experience centered on financial decision-making.
  
**Role Description**
The Cloud Architect will design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures to support IFI’s digital platforms and production workflows. This full-time remote role involves working closely with product, engineering, and media teams to translate business and content requirements into robust cloud solutions, including infrastructure, application hosting, data flows, and integrations. Day-to-day responsibilities include planning and optimizing cloud infrastructure, defining architecture patterns, overseeing deployment pipelines, and ensuring reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. The Cloud Architect will also establish best practices for security and compliance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and provide guidance to development teams on cloud-native design and integration. Collaboration, documentation, and continuous improvement of the overall cloud environment are central to this role.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Solution Architecture and Architecture skills, with experience designing end-to-end cloud systems for high-traffic digital or media platforms.
* Hands-on expertise in cloud Infrastructure (compute, storage, networking) and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates).
* Background in Software Development with proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Node.js) and microservices design.
* Experience with Integration, including APIs, messaging, streaming, and connecting distributed services and third-party platforms.
* Deep knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP), including security, identity and access management, monitoring, and cost optimization.
* Proven ability to design for scalability, reliability, and performance, using CI/CD pipelines, containers, and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and remote teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in media, entertainment, or fintech environments, and familiarity with high-availability, low-latency architectures, is a plus.

e9d17c93.title: Managed Services Consultant - Lead
e9d17c93.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers, driving platform configuration, optimization, and adoption across digital and voice ecosystems. Act as a hands-on solution lead ensuring scalable design, strong customer outcomes, and continuous value realization.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Translate customer business requirements into best-practice CCaaS solutions aligned to Sprinklr capabilities and defined solution blueprints.
* Own and manage end-to-end configurations across omnichannel workflows, routing, IVR, case management, SLA frameworks, and automation.
* Manage and maintain core configuration architecture, ensuring alignment with customer blueprints, supportability, and scalability standards.
* Configure and optimize advanced routing models including skills-based routing, priority logic, queue segmentation, and escalation workflows.
* Design and enhance IVR flows, voice queue logic, call routing paths, and contact center workflow automation.
* Build and optimize bot workflows, conversational AI journeys, and automation frameworks to improve containment, productivity, and customer experience.
* Drive platform adoption by aligning features to customer use cases, usage patterns, and operational objectives.
* Monitor and improve customer contact center operational metrics such as SLA adherence, AHT, queue performance, response times, productivity, and CSAT.
* Identify platform gaps and optimization opportunities and implement best practice solutioning to improve efficiency and service outcomes.
* Manage post go-live changes, releases, configuration updates, and continuous platform improvements across the customer lifecycle.
* Support and guide API, CRM, telephony, and third-party system integrations to enable connected workflows and unified service operations.
* Lead training and onboarding sessions for agents, admins, and customer teams to drive adoption of workflows, tools, and operating practices.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify new opportunities, drive platform consumption, and support upsell/cross-sell discussions.
* Act as the primary technical and functional point of contact, advising stakeholders on solution design, adoption strategy, and operational improvements.
* Leverage AI and automation opportunities to improve ROI, efficiency, and service performance.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in managed services, CCaaS, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands-on experience with Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Twilio Flex, or comparable solutions.
* Strong knowledge of IVR, routing strategies, queue management, chatbot workflows, case management, and SLA configurations.
* Experience designing and supporting omnichannel customer journeys across digital and voice channels.
* Understanding of telephony concepts such as VoIP, SIP, CTI, and ACD.
* Experience with API, CRM, and third-party integrations.
* Hands-on experience in system configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business needs into platform solutions.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Exposure to AI-driven support models, automation use cases, and digital deflection strategies.
* Experience with social and digital engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with understanding of customer service KPIs.
* CCaaS certifications such as Genesys, Cisco, or Avaya preferred.

**Who You Are**

* A strong technical consultant with an ownership mindset.
* Able to independently manage customer outcomes and multiple engagements.
* Skilled at balancing hands-on delivery with stakeholder engagement and solution guidance.
* Customer-focused, solution-oriented, and driven by continuous improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**

* High platform adoption and improved operational performance across customer accounts.
* Strong customer retention and measurable expansion opportunities.
* Successful delivery of scalable, optimized, and well-governed CCaaS solutions.
* Recognition as a trusted advisor for day-to-day platform and service improvements.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. Job Title: CMS Architect

**Experience:** 10 Years Overall | Minimum 7 Years Relevant Experience  
**Location:** Remote – Pan India  
**Budget:** ₹2.5 LPA  
**Engagement Model:** Direct Contract with Haparz

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced CMS Architect with strong expertise in digital content architecture, enterprise content management systems, and knowledge management platforms. The ideal candidate will assess existing content ecosystems and design scalable, governed, and reusable content architectures for global websites and digital platforms.

This role focuses on content architecture, information architecture, taxonomy, metadata, content governance, localization, and knowledge management. The candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into practical architecture recommendations that improve content discoverability, consistency, reuse, and delivery across global markets.

Key Responsibilities

* Assess existing CMS, FAQ, and knowledge management ecosystems across global websites to identify architectural gaps, content duplication, and opportunities for improvement.
* Design scalable content models, classification frameworks, metadata structures, and information architectures that support reusable content across multiple websites and markets.
* Define taxonomy, tagging standards, and publishing workflows to improve content discoverability, consistency, governance, and traceability.
* Establish content reuse strategies, localization guidelines, and controlled content variations to support regional requirements without unnecessary duplication.
* Evaluate enterprise CMS, knowledge management systems, search capabilities, and content delivery platforms to recommend improvements and potential consolidation.
* Translate business and content requirements into architecture recommendations in collaboration with content strategists, business analysts, developers, and business stakeholders.
* Develop content lifecycle management frameworks covering creation, review, approval, publication, maintenance, archival, and retirement.
* Define governance models, content ownership, access controls, and compliance requirements for enterprise content repositories.
* Recommend approaches for multilingual content management, translation workflows, market-specific publishing, and global content consistency.
* Contribute to implementation playbooks, platform evaluation documents, architecture guidelines, and transformation roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to improve content search, knowledge discovery, content analytics, and omnichannel content delivery.

Required Technical Expertise

* Strong experience with enterprise CMS platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore, Salesforce Experience Cloud, Contentful, Kentico, Drupal, SharePoint, Bloomreach, or similar platforms.
* Expertise in digital content architecture, structured content modeling, and information architecture.
* Hands-on experience designing taxonomy, metadata models, tagging strategies, and content governance frameworks.
* Understanding of knowledge management systems, FAQ ecosystems, enterprise search, and knowledge discovery.
* Experience with content reuse, content lifecycle management, versioning, traceability, and publishing workflows.
* Understanding of localization, multilingual content delivery, translation management, and regional content variations.
* Ability to assess existing content platforms and develop architecture recommendations aligned with business and technical requirements.

Preferred Expertise

* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, medical devices, or other regulated industries.
* Knowledge of headless CMS, composable architecture, APIs, and omnichannel content delivery.
* Experience with content analytics, search relevance, customer support knowledge bases, and content discoverability.
* Familiarity with translation management systems and market-specific governance requirements.
* Experience creating architecture roadmaps, implementation playbooks, governance documentation, and platform evaluation frameworks.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Architecture, or a related discipline.
* CMS or digital experience platform certifications are an advantage.
* Knowledge management or information architecture certifications are desirable.

Work Location: Remote

The role involves managing student experience, academic operations, programme performance, external partnerships, admissions coordination, budgeting, and reporting.

The ideal candidate should have strong program management, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with an understanding of online learning platforms, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and student lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Program Management & Operations**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations and end-to-end delivery of the Online MBA programme.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including student engagement, retention, completion rates, and student satisfaction.
* Analyse programme performance data and implement strategies to improve operational efficiency and learner experience.
* Track individual student progress, identify at-risk learners, and coordinate appropriate intervention and support.
* Review and update programme curriculum in coordination with academic stakeholders to ensure relevance and quality.
* Develop and maintain programme websites, digital content, and online learning resources.
* Collaborate with the brand and marketing teams to develop programme-related communication and marketing materials.
* Manage programme budgets and monitor expenses to support financial sustainability.

**2. Student Experience & Support**

* Address student queries through email and other communication channels, ensuring timely resolution.
* Coordinate with academic teams, faculty members, and student support teams to enhance the overall learner experience.
* Organise student workshops, masterclasses, networking events, and other engagement activities.
* Conduct student satisfaction surveys, analyse feedback, and implement improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with career services teams to facilitate career guidance and employment-related opportunities for students.
* Ensure smooth delivery of online classes and provide support for technical or operational issues, including during weekends when required.

**3. Partner & Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with external vendors and partners, including technology providers and education financing partners.
* Coordinate vendor onboarding, evaluate performance, and resolve operational issues.
* Support contract negotiations and monitor service delivery against agreed requirements.
* Work with technology and Learning Management System (LMS) teams to ensure course content management, data backup, and platform functionality.

**4. Admissions & Enrolment Management**

* Coordinate with the admissions team to ensure smooth execution of admission and enrolment processes.
* Monitor the student enrolment journey and ensure timely completion of admission formalities.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve admission-related operational issues and improve process efficiency.

**5. MIS, Reporting & Financial Coordination**

* Prepare Management Information System (MIS) reports, dashboards, and performance reports related to enrolments, student engagement, retention, and programme outcomes.
* Analyse student data and generate actionable insights to support management decisions.
* Coordinate with the finance department regarding student billing, fee payments, and outstanding dues.
* Oversee student refund processing in coordination with the finance team.
* Maintain accurate programme records, reports, and operational documentation.

**6. Stakeholder Coordination & Administration**

* Coordinate with academic, technology, finance, marketing, career services, and student support teams.
* Participate in programme review meetings and provide updates on performance, operational challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Conduct research on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in online programme management.
* Develop and implement crisis communication and issue-resolution plans.
* Coordinate campus facilities and logistical arrangements for visiting guests and programme-related events.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and participate in relevant professional development activities.

Required Qualifications

* MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Education, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in programme management, project management, academic operations, or online education.
* Strong understanding of online learning platforms, digital education delivery, and student lifecycle management.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and coordinate cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing Online MBA programmes, distance education, higher education, or EdTech operations.
* Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS), Student Information Systems (SIS), and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms.
* Experience in MIS reporting, data analysis, budgeting, vendor management, and student engagement initiatives.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management qualification.

Key Skills

Program Management | Online MBA Operations | EdTech | Higher Education | Online Learning | Academic Operations | Student Experience | Student Engagement | Project Management | Learning Management System (LMS) | Vendor Management | Stakeholder Management | MIS Reporting | Data Analysis | Budget Management | Admissions Management | Student Lifecycle Management | Process Improvement | Cross-Functional Coordination

Working Conditions

* Full-time role in a professional office environment.
* Flexibility to work evenings or weekends when required for online classes, student engagement activities, and programme operations.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Online Education: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

48695c1b.title: Delivery Manager
48695c1b.description:
**Role Summary**

The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **1. Delivery Execution (MANAGE)**
  Own delivery commitments, including SLA tracking and quality assurance, for assigned accounts.
* Lead Agile sprint planning, execution, and demos in coordination with COEs, Solution Architects, and QA teams.
* Ensure hypercare stability (2–4 weeks post go-live) and transition to managed services.
* Manage resource allocation (onshore, nearshore, offshore) based on complexity and cost efficiency.
* Host weekly client delivery status meetings and internal syncs.
* Own major incident resolution, recovery planning, and corrective actions, including leading technical triage and root cause analysis (RCA) with engineering teams.
* Identify and implement process improvements to improve delivery efficiency and predictability.
* **2. Technical Leadership & Quality**
  Review solution designs, technical approaches, and estimates with architects and tech leads; challenge assumptions and flag technical risk early.
* Understand code, branching, CI/CD pipelines, environments, and release processes well enough to unblock teams and validate delivery status.
* Drive engineering quality practices: definition of done, technical debt tracking, and release readiness.
* Translate technical issues into clear business impact for client leadership, and client needs into clear technical direction for teams.
* Evaluate and promote the use of AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve team productivity and quality.
* **3. Risk & Opportunity Monitoring (MONITOR)**
  Continuously monitor client leadership changes, operational shifts, and market dynamics.
* Flag risks early using the
  **Account Health Dashboard (Green/Yellow/Red)**
  .
* Escalate delivery disputes or commercial risks to Delivery Director when thresholds are breached.
* Conduct continuous risk management and quality assurance checks.
* **4. Account Growth Support (MINE)**
  Partner with Account Executive (AE) and Client Success Team to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
* Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for key or at-risk accounts.
* Provide delivery health summaries and expansion recommendations to AEs.
* **5. Governance & Reporting**
  Produce
  **weekly status reports**
  rolled up to Delivery Director.
* Use PMO tools, playbooks, and dashboards per organizational standards.
* Co-run internal kickoffs with AE within
  **5 business days**
  of contract signing.
* Lead external client kickoffs within
  **1 business day**
  of tier/PM assignment.
* **6. Peer Collaboration (Global Delivery Model)**
  Operate as a peer with US and India Delivery Managers (no hierarchical silos).
* Participate in
  **weekly delivery health reviews**
  led by Delivery Director.
* Share best practices and resources across the global delivery organization.
* Provide a clean handover and clear escalation path for the hours you are offline, so clients are always covered.
* **7. Availability & Business Needs**
  Provide live support and be reachable for PST clients until approximately 1:00–2:00 AM IST, including client calls, release windows, and urgent escalations.
* Be available to attend the office on short notice when called upon by the business.
* Travel to client sites, delivery centers, or other locations as the need arises.

Must-Have Skills

Required • 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years • Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines • Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects • Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model) • Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models • Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The IB Program Manager provides end-to-end program leadership for Cardiovascular Ultrasound Installed Base initiatives. Based in India, the role partners with global stakeholders to translate customer, patient, quality, regulatory, service, supply-chain and business priorities into integrated execution plans.
  
The role owns program governance, prioritization, schedule, budget and resource visibility, cross-functional dependencies, risks and leadership escalation. The successful candidate will be operating independently across a complex global matrix and driving measurable customer, quality, lifecycle and business outcomes. Technical design authority remains with the accountable Engineering, Systems, Quality and Regulatory leaders.  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end planning and execution of assigned CVUS Installed Base programs across the post-launch product lifecycle.
* Define program scope, outcomes, milestones, deliverables, resources, dependencies, decision points and operating cadence.
* Create and maintain an integrated execution plan across Engineering, Systems, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Service, Finance and Product Management.
* Build and manage a transparent IB backlog, facilitating prioritization based on patient and customer impact, safety, regulatory commitments, product quality, service burden, fulfilment, lifecycle urgency, cost and resource availability.
* Drive cross-functional execution for customer complaints and investigations, product quality issues, corrective actions, CAPA, SCR/SPR, CSO, FMI or field actions, CCN and standards updates, cybersecurity updates, product holds and recovery actions, as applicable.
* Lead sustaining execution for design changes, supplier or component changes, obsolescence, component end-of-life, continuity of supply and product lifecycle or end-of-life activities.
* Ensure effective transition from NPI into Installed Base support, with clear ownership of residual risks, sustaining commitments and field-readiness actions.
* Lead program reviews and relevant Heartbeat operating mechanisms; maintain concise dashboards covering milestones, backlog, risks, dependencies, resources, budget, customer and quality actions, and decisions.
* Actively manage program budgets, purchase orders, forecasts and actuals in partnership with budget owners and Finance.
* Maintain resource and capacity visibility, surface constraints early, and facilitate cross-functional trade-off and allocation decisions.
* Identify and mitigate program, quality, regulatory, supply, resource, schedule and implementation risks before they affect customers or commitments.
* Escalate unresolved issues with a clear problem statement, customer and business impact, options and a recommended course of action.
* Provide clear, fact-based communication to India, Horten and broader CVUS leadership, with documented decisions, owners and closure dates.
* Apply Lean and continuous-improvement principles to simplify IB execution, improve predictability and standardize effective program-management practices.

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering from an accredited university or institution.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in engineering, program management, product development, sustaining engineering or product-lifecycle leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, global, cross-functional program in a matrix organization.
* Proven ability to convert complex technical, quality, regulatory and business issues into integrated, executable program plans.
* Strong program-management capability across scope, schedule, milestones, risk, resources, budget, dependencies, decisions and stakeholder communication.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive accountable closure without direct reporting authority.
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities, urgent field or business issues and ambiguity with limited direction.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise program reviews and escalation to senior leadership.
* Ability to work effectively across India, Europe and other global locations and time zones.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in regulated medical devices, healthcare technology or another highly regulated product environment.
* Working knowledge of medical-device design controls, complaints, CAPA, field actions, product risk management, regulatory compliance, design changes, running VCP programs and lifecycle or end-of-life processes.
* Experience with diagnostic ultrasound, imaging systems, electromechanical medical equipment or comparable complex hardware and software products.
* Experience leading sustaining releases, supplier and component changes, obsolescence, continuity-of-supply or product-quality improvement programs.
* Financial-management experience covering program budgets, forecasts, purchase orders, external spend and actuals.
* Lean or continuous improvement experience focused on reducing hand-offs, delays and execution variability.
* Experience using portfolio or program-management systems, operational dashboards and data-driven reviews to support decisions.

**Common Engineering Expectations:**

* Cloud-native and hybrid cloud/on-premises product development using AWS services.
* Containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and production observability.
* Secure engineering, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management and DevSecOps.
* Performance, scalability, availability, reliability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery.
* Automated unit, integration, API, system, performance and reliability testing.
* Strong design, coding, debugging, root-cause analysis and technical documentation practices.
* Integration challenges of third party and second party SaaS solutions.
* Working with AI-DLC and software development acceleration.

**Healthcare and Medical Device Context:**

* Experience in regulated healthcare or medical-device development is required for the Verification Lead and strongly preferred for senior architecture, automation and program roles.
* Strong knowledge on SDLC, PRD process, Risks, FMEAs.
* Awareness of patient-data privacy, cybersecurity and secure handling of clinical information.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as DICOM, HL7 and FHIR.
* + Experience with real-time clinical data, device connectivity, patient monitoring or high-availability clinical applications is advantageous.

**Inclusion and Diversity**

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
