85529b5d.title: Customer Engineer, Outcome, Google Cloud
85529b5d.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience in deployment planning, orchestration, or change management.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, or systems design.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience working with product and capacity teams to resolve technical and capacity blockers.
* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following areas: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, AI, Networking, Migrations or Security.
* Experience with Google Cloud products and differentiation from competition.
* Experience with object-oriented programming languages (i.e. Python, Java), and using technical proficiencies to remove blockers and accelerate customer deployment.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Outcome Customer Engineer (OCE), you will drive initial and ongoing business growth ramp for customers, clearing blockers and ensuring they get the maximum benefit from their investment faster. You will manage and execute the deployment plan, transitioning scoped workloads into production by providing technical leadership to customers and partners. You will have a direct impact on the velocity and incremental consumption of customer workloads, leading to accelerated value realization, higher adoption, and future expansion opportunities. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge, direct technical engagement, and technical project management to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and orchestrate a structured deployment plan across customer, professional services, and partner teams, onboarding the implementation team, clearing blockers, managing timelines and progress, and ensuring readiness (e.g., capacity, training).
* Drive and track progress of the initial and ongoing ramp of workloads, moving customers from agreement to consumption.
* Drive sustainable product usage to help customers realize value on an ongoing basis and secure future contract renewals.
* Employ coding, debugging, or systems design to resolve technical blockers and accelerate deployment.
* Identify expansion opportunities for new workloads within the account during project execution.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

c8fba1b9.title: Senior Solution Support Engineer
c8fba1b9.description:
**About the Role:**
GSK’s Enterprise AI team is expanding its ability to architect, build, and run complex AI solutions across the enterprise. Senior Solutions Engineers sit at the intersection of technical architecture, hands-on AI engineering, and production operations — ensuring that AI capabilities translate reliably into production value and keep delivering it after go-live.
  
  
As a Senior Solutions Engineer you will own the technical solution design for complex AI integrations and personally build and operate them, working across EAI engineering, business technology teams, external partners, and strategic suppliers to ensure that what gets built can be deployed, integrated, maintained, and operated at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build, and review AI systems yourself — including LLM, agentic, and retrieval-based solutions — working within the architectural standards, engineering practices, and lifecycle framework set by the Staff Solutions Engineer, and contributing to how they evolve. You bring both the architectural depth to make the right design choices and the communication skills to earn confidence across technical and business audiences.
  
  
The role carries direct accountability for the AI products and integrations you deliver. Expect to spend roughly 40% of your time on production operations and support — keeping the lights on (KTLO), meeting SLAs and service metrics, and day-to-day coordination with strategic suppliers — and roughly 60% on engineering, with a deliberate focus on using that engineering to automate operations and steadily reduce the operational load.
  
  
You will use AI agents as part of your engineering and operations toolkit, supervising their output, to keep lowering the cost at which value is delivered for the solutions you own. As those solutions scale in deployment, you are responsible for identifying when the current engineered solution needs to be refactored and/or optimised, and for recommending and delivering that change — escalating portfolio-level cases to the Staff Solutions Engineer.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists:**
As the Enterprise AI portfolio matures, the complexity of integration, deployment, and operations grows. Many of the most valuable AI opportunities require deep technical solutioning before engineering can begin, hands-on engineering to build them, and disciplined operation once they are live. In this role you will be the person who:
  
  

* Closes the gap between AI capability and enterprise deployment readiness through rigorous technical solutioning.
* Enables faster delivery by resolving integration complexity early, before it becomes a production blocker.
* Builds and ships production AI solutions hands-on, so that architectural decisions are grounded in working code rather than slideware.
* Keeps products healthy in production by owning KTLO, SLAs, and service metrics for the solutions you deliver.
* Automates the run through monitoring, AIOps, and AI agents, so reliability improves and the cost to operate falls as the portfolio grows.
* Governs the lifecycle by applying Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) discipline — stage gates, versioning, change control, and traceability — to every AI product you deliver.
* Raises the bar on solution quality by applying and contributing to architectural standards across complex engagements.
* Builds trust with business technology partners and enterprise architects through credible, well-grounded technical guidance.

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Solution Architecture & Technical Design**

* Own technical solution design for complex AI integrations — from requirements through to detailed architecture, component selection, and integration specification.
* Define integration patterns for connecting AI capabilities with enterprise systems: SAP, Veeva, Salesforce, clinical data platforms, and GSK’s data infrastructure.
* Design for operability so that observability, SLOs, runbooks, and support requirements are built into the solution from the start rather than added after go-live.
* Produce solution architecture documentation that enables downstream engineering teams to build with confidence and minimises ambiguity at handoff.

**Hands-On AI Engineering (approx. 60% of role)**

* Build and ship production AI solutions — including LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and ML model serving — integrated with GSK enterprise systems.
* Write production-quality code and reference implementations, with tests, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and CI/CD for the AI systems you deliver.
* Apply the function’s AI engineering standards — prompt and model versioning, evaluation, secure deployment — and contribute improvements back to them.
* Evaluate models, frameworks, and tooling through hands-on benchmarking of quality, latency, cost, and risk, and recommend the right choice for each engagement.
* Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and platform engineers to take proven prototypes through to hardened, supportable production services, and own the handoff for your engagements.
* Use AI agents and coding assistants as part of daily engineering and operations, supervising and quality-assuring their output to lower the cost of delivering the solutions you own.

**Deployment Readiness & Technical Assurance:**

* Lead technical due diligence for complex deployments — identifying integration risks, data dependencies, security considerations, and operational requirements before build begins.
* Drive deployment readiness assessments ensuring AI solutions meet enterprise architecture standards, security policy, and regulatory requirements prior to production.
* Provide technical assurance throughout delivery — reviewing design decisions, flagging architectural drift, and escalating risks to engineering and product leadership.

**Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) for Enterprise AI:**

* Apply the PLM framework and stage gates to every AI product and integration you deliver, preparing the release evidence — evaluation results, security, data privacy, regulatory and quality requirements.
* Maintain accurate lifecycle records for your products — models, versions, prompt versions, dependencies, owners, and status — and drive change management, deprecation, and retirement.
* Ensure traceability and auditability across the lifecycle (data lineage, model and prompt versions, approvals, and decisions), suitable for a regulated pharma environment.
* Feed delivery and operational experience back into the PLM framework so that gates and criteria improve over time.

**Production Operations & Support (approx. 40% of role):**

* Own production operation and support for the AI integrations and products you deliver, including KTLO activities such as patching, upgrades, dependency and certificate management, and break-fix.
* Deliver against SLAs, SLOs, and service metrics (availability, latency, incident response and resolution times, change success rate, cost to serve) for your services, reporting performance to the Staff Solutions Engineer and business owners.
* Diagnose and resolve integration failures and lead incident response for your services, running post-incident reviews that drive root-cause fixes rather than repeated manual remediation.
* Work day to day with strategic suppliers and platform vendors on delivery — raising and tracking tickets, coordinating support escalations, and flagging performance or SLA issues to the Staff Solutions Engineer.
* Maintain runbooks and knowledge base articles for your services, and participate in the on-call and escalation model.
* Track operational toil for the services you own and convert it into automation.

**Intelligent Operations & Automation:**

* Build and operate observability for your services — monitoring of model quality, drift, hallucination and safety signals, latency, availability, and cost — with defined SLOs, alerting, and runbooks (AIOps / LLMOps / MLOps).
* Apply AI and agents to operations itself — automated triage, root-cause analysis, runbook execution, cost and capacity optimisation, and self-service support for product teams.
* Feed production usage and operational data back into design, evaluation, and PLM decisions so the portfolio improves with every release.
* Contribute to operating-model standards — ownership, support tiers, escalation, and the FDE-to-SE handoff — drawing on what you learn running real services.

**Solution Evolution & Cost-to-Value:**

* Track unit-economics and value metrics for the solutions you own (for example cost per transaction or outcome, and run cost against business value) and use them to prioritise optimisation work.
* As your solutions scale in deployment, identify when the current engineered solution needs to be refactored and/or optimised — for performance, reliability, cost, or maintainability — and make the case, plan the work, and deliver the change; escalate portfolio-level cases to the Staff Solutions Engineer.
* Monitor scale signals (usage growth, latency, cost per unit, incident trends, architectural limits) so that refactor and optimisation decisions are triggered early, and feed the outcomes into reusable patterns.
* Own the technical roadmap for integration capabilities, identifying where investment in common patterns will reduce cost and risk across the portfolio.
* Contribute to platform engineering decisions based on deployment and integration experience — feeding real-world constraints back into how the platform evolves.

**Partner Engagement & Technical Governance:**

* Represent EAI’s technical architecture in conversations with enterprise architecture, data governance, security, and vendor partner teams.
* Build and maintain relationships with business technology leads across GSK to support alignment and accelerate approval of complex deployments.
* Contribute to EAI’s technical standards and architecture decision records, ensuring decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and reusable.

**Required Experience:**

* 15+ years in enterprise solution architecture, software or AI engineering, or technical pre-sales/post-sales engineering, with a track record of designing complex integrations.
* Recent, hands-on AI engineering experience: you have personally built and deployed production AI/ML or LLM-based systems (for example RAG, agentic workflows, model serving, evaluation pipelines) and can write, review, and debug code in languages such as Python.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, event-driven architectures, and data exchange standards.
* Practical experience with MLOps/LLMOps and cloud-native deployment (CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code, observability) sufficient to make sound decisions about AI deployment, integration, and operability.
* Experience supporting production operations for enterprise platforms or AI services, including KTLO, SLA/SLO and service-metric delivery, incident and problem management, and on-call or escalation models.
* Experience using automation — and ideally AI agents — to reduce operational toil and the cost of delivery or operation.
* Working knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) or equivalent lifecycle governance for technology, data, or AI products, including stage gates, versioning, change control, and retirement.
* Experience working with vendors or suppliers on delivery, including SLA follow-up, support escalations, and performance conversations.
* Track record of recognising when a system needs to be refactored or optimised as it scales, and delivering that work (performance tuning, re-architecture, cost optimisation).
* Experience operating in a regulated enterprise environment (pharma, healthcare, or financial services preferred).
* Confidence engaging with senior technical and business stakeholders: running workshops, producing crisp architecture artefacts, and defending design choices.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in an AI-native company or equivalent AI-first engineering environment.
* Familiarity with ITIL or SRE practices (error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, change management) applied to AI and data platforms.
* Familiarity with GxP, computer system validation, or other quality and regulatory frameworks as they apply to AI and software products.
* Experience with agent frameworks, vector and graph data stores, model evaluation and red-teaming, and AI cost management (FinOps).

#AGTech
  
  
#GSK-LI
  
  
**Skills**
AI Frameworks, Algorithm Optimization, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Algorithms, Microsoft Azure, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Performance Optimizations, Production Operations, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Solution Architecture
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

746dc19c.title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
746dc19c.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

6856fe85.title: Global AI Solution Engineer
6856fe85.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A  

**Mission of the Role**

Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an **AI Solution Engineer** to join our **Automation IS** team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and practical AI-enabled solutions. You will assess whether AI is the right approach and recommend an implementation approach based on the standards, reference architectures and technology guidance defined by the Advanced Analytics Architect and relevant platform architects. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. You will also contribute to project set-up, incremental delivery, solution quality, production readiness and reuse across Automation.

  

**Work model:** #LI Hybrid **Area:** This role contributes to AU IS in AU.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution fit**

* Work with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to clarify:business needs and expected outcomessuccess measuresAI-specific data and context requirementsrisks and ownership
* Assess whether AI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution best addresses the identified business need.
* Recommend solutions based on approved patterns and guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and the Snowflake, Azure and Fabric platform architects.

  

**Build and development**

* Develop and validate AI components, proofs of concept, prototypes and minimum viable solutions using Python, SQL and approved technologies.
* Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components.
* Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.

  

**Quality, compliance and operations**

* Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability.
* Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required.
* Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design.
* Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope.
* Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements.

  

**Collaboration**

* Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists.

  

**Requirements (Mandatory)**

**Experience and education**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.
* 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role.
* Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

  

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
* Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
* Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.
* General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case.
* Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage.
* Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality concepts, with attention to data accuracy and consistency.

  

**Ways of working**

* Experience working in an Agile or similar delivery setup.
* Ability to take part in stakeholder discussions and clarify technical, data and AI-specific aspects of documented business requirements.
* Ability to explain technical options, limitations and trade-offs, and to work effectively in a multidisciplinary delivery team.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with analysts and customers and convert documented requirements into practical AI solution components.

  

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Relevant professional certifications, particularly:Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)SnowPro Core or GenAI certificationsFabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
* Practical experience with Snowflake AI/ML capabilities such as Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst or AI Functions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience using SAP and Salesforce enterprise data as inputs to AI/ML solutions.

  

**More About Us**

ABB provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.
  
  
**Description Of The Area**
Within
**RDT Pharma Technical Operations**
and specifically in the context of
**Manufacturing Technologies**
, this Solution Architect for Process Data ensures the seamless fit of our manufacturing business solutions into the Roche ecosystem. This is crucial for implementing and running stable, robust, and highly performing solutions while maximizing the return on investment (ROI) on our manufacturing data. The Process Data area is part of the digital backbone of our production environment, ensuring that complex scientific processes are translated into reliable, executable, and reportable digital formats.
  
  
Our scope includes:
  
  

* Process Parameter Definition & Tracking: Ensuring the precision and integrity of data that defines our manufacturing steps
* Enterprise Recipe Management: Orchestrating the "blueprints" for our medicines across different sites to ensure consistency and scalability
* Data Historian Solutions: Managing the high-frequency, real-time data streams from the shop floor to enable deep analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous process improvement
* Shop-Floor Data Accessibility: Streamlining the extraction and availability of raw manufacturing data to ensure it is readily accessible for higher-level systems, analytics, and operational decision-making

**Job Responsibilities**

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments
* Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product
* Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context
* Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring

**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor or advanced degree
* Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context
* Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes

52868e32.description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Migration Specialist to lead and manage the migration of applications, data and infrastructure from legacy or existing platforms to modern cloud environments. You will assess requirements, plan and execute migrations, and help ensure minimal disruption to business operations. Based in Pune, this role requires practical experience with cloud migration methodologies, infrastructure administration, security hardening, automation and advanced technical troubleshooting.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Assess, plan and execute migrations of applications, data and infrastructure to modern cloud platforms
* Perform migrations of virtual machines, databases, applications and data to Microsoft Azure using Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Database Migration Service
* Collaborate with developers, database administrators, system administrators and other cross-functional stakeholders
* Monitor migrated environments to maintain performance, security, reliability and operational stability
* Troubleshoot migration-related issues, complete root-cause analysis and implement effective resolutions
* Deliver Level 3 infrastructure administration, including installation, configuration, monitoring and maintenance
* Identify, assess and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities to support security compliance and reduce risk exposure
* Apply operating-system security-hardening practices in accordance with organisational and industry standards
* Use Bash, Python or similar scripting technologies to automate routine activities and support enterprise system automation
* Produce technical documentation and conduct knowledge-transfer sessions to enable ongoing maintenance and support

**Who You Are**

* You have hands-on experience migrating platforms to cloud services or managed-instance environments
* You understand cloud migration methodologies and tools, particularly within Microsoft Azure
* You have experience with infrastructure technologies such as Linux, VMware and vCenter
* You hold a cloud certification relating to Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform
* You possess broad IT knowledge, including service delivery, operations and emerging technologies
* You understand ITIL frameworks and their practical application within IT service management
* You are familiar with relevant compliance and governance requirements, including GDPR
* You apply strong analytical, problem-solving and advanced troubleshooting skills
* You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, build trusted stakeholder relationships and work collaboratively across teams
* You follow through reliably on agreed actions and focus on achieving timely outcomes

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to contribute to end-to-end cloud transformation and modernisation initiatives
* Practical exposure to business-critical migrations involving virtual machines, databases, applications and data
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary technology teams across development, database, systems and infrastructure functions
* Experience supporting secure, reliable and well-governed cloud environments
* Opportunities to apply automation, troubleshooting and infrastructure expertise to complex technical challenges

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced planning and execution techniques for large-scale cloud migrations
* Practical use of Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Database Migration Service
* Cloud and infrastructure security, including vulnerability remediation and operating-system hardening
* Enterprise automation using scripting technologies such as Bash and Python
* Cross-functional stakeholder collaboration, technical documentation and knowledge transfer
* Operational monitoring and optimisation of migrated cloud environments

b8c691b0.title: Cloud Security Consultant - Information Compliance Security : CNAPP, CSPM & Multi-Cloud Exp -8 - 12 Yrs | Job Location : Gurgaon, Mumbai
b8c691b0.description:
**Company Description**
WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Cloud Security Solution Review & Design Assurance**

* Conduct comprehensive design and architecture reviews of end-to-end cloud technology solutions, including cloud platforms (M365, Azure, AWS) and SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS implementations, ensuring security by design.
* Perform in-depth technical assessments of implemented technology solutions (on-premises and cloud) to identify misconfigurations, deviations from best practices, and potential attack vectors.
* Evaluate cloud security solutions against threat models, risk assessments, and industry-recognized frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks).
* Provide expert security recommendations and architectural guidance to Risk, InfoSec, and Enterprise IT leadership, as well as to client-facing processes.

**Cloud Security Posture Management & Compliance Assurance**

* Lead and execute Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) reviews using CNAPP (Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform) tools to assess cloud security posture, cloud identity protection (CIEM), workload protection, and container security.
* Run regular compliance scans of cloud resources against standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, and SOC 2, and drive continuous improvement of compliance posture.
* Review and provide feedback on cloud security policies, procedures, and hardening documents, ensuring alignment with CIS benchmarks and organizational InfoSec policies.
* Conduct cloud risk assessments to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and misconfigurations that could impact IT operations and sensitive data.

**Secure Cloud Development & Operations Practices**

* Collaborate with Enterprise IT and DevOps teams to embed security throughout the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines.
* Review Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates and automation scripts for security flaws, guiding teams on secure IaC best practices.
* Participate in cloud attack path analysis to understand adversary techniques and design preventative and detective controls.
* Ensure CIS and other security best practices are rigorously applied across new and existing applications, products, and cloud infrastructure.

**Security Governance & Remediation Oversight**

* Partner with cross-functional teams to track and drive remediation of identified security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud security governance frameworks and processes.
* Act as a subject matter expert for incident response and forensic readiness related to cloud security incidents.
* Collaborate on cloud attack path analysis across teams.

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 8–12+ years of progressive experience in Information Security, with at least 5–7 years focused specifically on cloud security architecture, engineering, and review.
* Extensive hands-on experience with security services and features across major cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Demonstrable experience performing security assessments, penetration testing, or vulnerability management within cloud environments.
* Proven experience designing and reviewing secure cloud architectures for complex enterprise solutions.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of cloud computing principles (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and the Shared Responsibility Model.
* Expertise in cloud security frameworks and standards: NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Cloud Top 10.
* Hands-on proficiency with leading CNAPP platforms (e.g., Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Tenable, Lacework, Microsoft, CrowdStrike Cloud Security) for CSPM, CIEM, cloud workload protection, and container security.
* Strong grasp of Identity and Access Management (IAM) in the cloud: Azure AD, AWS IAM, GCP IAM, conditional access policies, MFA, SSO, PIM/PAM.
* Advanced knowledge of network security in the cloud: VPC/VNet design, network segmentation, firewalls (WAF, NGFW), security groups/NSGs, VPNs, and private links.

feb28a11.title: People Consulting-HRT Managed Services-Manager
feb28a11.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY - GDS - Consulting - People Consulting (PC), HR Managed Services - Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Manager within HR Managed Services, you will lead end-to-end HR transformation and operational delivery engagements, helping organizations design, build, transition, and run scalable HR service delivery models.
  
  
You will drive service excellence through governance, operational performance management, continuous improvement, workforce optimization, and technology-enabled process transformation. Partnering with senior stakeholders, you will shape strategic transformation agendas while ensuring sustainable operational outcomes.
  
  
In parallel, you will play a key role in growing the HR Managed Services practice through solution innovation, business development, client pursuits, and the development of market-leading managed service offerings.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Engagement Leadership & HR Transformation**

* Lead current-state assessments, transformation diagnostics and business case development for HR service delivery initiatives.
* Design integrated future-state HR operating models covering processes, organization, governance, service management and enabling capabilities.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, decision forums and executive-level discussions to align priorities and resolve design issues.
* Develop transformation roadmaps, implementation plans and change approaches that are practical and sustainable.

**HR Shared Services & Service Centre Set-up**

* Lead the design and set-up of HR Shared Services or HR Service Centres, including scope, service catalogue, organization structure, role design, governance, interaction models and service management frameworks.
* Oversee process standardization, SOP and playbook development, transition planning, knowledge transfer, training, operational readiness and stabilization.
* Define KPIs, SLAs, reporting and governance mechanisms, and establish continuous improvement routines.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, automation and self-service without making technology implementation a prerequisite.

**Client, Delivery & People Leadership**

* Own engagement delivery, financials, quality, risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations across one or more workstreams.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and collaborate with EY member firms and multidisciplinary teams.
* Lead, coach and develop project teams, ensuring clear accountability and high-quality deliverables.
* Provide subject matter guidance and challenge teams to develop insight-led, outcome-focused recommendations.

**Practice Development & Business Growth**

* Lead or significantly contribute to proposals, RFP/RFI responses, solution design, commercials, effort estimates and client presentations.
* Identify opportunities within existing and prospective accounts and support pipeline development and pursuit strategy.
* Develop market-relevant offerings, thought leadership, methodologies, credentials and reusable assets.
* Contribute to capability building, knowledge management and the growth of the HR Managed Services practice.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Deep understanding of end-to-end HR processes, HR service delivery, Shared Services and HR operating models.
* Demonstrated experience leading HR transformation, process redesign and service centre design or set-up engagements.
* Strong consulting, executive stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation and decision-making skills.
* Ability to shape ambiguous business problems into clear solutions, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Strong engagement management, commercial awareness, team leadership and quality management capabilities.
* Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills.
* Open to travel nationally and internationally for approved client projects in line with EY and country-specific travel advisory guidelines.

**Ideally, You'll Also Have**

* 10-14 years of experience in HR Transformation, HR operations, HR Shared Services or consulting.
* Master’s degree in HR or a full-time MBA/EMBA.
* Hands-on experience leading HR operating model design, Shared Services advisory, service centre set-up and transition.
* Experience managing multiple workstreams, teams and senior stakeholders across global engagements.
* Experience in process excellence, benchmarking, business case development and benefits realization.
* Proven contribution to proposals, client pursuits, account growth or the development of consulting offerings.
* Experience working with a Big 4 or comparable professional services organization.

**What We Look For**
We are seeking a consulting-oriented leader with deep expertise in HR operations, service delivery, and transformation. The ideal candidate will partner with senior stakeholders to shape strategy, optimize HR operating models, and lead large-scale transformation and managed services engagements. They will drive operational excellence through governance, service performance management, continuous improvement, and workforce optimization, while building high-performing teams and contributing significantly to practice growth, market development, and differentiated HR Managed Services offerings.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

b764ff98.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
b764ff98.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Technical Program ManagerOverview  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible.  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex cross-functional programs spanning multiple engineering teams, platforms, and stakeholder organizations.
  
  
You will drive delivery from concept to production while managing dependencies, risks, schedules, operational readiness, and executive communications.  
  
This role requires strong technical depth, exceptional program leadership, and the ability to influence across engineering, architecture, product, operations, and executive leadership teams.  
  
All About You  
Required Qualifications  
  
5-9 years of overall career experience leading large-scale technical programs and has played a TPM role.  
  
Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional initiatives across multiple engineering teams.  
  
Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and event-driven platforms.  
  
Experience managing large migration and modernization programs.  
  
Strong program planning, dependency management, and risk management skills.  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across organizations.  
  
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management capabilities.  
  
Experience leading production readiness, release governance, and operational execution activities.  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  
  
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and platform engineering.  
  
Experience with Kafka, MQ, event-driven architectures, and high-volume transaction processing systems.  
  
Knowledge of observability platforms, operational controls, and resiliency patterns.  
  
Experience within financial services, payments, or highly regulated industries.  
  
PMP, SAFe, Scrum, or equivalent certification is a plus.  
Role  
  
Drive end-to-end execution of large, complex technology programs.  
  
Establish clear program plans, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.  
  
Lead planning, execution, release readiness, and production deployment activities.  
  
Manage cross-functional delivery involving Engineering, Product, Architecture,
  
  
Security, Infrastructure, and Operations teams.  
  
Ensure predictable delivery outcomes through proactive risk management and
  
execution discipline.  
  
Develop a strong understanding of platform architecture, technical dependencies, and operational requirements.  
  
Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies.  
  
Drive technical readiness reviews, architecture reviews, migration programs, and operational preparedness activities.  
  
Coordinate large-scale platform initiatives including cloud migration, resilience improvements, infrastructure modernization, and product launches.  
  
Serve as the single point of accountability for program status, risks, decisions, and escalations.  
  
Build alignment across senior engineering leaders, architects, TPMs, product managers, and business stakeholders.  
  
Drive timely decisions and resolve competing priorities across multiple teams.  
  
Provide concise executive-level status reporting and decision support.  
  
Proactively identify and manage program risks, dependencies, and blockers.  
  
Ensure operational readiness including monitoring, observability, deployment, rollback, and support procedures.  
  
Lead war-room activities during critical incidents and drive post-incident learnings.  
  
Establish governance frameworks and reporting mechanisms to improve delivery predictability.  
  
Mentor TPMs and project leads across the organization.  
  
Promote program management best practices and execution rigor.  
  
Drive a culture of accountability, ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

a770429e.title: Program Manager, Agentic Deployments
a770429e.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

This role owns how our agentic product lands in customer environments. You'll run customer deployments from kickoff through initial agent deployment, and often into the next set of agents for the same customer, keeping each engagement on scope, on schedule, and on track to the outcome the customer signed up for. You work in close partnership with our Agentic Solutions and engineering teams, and you own the deployment programs themselves along with the internal and external reporting on them.

The job is equal parts internal coordination and customer-facing leadership. On one side, you line up the internal teams that build and ship the work and keep them moving in sync. On the other, you set expectations with the customer, keep their sponsor engaged, and make sure everyone can see where things stand. You're comfortable in the technical detail and communicate clearly with all stakeholders, from engineers to customer executives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own customer deployments end to end. Drive each engagement from kickoff and discovery through build, testing, and initial agent deployment, keeping it on scope, on schedule, and on track to the outcome the customer signed up for.
* Run the stage-gate process. Manage the go/no-go gates between phases, confirm entry and exit criteria are met, and keep the work moving without skipping the steps that matter.
* Be the customer's primary program contact. Set expectations, keep the executive sponsor engaged, run the cadence, and keep the relationship grounded in clear, trustworthy delivery.
* Coordinate the teams that deliver. Partner closely with the Agentic Solutions and engineering teams, manage dependencies across them, and clear blockers before they slip the timeline.
* Own the deployment artifacts and deliverables. Produce and standardize the engagement charters, delivery plans, status reports, runbooks, and customer-facing deliverables each deployment depends on, so quality stays consistent across engagements.
* Establish repeatable processes and practices. Turn how we deploy into a documented, reusable playbook, covering intake, kickoff, stage gates, and handoffs, that scales as we add customers instead of reinventing each engagement.
* Own internal and external reporting. Give the customer and internal leadership a clear, straight view of where each engagement stands: status, risks, dependencies, and decisions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3 to 5+ years in program or project management, ideally delivering software or technology implementations to external customers.
* A track record of owning complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and external dependencies.
* Strong customer-facing skills: you set expectations, manage stakeholders, and keep executive sponsors engaged.
* Comfortable with technical concepts and technical teams.
* Excellent organization and communication. You produce clear documentation, plans, and reporting, bring structure to ambiguity, and can run several workstreams at once.
* Comfortable in a startup or fast-changing environment where priorities shift and you help build the process, not just follow it.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience delivering enterprise software or SaaS implementations to large organizations.
* Experience building or standardizing delivery playbooks, artifacts, or processes.
* Familiarity with AI/ML, automation, and data products.
* Experience running a stage-gate or other structured delivery methodology.
* Insurance or financial services experience.
* Comfortable coordinating across distributed teams and time zones.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field, such as Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations, or Business, or equivalent practical experience.

  

*Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world.
