a53e27e3.title: Program Manager 4
a53e27e3.description:
**Job Description**
This role will lead complex technical programs, establishes scope and milestones, improves cross-team processes, automates reporting, and acts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Lead one or more major GPU Cluster Health domains such as strategic customer availability, partner repair execution, RMA/spares governance, data/reporting framework, repair workflow improvement, or engineering platform tooling.
* Translate availability gaps into structured programs with scope, owners, milestones, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive-ready status.
* Drive weekly operating rhythm for assigned domains, including KPI review, blockers, escalations, decisions, and follow-through.

**Customer and Horizontal Leadership**

* Support the vertical/horizontal TPM model by owning either a customer vertical or a horizontal functional area.
* For vertical ownership, lead availability and repair strategy for assigned strategic customers and customer clusters.
* For horizontal ownership, lead cross-cutting programs such as NVIDIA/AMD partner tracking, SDE/SRE tooling, RMA/spares feedback loop, SOP tracking, or metrics/reporting framework.

**KPI Definition and Governance**

* Define KPI measurement methods for repair health, including cluster availability, unavailable-host backlog, repair cycle time, repair success rate, reopen rate, spare availability, RMA loop performance, partner responsiveness, and SLA/SLO adherence.
* Drive consistent reporting standards across TPMs and support teams.
* Identify trends across multiple workstreams and convert them into prioritized corrective actions.

**Cross-Functional Execution**

* Partner with India, Morocco, and Mexico SDE/SRE teams to identify tooling and first-level support needs.
* Prioritize tooling requirements that reduce manual repair coordination, improve triage, automate reporting, or accelerate repair handoffs.
* Work with GSL, CHS, CPV, TRS, Warminator , and data center operations to remove repair blockers.
* Support incident-style escalation for clusters at availability risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead post-program retrospectives and drive process updates.
* Standardize repeatable playbooks, intake processes, escalation paths, and repair governance artifacts.
* Identify automation opportunities and advocate for prioritization.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Major repair programs have clear objectives, metrics, owners, and measurable improvement .
* Leadership has reliable visibility into customer cluster health and repair risk.
* Repair blockers are resolved through structured governance instead of ad hoc escalation.
* Tooling and reporting requirements are translated into actionable SDE/SRE work.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

6d1fc757.title: Sr Advisory Solution Consultant - TMT
6d1fc757.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**

* Support product sales as a technical, solution, and industry domain expert within a client-facing sales team pursuing strategic enterprise customers and prospects.
* Bring industry-specific expertise across Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, and/or Telecommunications, with the ability to understand industry operating models, customer journeys, service operations, business processes, technology landscapes, and transformation priorities.
* Translate industry challenges into compelling solution narratives by connecting business outcomes, customer experience, workflow transformation, automation, data, and AI with ServiceNow capabilities.
* Lead executive and technical discovery workshops to uncover customer priorities, operational challenges, transformation opportunities, and desired business outcomes.
* Develop and deliver compelling product demonstrations and solution experiences that reflect real industry scenarios and end-to-end business processes, rather than feature-led demonstrations.
* Engage credibly with senior business stakeholders, CIO/CTO/CBO organizations, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and transformation teams.
* Develop strong client and partner relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle.
* Develop solution architectures that demonstrate how ServiceNow integrates with a customer's broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including CRM, ERP, contact center, data, integration, and AI platforms.
* Articulate the role of AI, Agentic AI, automation, workflow orchestration, and data in transforming industry-specific processes and customer experiences.
* Stay current on competitive positioning, industry trends, emerging technology, AI developments, and market differentiation.
* Represent ServiceNow at executive briefings, customer workshops, conferences, industry forums, user groups, partner events, and trade shows.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10+ years of experience in pre-sales Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Technology Consulting, or a comparable customer-facing technology role.
* Strong domain expertise in at least one, preferably more, of the following industries: Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, or Telecommunications.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate industry business processes, customer journeys, operational challenges, transformation priorities, and technology landscapes.
* Experience converting complex business requirements into solution architectures, demonstrations, transformation roadmaps, and compelling executive narratives.
* Experience engaging both business and technical stakeholders, ranging from operational teams to senior executives and enterprise architects.
* Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with enterprise cloud software platforms and architectures.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integrations and the role of platforms such as CRM, ERP, contact center, data platforms, APIs, integration technologies, and AI services within an enterprise architecture.
* Experience working collaboratively with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Partners, Professional Services, and customer technology teams.
* Strong discovery, storytelling, presentation, demonstration, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate strategically within complex enterprise accounts while remaining hands-on with solution development and demonstrations.
* Ability and willingness to travel as necessary.

Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

3a2b3bc4.title: Principal Solutions Engineer
3a2b3bc4.description:
**Position Overview**
Solution Engineers (SEs) at SingleStore are solving some of the most cutting-edge technical challenges in today’s data-driven world. When customers evaluate SingleStore, SEs are their trusted technical experts who evaluate, identify, and demonstrate how SingleStore can solve their mission-critical business needs. As key contributors to our sales organization, Solution Engineers add tremendous value to the customer journey and directly impact company growth and revenue.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements necessary to deliver business value for our Fortune 1,000 customers. Working in partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will help to acquire new customers and expand existing accounts. You will do this by leveraging your technical skill set and business acumen to understand complex solutions and create high-quality demos that resonate with our customers.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Partner with Prospects and Customers to understand their industries and strategies, and educate them on SingleStores strategy, technologies and vision.
* Partner with Account Executives to close new business (logos) and expand existing accounts
* Partner with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing etc.) to share feedback on customer needs and requests
* Design, develop, and deploy Proofs of Concept (POCs) with prospective customers
* Drive the technical evaluation stage of the sales cycle, acting as the technical lead/subject matter expert (query tuning, load testing, etc.)
* Work to develop Channels and Partners for co-selling in the region.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Fluency in English and regional languages
* Experience with Gen AI, ML and Advanced Analytics
* Experience successfully selling enterprise database technologies, distributed systems, and similar products
* Deep understanding of distributed database technologies, including both analytic and transactional processing
* Expertise executing POCs, with experience designing and deploying complex technologies into existing customer environments
* In-Depth understanding of data platforms, including various competitive products (Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.)
* Experienced in cloud and containerized environments, deployment and orchestration (including Linux and Kubernetes environments)
* Proficient programming skills in Python, Java, or other programming languages
* Ability to travel within the region and internationally
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a relevant technical field

SingleStore is a global database company that empowers the world’s leading organizations to build and scale cutting-edge AI applications on a unified data platform that supports real-time transactions, analytics, and search. Our platform handles streaming data ingestion, vector search, full-text search, and multi-model data types - all with high performance, petabyte-scale capacity, high user concurrency, and low latency.
  
  
As a leader recognized by both Gartner and Forrester Wave, SingleStore serves the world ‘s leading data innovators including the top Fortune 500 enterprises. Our 95%+ gross retention rate reflects the strong satisfaction and trusts our customers place in the platform. SingleStore is owned by private equity firm Vector Capital and is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices worldwide, including Hyderabad.
  
  
*To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*

d3d4173b.title: Senior Consultant | D365 F&O - PMO | Mumbai | Emerging ERP Solutions
d3d4173b.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

As a Senior Consultant within Deloitte's Enterprise Technology & Performance practice, you will lead PMO governance, integrated planning, executive reporting, and project controls activities across Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP transformation programs and D365 application support engagements.

You will partner with Program Directors, Program Managers, Client Leadership, Delivery Leads, Implementation Partners, and Support Managers to drive governance excellence, delivery transparency, executive decision-making, service performance management, and program controls across complex ERP transformation initiatives.

The role requires strong consulting skills, governance leadership capability, stakeholder management expertise, and experience operating within large-scale enterprise transformation and application managed services environments.

  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  
  

Program Governance Leadership

* Lead establishment and execution of PMO governance frameworks, standards, controls, reporting processes, and operating models.

* Drive governance compliance across all program workstreams and delivery teams.

* Own governance calendars, executive review forums, steering committees, stage-gate reviews, and leadership reporting cycles.

* Ensure delivery teams adhere to agreed governance, reporting, escalation, and quality management requirements.

* Act as the primary PMO governance lead supporting Program Management, Delivery Leadership, and client executives.

* Drive governance consistency across implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support engagements.

  
  

Integrated Planning & Delivery Oversight

* Govern integrated program schedules, milestone plans, critical path activities, and dependency networks.

* Drive planning and coordination across business, functional, technical, testing, data migration, integration, deployment, support, and change management workstreams.

* Monitor overall program health, delivery performance, resource utilization, and milestone achievement.

* Identify emerging delivery risks and drive appropriate escalation and corrective action.

* Review schedule variances and challenge delivery teams on recovery and mitigation plans where required.

* Establish and monitor program KPIs and KRIs to provide visibility into delivery performance.

  
  

D365 ERP Program Governance

* Lead PMO governance across D365 ERP implementation workstreams including Finance, Supply Chain Management, Project Operations, Data Migration, Integrations, Security, Testing, Technical Architecture, and Organizational Change Management.

* Govern design, build, testing, deployment, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and transition activities.

* Monitor environment readiness, release readiness, testing readiness, and deployment schedules.

* Lead cutover readiness governance and support go-live decision-making processes.

* Govern data migration readiness, integration testing milestones, and associated dependencies.

* Track program-level dependencies and readiness indicators across all implementation phases.

* Ensure appropriate governance and reporting throughout hypercare and transition-to-support activities.

  
  

D365 ERP Support, AMS & Operate Governance

* Lead PMO governance activities across D365 ERP support, enhancement, application management, managed services, and operate engagements.

* Establish governance frameworks, reporting mechanisms, KPIs, and service management controls for support programs.

* Govern SLA performance, service delivery metrics, backlog management, ticket resolution performance, and operational risks.

* Drive governance reviews for incidents, service requests, enhancement pipelines, release schedules, and service improvement initiatives.

* Monitor support team capacity, resource utilization, demand forecasting, and operational delivery performance.

* Provide leadership visibility into service performance, recurring issues, escalation trends, support risks, and enhancement delivery status.

* Govern service transition activities from implementation programs into steady-state support operations.

* Coordinate with client leadership, support managers, vendors, and delivery teams to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.

  
  

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Management

* Own production of executive dashboards, steering committee packs, governance reports, operational reviews, and leadership presentations.

* Provide program performance insights and recommendations to Program Managers, Delivery Leaders, and client executives.

* Facilitate executive governance forums and drive timely closure of key decisions and actions.

* Build strong client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor on program governance matters.

* Present project and operational performance reporting to senior stakeholders.

* Ensure alignment across client stakeholders, implementation teams, support teams, vendors, and leadership groups.

  
  

Risk, Issue, Dependency & Decision Governance

* Establish and drive RAID governance processes across programs and support engagements.

* Govern program-level risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions, and decisions.

* Facilitate risk reviews, escalation forums, and leadership reviews.

* Monitor effectiveness of mitigation plans and ensure closure of critical actions.

* Provide leadership visibility into key delivery risks, service risks, and program constraints.

* Govern decision logs and ensure timely resolution of pending decisions.

* Escalate critical risks and issues through established governance structures.

  
  

Financial & Resource Governance

* Govern program financial reporting, budget tracking, forecasting, and variance management.

* Monitor resource demand, utilization, workforce planning, capacity management, and staffing risks.

* Support commercial and delivery leadership through financial and resource analytics.

* Oversee governance of implementation partners, managed service providers, and vendor delivery commitments.

* Monitor program and support engagement performance against agreed contractual and commercial objectives.

* Drive visibility into financial, resourcing, and operational risks.

  
  

PMO Capability Development

* Drive PMO process standardization, governance enhancement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Lead enhancement of project controls, reporting frameworks, governance templates, dashboards, and PMO methodologies.

* Support PMO audits, assessments, quality reviews, and compliance activities.

* Coach and mentor consultants and junior PMO resources.

* Contribute to the growth and maturity of Deloitte's ERP PMO and Transformation Management Office capabilities.

* Promote adoption of PMO best practices across projects and managed services engagements.

  
  
  
  

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

* 6-9 years of PMO, Program Management Office, Transformation Office, Project Controls, or Governance experience.

* Experience across at least two end-to-end ERP implementation programs.

* Experience supporting ERP implementation programs and/or application management, managed services, support, enhancement, or operate engagements.

* Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP implementation experience strongly preferred.

* Experience supporting large-scale business transformation, shared services transformation, or multi-country ERP deployment programs.

* Demonstrated experience interacting with senior client stakeholders, executive leadership, and steering committees.

  
  

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Program governance and PMO leadership.

* Executive reporting and steering committee management.

* Integrated planning and dependency management.

* Financial governance and resource management.

* RAID and decision governance.

* Stakeholder management and executive communications.

* Ability to influence delivery teams and challenge delivery performance where required.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and consulting skills.

* Understanding of IT service management concepts including SLA management, incident management, service request management, release management, enhancement governance, and service performance reporting.

  
  

**TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES**

* Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.

* Azure DevOps, Jira, Microsoft Project, or equivalent project management tools.

* Power BI and executive dashboarding solutions.

* Collaboration and documentation management platforms.

  
  

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

* PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-PBA, PMI-ACP, SAFe Agilist, or equivalent certifications.

  
  

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Science, Commerce, CA, or related discipline.

* MBA preferred.

  
  

**SUCCESS Metrics**

* Effective governance across ERP transformation programs and managed services engagements.

* High-quality executive reporting, steering committee management, and governance leadership.

* Reliable visibility into program health, risks, dependencies, financial performance, and resource utilization.

* Successful governance of testing, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and transition-to-support activities.

* Effective governance of support operations, enhancement delivery, ticket backlog management, and SLA compliance.

* Measurable improvement in PMO maturity, governance effectiveness, and reporting quality.

* Positive feedback from client leadership, delivery leadership, and program stakeholders.

* Strong visibility into schedule, cost, resource, operational, and delivery performance.

753c341a.title: Global AI Solution Engineer
753c341a.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
Senior Operation Manager for D&A
  
  
  
  
  
**Mission of the Role**
Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an
**AI Solution Engineer**
to join our
**Automation IS**
team.
  
  
In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and practical AI-enabled solutions. You will assess whether AI is the right approach and recommend an implementation approach based on the standards, reference architectures and technology guidance defined by the Advanced Analytics Architect and relevant platform architects. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. You will also contribute to project set-up, incremental delivery, solution quality, production readiness and reuse across Automation.
  
  
**Work model:**
Hybrid
**Area:**
This role contributes to AU IS in AU.
  
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Business understanding and solution fit**

* Work with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to clarify:business needs and expected outcomessuccess measuresAI-specific data and context requirementsrisks and ownership
* Assess whether AI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution best addresses the identified business need.
* Recommend solutions based on approved patterns and guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and the Snowflake, Azure and Fabric platform architects.

**Build and development**

* Develop and validate AI components, proofs of concept, prototypes and minimum viable solutions using Python, SQL and approved technologies.
* Build Azure- or Snowflake-based AI applications and services, including orchestration, retrieval, RAG, agent logic, APIs, evaluation and integration components.
* Create implementation assets, including prompts, agent instructions, evaluation datasets, notebooks, application logic, automated workflows, tests and deployment assets.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to develop AI/ML solutions that address business needs and deliver measurable business value. These include predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities to build and validate machine learning and generative AI solutions using enterprise data. These include Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.

**Quality, compliance and operations**

* Evaluate and test solutions for grounding, answer quality, model or agent behaviour, business value, safety, cost and operational reliability.
* Apply the defined Responsible AI, information security, privacy, access-control and IT compliance requirements within the assigned solution scope. Work with architecture, platform, security and operations specialists where required.
* Contribute to CI/CD, production readiness, handover and monitoring design.
* Support incident and problem analysis related to AI solutions within the assigned scope.
* Document AI solutions, including their logic, assumptions, limitations, test results and operational requirements.

**Collaboration**

* Work as part of a multidisciplinary delivery team with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers and platform specialists.

**Requirements (Mandatory)**
**Experience and education**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience delivering AI, ML or advanced analytics solutions, including at least one solution taken from requirements through implementation.
* 4–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, BI analytics or a similar data-focused role.
* Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level).

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL for data preparation, API integration, testing and solution development.
* Strong practical understanding of generative AI application patterns, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering and evaluation.
* Practical experience with at least one enterprise AI development platform, preferably Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI AI capabilities is an advantage.
* General understanding of classical machine learning concepts. Hands-on experience is an advantage where relevant to the use case.
* Working experience with version control and testing, preferably using GitHub or Azure DevOps. Exposure to CI/CD and deployment processes is an advantage.
* Experience documenting AI solutions and understanding data quality concepts, with attention to data accuracy and consistency.

**Ways of working**

* Experience working in an Agile or similar delivery setup.
* Ability to take part in stakeholder discussions and clarify technical, data and AI-specific aspects of documented business requirements.
* Ability to explain technical options, limitations and trade-offs, and to work effectively in a multidisciplinary delivery team.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with analysts and customers and convert documented requirements into practical AI solution components.

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Relevant professional certifications, particularly:Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)SnowPro Core or GenAI certificationsFabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
* Practical experience with Snowflake AI/ML capabilities such as Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst or AI Functions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience using SAP and Salesforce enterprise data as inputs to AI/ML solutions.

e98c7551.title: Scaled AI & Solution Architect
e98c7551.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Scaled AI & Solution Architect is the senior technical design authority for the Digital Quality (DQ) organisation, which delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer. The role is a global individual contributor position accountable for setting and driving the AI and solution architecture direction across the entire DQ product portfolio, rather than for the delivery of any single product.

The incumbent defines the target architecture, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering standards that every DQ solution is built against, so that capability is built once and reused many times rather than rebuilt product by product. The role leads the scaled adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic AI across the portfolio, translating enterprise AI platforms and emerging technology into GxP-compliant, validated, production-grade capability that measurably improves quality, safety and environmental outcomes at site level.

Recognised as an expert within and beyond Digital Quality, the incumbent influences the strategic technology direction of the QSEO business, and partners with Solution Leads, the Platform and Solution Engineering team, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security to ensure architectural coherence, compliance and pace across a complex global portfolio.  
  
**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Cross-Product Solution Architecture**

* Own the target-state solution architecture for the Digital Quality portfolio, spanning quality management, laboratory, manufacturing quality, and safety, environment and occupational health solutions.
* Define how products, platforms, data and integrations fit together, and drive convergence of point solutions onto common architecture, avoiding duplicated capability and unmanaged technical debt across the portfolio.

**Architecture Standards, Patterns and Reusable Components**

* Establish, publish and maintain the architecture standards, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering guardrails that DQ solutions are designed and built against, covering integration, data, identity, AI, validation and cyber security.
* Make reuse the path of least resistance for delivery teams, and measure adoption, reuse and the resulting delivery efficiency.

**Scaled AI Enablement**

* Define and drive the AI and agentic AI architecture for the DQ portfolio, including use case patterns such as deviation and incident triage, leading-indicator prediction, automated document and content generation, and conversational access to standards and procedures.
* Determine where AI capability should be built once as a shared service versus configured per product, and ensure AI is delivered on enterprise platforms with appropriate human oversight, evaluation, model monitoring and lifecycle management.

**Design Authority and Technical Governance**

* Act as design authority for significant DQ investments, reviewing and approving solution designs at key lifecycle gates and providing architectural assurance on build-versus-buy, platform selection and vendor technical fit.
* Identify multiple viable options for highly complex problems, set out the trade-offs in cost, risk, compliance and time to value, and make clear recommendations to Digital and business leadership and relevant governance forums.

**Technical Leadership and Capability Building**

* Provide hands-on architectural leadership to Solution Leads, Product Managers, engineers and vendor teams across the portfolio without direct reporting authority, influencing through expertise, credibility and evidence.
* Mentor and raise the technical capability of architects and engineers across Digital Quality, and lead architecture and AI Communities of Practice that spread good practice across DQ and the wider Digital organisation.

**Compliance, Data Integrity and Security by Design**

* Ensure architectural decisions embed GxP computerised system compliance, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements from the outset, in partnership with Quality, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Cyber Security.
* Define validation-efficient architecture patterns that allow AI and cloud capability to be deployed at pace while remaining inspection-ready.

**Innovation and Emerging Technology**

* Exercise foresight in evaluating emerging AI, data and platform technologies, and act independently on self-initiated proofs of concept and technical experiments that challenge the status quo and shape the multi-year DQ technology roadmap.
* Take appropriate, well-governed technical risk, and translate proven experiments into scaled, supportable production capability with a defined adoption path.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Engineering, Environmental or Occupational Health Sciences, Life Sciences or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in in solution architecture, technical leadership or enterprise software delivery (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including demonstrable accountability for architecture across a portfolio of products rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI or machine learning capability into production, including an understanding of large language model and agentic architecture patterns, retrieval, evaluation and model lifecycle management.
* Strong experience with cloud, integration and data architecture, and with modern software engineering and Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Experience setting and driving adoption of technical standards across teams that do not report to the incumbent, influencing senior stakeholders through technical credibility.
* Experience across all stages of the system and application lifecycle, from value analysis and business case through deployment to value realisation and technical debt management.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation and data integrity expectations (e.g. GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11).
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS business processes and the platforms that support them (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority).
* Experience deploying AI in a regulated context, including responsible AI governance, model risk assessment and human-in-the-loop design.
* Recognised architecture certification (e.g. TOGAF) or equivalent cloud architecture certification.
* Track record of external technical contribution — industry forums, working groups, publications or conference speaking.

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS**

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.

**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to work with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.

**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms – Digital Quality Lead.

Key internal relationships include Enterprise Architecture, the enterprise AI and Data organization, Cyber Security, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation, Legal and Privacy, and senior business stakeholders across Quality and EHS in Pfizer Global Supply. External: strategic software and AI vendors, cloud and platform providers, implementation and managed service partners, and relevant industry and regulatory technical forums.

**RESOURCES MANAGED**

**Financial Accountability**

No direct budget ownership. Influences the architecture and technology decisions underpinning the Digital Quality portfolio representing approximately $10M of annual software, services and transformation investment, and is accountable for identifying reuse and rationalization opportunities that improve return on that investment

**Supervision**

Individual contributor with no direct reports. Provides technical direction and design authority to matrixed teams of product, engineering, data, validation and vendor resources across the Digital Quality portfolio, and mentors architects and senior engineers across the organization.

  
  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

f75c7f70.title: Principal Technical Account Manager
f75c7f70.description:
**Technical Account Manager – Oracle Database**

Technical Account Manager (TAM), combining strong Oracle Database expertise with customer relationship management, strategic account planning, and service delivery leadership. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping enterprise customers improve database availability, performance, security, and operational efficiency across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

You will translate customer business priorities into actionable technical plans, coordinate Oracle teams, and oversee service commitments. The role requires technical judgment, clear communication, and ownership of customer outcomes—from proactive risk management and technology adoption to critical incident coordination and continuous improvement

  

.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer relationship management:** Build trusted relationships with database administrators, architects, IT leaders, and executive stakeholders. Understand their business objectives, technical environments, and operational priorities.
* **Strategic account planning:** Develop and maintain technical account plans, service roadmaps, and customer success plans with clear milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes.
* **Service delivery and governance:** Coordinate contracted service deliverables, track commitments and applicable service levels, and conduct regular operational reviews and executive business reviews.
* **Incident and escalation management:** Lead customer communication during critical incidents, coordinate support and engineering teams, track resolution activities, and drive follow-through on root cause analysis and preventive actions.
* **Proactive database health management:** Coordinate health checks, performance reviews, capacity assessments, and availability evaluations to identify risks and recommend improvements.
* **Database lifecycle planning:** Guide customers through database upgrades, migrations, patching, platform modernization, and cloud adoption, including readiness assessments and risk mitigation.
* **Availability and recovery:** Review high availability architectures, backup strategies, disaster recovery readiness, and recovery testing against customer recovery objectives.
* **Security and governance:** Advise on database security practices, access controls, encryption, auditing, and vulnerability remediation in collaboration with customer security teams.
* **Technology adoption:** Help customers evaluate relevant Oracle Database, OCI, automation, and AI capabilities based on business value and operational readiness.
* **Customer advocacy:** Represent customer priorities within Oracle, coordinate cross-functional resources, and communicate product feedback and recurring issues.
* **Continuous improvement:** Maintain account documentation, action registers, service dashboards, and technical recommendations that demonstrate progress and service value.

**Required Database and Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Oracle Database administration, architecture, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management, including Oracle Database 19c and familiarity with Oracle AI Database 26ai.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Multitenant architecture, including container databases, pluggable databases, provisioning, consolidation, and resource management.
* Experience with Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Automatic Storage Management (ASM), Oracle Data Guard, and Active Data Guard.
* Strong database performance analysis and SQL tuning skills, including execution plans, indexing, optimizer statistics, wait events, AWR, ASH, and ADDM.
* Experience with RMAN backup and recovery, restore validation, disaster recovery planning, and recovery time and recovery point objectives.
* Knowledge of Oracle Exadata architecture, workload optimization, and operational considerations.
* Experience planning database migrations, upgrades, and patching using appropriate tools such as Data Pump, AutoUpgrade, GoldenGate, and Zero Downtime Migration.
* Familiarity with OCI database services, Oracle Autonomous AI Database, Exadata Database Service, and Exadata Cloud@Customer.
* Understanding of database security capabilities, including Transparent Data Encryption, privilege management, auditing, Oracle Data Safe, and Database Vault.
Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL, Linux/Unix fundamentals, and scripting or automation using Python, shell scripts, Ansible, or Terraform.  

**Modern Database Skills — Preferred**

* Familiarity with Oracle AI Vector Search, vector embeddings, similarity search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) use cases.
* Awareness of Select AI and natural language access to enterprise data.
* Understanding of JSON Relational Duality, modern SQL capabilities, and support for relational, JSON, spatial, and graph workloads.
* Knowledge of cloud database observability, infrastructure automation, and performance and cost optimization.
Ability to assess the operational, security, and governance requirements of AI-enabled database solutions.  

**Technical Account Management Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical issues through their business impact and recommended actions.
* Experience managing escalations, setting expectations, resolving conflicts, and maintaining customer confidence.
* Strong planning, prioritization, and coordination skills across multiple accounts or concurrent initiatives.
* Understanding of incident, problem, and change management practices, preferably aligned with ITIL.
* Ability to define and track service measures such as customer satisfaction, milestone completion, recurring incident reduction, and risk remediation.
Demonstrated ownership, analytical thinking, and effective collaboration across distributed teams.  

**Qualifications**

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant experience in Oracle Database technologies and customer-facing technical account management, consulting, enterprise support, or service delivery is required. Oracle Database, OCI, and ITIL certifications are desirable.

Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Architect to lead the design, governance, and modernization of enterprise-wide technology solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in enterprise architecture, .NET-based application ecosystems, desktop engineering, and on-premises infrastructure environments. This role will be responsible for defining architecture standards, driving digital transformation initiatives, establishing technology roadmaps, and ensuring alignment between business objectives and technology strategies.

  

* **Role: Senior Enterprise Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Define and govern enterprise architecture frameworks, standards, principles, and technology roadmaps.

* Drive modernization and transformation of legacy applications and enterprise platforms.
* Architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and disaster recovery-enabled solutions across distributed environments.
* Establish enterprise integration strategies across applications, databases, middleware, APIs, and third-party systems.
* Lead architecture decisions for .NET applications, desktop environments, virtualization platforms, networking, and on-prem infrastructure.
* Define infrastructure architecture covering compute, storage, security, networking, and enterprise platforms.
* Establish architecture governance processes, compliance controls, risk management practices, and security standards.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and leadership to align technology investments with business goals.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technology assessments, and technical governance forums.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic improvements and modernization opportunities.
* Mentor architects, developers, and engineering teams on enterprise architecture best practices.
* Support enterprise-wide transformation programs and technology adoption initiatives.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 10-15 years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, or Technology Strategy.
* Strong experience designing enterprise-scale .NET application ecosystems.
* Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman, and Architecture Governance models.
* Strong understanding of Desktop Engineering and Enterprise Endpoint Management environments.
* Extensive experience working with On-Prem Infrastructure, VMware virtualization, servers, storage, and enterprise platforms.
* Deep knowledge of Microservices Architecture, SOA, Event-Driven Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design.
* Proven experience in application modernization, legacy transformation, and enterprise platform consolidation programs.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, high availability, disaster recovery, and fault-tolerant architectures.
* Experience defining enterprise integration patterns, API strategies, middleware solutions, and data architecture standards.
* Expertise in infrastructure architecture, networking, security architecture, compute, and storage platforms.
* Strong knowledge of architecture governance, compliance frameworks, and risk management practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive enterprise-wide technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience collaborating with executive leadership and influencing strategic technology decisions.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

  + Cluster lifecycle management
  + Worker node design and scaling
  + Networking and ingress
  + Storage integration
  + Secrets and certificate management

  + Backup and recovery
  + Security controls and policy enforcement

  + Engineering & Validation environments

* Implement GitOps deployment patterns using Argo CD, or approved alternatives.
* Drive automation-first approaches for provisioning, configuration management, upgrades, compliance validation, and operational support.
* Build repeatable deployment patterns that reduce operational effort while improving consistency and quality.

**DevSecOps & Platform Reliability**
------------------------------------

* Integrate security, compliance, and operational controls into platform delivery processes.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure, platform services, and Kubernetes lifecycle activities.
* Support vulnerability management, policy enforcement, secrets management, and certificate management capabilities.
* Define and improve platform reliability, availability, observability, backup, and recovery capabilities.

**Qualification, Testing & Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------------

* Develop automated validation and qualification frameworks for:
  + Kubernetes releases

  + Storage integrations
  + Network integrations
  + Security controls
  + Platform services
  + Edge deployments
  + GPU-enabled configurations

* Support development of platform standards, support matrices, and operational runbooks.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardization, measurement, and operational feedback.

**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Partner with architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, operations teams, and application teams to deliver platform capabilities.
* Participate in architecture reviews and technology evaluations.
* Help define engineering roadmaps and implementation plans.
* Contribute to platform strategy through practical implementation experience and operational insights.

**Key** **Responsibilities/Minimum** **Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree with 5+ years of total experience.

* Experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* Strong knowledge of AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with **Kubernetes platforms** such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), OpenShift, RKE2, or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred), CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Linux administration, Containers and container platforms, Cloud networking and security, Observability and monitoring solutions

835c3868.title: Operations Program Manager
835c3868.description:
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and pursue new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we face unique support problems resulting from our scale and the types of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational support and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to meet the growing needs of external users and internal Stripe teams. Our support experience draws on a deep understanding of our products, the financial industry, money movement, and our customers’ products and users. Building this experience requires us to invest significant resources in talented teams of Stripes.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We’re looking for dynamic and entrepreneurial leaders who will define our strategy for scaling the Core Payments team, improve operational workflows, and maintain a best-in-class Operations program. If you like hard problems, are analytical, are comfortable operating with ambiguity, and enjoy finding creative solutions, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end product launches across multiple regions as an integrated program. Develop and maintain detailed launch plans that serve as the central point of coordination across globally distributed and highly cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product Management, go-to-market, cross-functional review, Support, and other key partner teams.
* Drive operational excellence across the product launch lifecycle by designing, improving, and implementing scalable processes that strengthen stakeholder coordination, clarify dependencies, maintain alignment, and support consistent execution across regions.
* Monitor and report on progress through biweekly status updates to senior leadership while maintaining transparent documentation throughout.
* Support cross-functional collaboration by identifying and documenting teams’ responsibilities for product launches, proactively communicating blockers, and providing transparent status updates and relevant documentation, such as product launch Gantt charts, program plans, and scope details.
* Define and improve operating rhythms that support efficient collaboration across teams. Manage operational cadences for product launches and business reviews, and track Stripe Objectives and Key Results (SOKRs).
* Establish scalable launch frameworks and operational structures to simplify execution, improve cross-functional alignment, and support efficient multi-region product rollouts.

**Minimum Requirements**

* More than 7 years of total work experience, including 4 to 5 years in program management, consulting, or a similar role within a high-growth technology company, with a strong focus on managing strategic product initiatives from conception through implementation.
* A proven track record in process and project management, including creating operational processes, leading product roadmap reviews, and designing scalable systems in fast-paced environments.
* Skill in scheduling, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines to support the timely delivery of products and features.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and executing complex projects while building collaboration across diverse teams and functions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including high-level planning and ongoing communication to align project goals with operations.
* The ability to present ideas, product updates, and roadmaps clearly and persuasively to a range of stakeholders, including executives, to build alignment and understanding of project objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in program management, consulting, or a similar role within payments or fintech.
* Familiarity with roadmap management tools and planning frameworks, and knowledge of how to apply them to manage projects effectively.
* The ability to understand the company’s strategic goals and align the product roadmap accordingly.
* Skill in helping stakeholders prioritize product features and initiatives based on business value, customer needs, and resource availability.
* A deep understanding of global markets and the ability to contextualize decisions and processes to account for regional nuances.
* Experience implementing process improvements and change-management strategies to scale operations effectively.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

6f0c2463.title: Presales Solutions Consultant
6f0c2463.description:
Build the Future of Enterprise AI

Are you a
**top engineering graduate**
who enjoys solving problems, understanding technology, building things, and explaining how technology can create business impact?

Do you find yourself naturally exploring
**AI, GenAI, APIs, software products, and emerging technologies**
?

At
**Zycus**
, you can turn that technical curiosity into a career at the intersection of
**AI, Enterprise Technology, Consulting, and Business**
.

We are looking for exceptional Graduate Engineers to join our
**Pre-Sales / Solution Consulting**
team and work with some of the world's largest enterprises.

This is not a traditional sales role.

You will work with Sales, Product, Engineering, AI, and customers to understand complex business problems, design technology-led solutions, and demonstrate how
**AI-powered enterprise software**
can transform the way organizations work.

What You'll Do

Solve Real Business Problems With Technology

Enterprise customers come to us with complex problems—not just requests for software.

You will:

* Understand customer business processes and challenges.
* Break ambiguous problems into structured requirements.
* Translate business needs into technology solutions.
* Research industries, companies, and customer environments.
* Identify where software, automation, and AI can create measurable value.
* Work with experienced Solution Consultants to develop solution strategies.

Your job is to answer:

**"How can technology solve this customer's problem?"**

Bring AI Into Enterprise Solutions

AI is at the core of Zycus.

You will learn and work with:

* Generative AI
* LLMs
* AI Agents
* Intelligent Automation
* AI-powered workflows
* Conversational AI
* Data and analytics

You will help demonstrate how AI can automate work, generate insights, improve decision-making, and transform enterprise processes.

You will also be encouraged to experiment with AI tools to improve your own productivity and create better solutions.

**We want engineers who don't just know about AI—they use it.**

Design Technology Solutions

Working with senior Solution Consultants and Product teams, you will:

* Design solutions based on customer requirements.
* Understand system architecture and application workflows.
* Work with APIs, integrations, data, and enterprise systems.
* Configure and demonstrate product capabilities.
* Create solution prototypes and proof-of-concepts where required.
* Understand how enterprise SaaS applications integrate with customer ecosystems.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to validate technical solutions.

You will progressively develop from
**understanding the product → designing solutions → owning solution discussions.**

Create Compelling Product Demonstrations

One of the most important skills you will develop is the ability to
**show—not just tell—how technology solves a problem.**

You will:

* Build customized product demonstrations.
* Design demos around customer business scenarios.
* Present technical capabilities and business outcomes.
* Demonstrate AI-powered workflows.
* Explain complex technology to both technical and business audiences.
* Participate in customer presentations and solution workshops.

The goal isn't to demonstrate every feature.

The goal is to demonstrate:

**"Here's your problem. Here's how we solve it. Here's the value you get."**

Work With Global Enterprises

You will gain exposure to some of the world's largest organizations and work alongside experienced Sales and Solution Consulting teams across global markets.

You may participate in:

* Customer discovery sessions
* Technical workshops
* Solution presentations
* Product demonstrations
* Proof-of-concepts
* RFP/RFI responses
* Executive presentations
* Competitive analysis
* Account strategy

You will learn how enterprise technology decisions are actually made.

Work Across the Organization

You will collaborate with:

* Enterprise Sales
* Product Management
* Engineering
* AI/ML teams
* Customer Success
* Implementation
* Marketing

You will become the
**technical bridge between the customer and Zycus**
.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for
**elite Graduate Engineers**
with strong technical foundations and exceptional problem-solving ability.

Education

* B.E./B.Tech —
  **2027 graduates**
* Preferred disciplines:
* Computer Science Engineering
* Computer Engineering
* Information Technology
* Artificial Intelligence
* Data Science
* Information Science
* Electronics & Communication
* Other strong engineering disciplines

We are particularly interested in candidates from
**top engineering institutions**
with strong academic and technical credentials.

What We Value

You don't need prior Pre-Sales experience.

We are looking for:

Strong Problem Solving

* Excellent analytical and structured-thinking ability.
* Ability to break complex problems into logical components.
* Strong aptitude for learning new concepts quickly.
* Comfort working with ambiguous problems.

Technical Curiosity

* Strong programming fundamentals.
* Understanding of software and technology concepts.
* Interest in SaaS, cloud, APIs, data, and enterprise technology.
* Ability to understand how different systems work together.

AI Fluency

We strongly value candidates who actively use AI.

You should be able to demonstrate how you have used tools such as:

* ChatGPT
* Claude
* Gemini
* Cursor
* GitHub Copilot
* Perplexity
* Other AI development or productivity tools

Even better if you have:

* Built an AI application.
* Built an AI Agent.
* Worked with an LLM or RAG.
* Created an AI-powered automation.
* Built a chatbot.
* Used AI to solve a real-world problem.
* Participated in an AI/technology hackathon.

Communication & Influence

Great Solution Consultants are excellent communicators.

You should be able to:

* Explain technical concepts simply.
* Present ideas confidently.
* Tell a compelling story around technology.
* Listen carefully and ask intelligent questions.
* Communicate with both engineers and business leaders.
* Influence without relying on authority.

You don't need to be a polished salesperson.

**We will teach you Pre-Sales.**

What we cannot easily teach is
**curiosity, intelligence, problem-solving ability, and the desire to understand technology deeply.**

What You'll Learn

At Zycus, you will develop a combination of skills that is difficult to acquire in a traditional engineering role.

Technology

Enterprise SaaS • APIs • Cloud • Integrations • Data • Architecture

AI

GenAI • LLMs • AI Agents • Intelligent Automation

Consulting

Discovery • Problem Definition • Solution Design • Business Analysis

Pre-Sales

Product Demonstrations • POCs • Solution Workshops • RFPs • Competitive Strategy

Business

Enterprise Buying • Digital Transformation • ROI • Value Selling

Communication

Storytelling • Executive Communication • Presentation • Influence

Where Can This Career Take You?

This role is designed to build the next generation of
**technology consultants and enterprise solution leaders**
.

As you grow, you can build a career toward:

**Solution Consultant → Senior Solution Consultant → Solution Architect → Principal Solution Architect**

or explore adjacent paths across:

**AI • Product Management • Enterprise Consulting • Sales Engineering • Customer Success • Business Value Consulting**

Why Zycus?

Zycus is an
**AI-first enterprise SaaS company**
transforming procurement for some of the world's largest organizations.

Our platform combines
**Source-to-Pay technology with Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, data, and intelligent workflows.**

You will get the opportunity to:

* Work with
  **Fortune 500 and global enterprises**
  .
* Work on real-world AI use cases.
* Learn enterprise SaaS and technology architecture.
* Work alongside Sales, Product, Engineering, and AI teams.
* Build solutions that impact large organizations.
* Develop both technical and business skills.
* Learn from experienced Solution Consultants and technology leaders.
* Build a career at the intersection of
  **AI + Technology + Business**
  .

The Profile We're Looking For

If you are someone who:

**Loves technology**

**Uses AI every day**

**Enjoys solving difficult problems**

**Can explain what you build**

**Enjoys interacting with people**

**Wants to understand how businesses work**

—you could be an exceptional Solution Consultant.

Start Your Career Where Technology Meets Business

Your engineering degree gives you the technical foundation.

At Zycus, you'll learn how to turn that foundation into
**solutions that solve real problems for the world's largest enterprises.**

**Build with AI. Solve complex problems. Work with global enterprises. Create impact.**

Join Zycus as a Graduate Solution Consultant

This position is based in Bangalore, India and covers the APAC territory.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive sales growth among independent resellers in the assigned territory by serving as a primary sales and technical advisor for Brivo products and third-party API integrations.
* Conduct product demonstrations, presentations, customer engagements, and field events for resellers and end-users, both virtually and on-site.
* Provide technical and design support to resellers and Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), including project design, Bills of Materials (BOMs), competitive differentiation, and remote/on-site support for escalated issues.

* Maintain knowledge of regional competitors, including local VMS and cloud providers, to support RSMs and resellers with technical differentiation and competitive opportunities.

**Skills, Expertise & Qualifications**

* Experience in physical security or access control, with 5+ years as a pre-sales technical professional OR relevant field experience selling, installing, or programming Brivo systems.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Proficiency with CRM, Google Workspace, and design tools.
* Previous experience crafting responses to functional and technical requirements for RFIs and RFPs.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver engaging product demonstrations to dealers and end users, both virtually and in person.
* Experience in creating a bill of materials (BOM).
* Proficient in delivering pre-sales and technical training content.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present ideas clearly and concisely.
* Confident, energetic, and enthusiastic approach.
* Capable of lifting 25 kg.
* Possession of a valid Passport and willingness to travel 25%-50%, including outside the assigned territory; proximity to a major airport is required.

**About Brivo**
Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises.
  
  
As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.
  
  
With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.

Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*
