8004967e.title: Sr Principal Solution Consultant
8004967e.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is an AI-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market-leading company with double-digit growth and a blue-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
  
  
In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
  
  

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

What You'll Need
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21), and Advanced Process Control (APC) & Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.
* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals & Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food & Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Power Generation, and Water & Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning & Scheduling - Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Regional travel up to 35%.

67674b07.title: Senior Solution Consultant - IND
67674b07.description:
**About Kinaxis**
Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high-trust and high-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state-of-the-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
  
  
**Location**
Chennai (or) Bangalore - Office Based
  
  
As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
  
  
****What you will do****

* Participate in deep-dive customer business requirements discovery sessions and develop requirements specifications documentation.
* Support Solution Architect in providing creative solutions to complex business problems while maintaining best practices.
* Guide and mentor junior consultants on the project team during project.
* Learn Maestro software and perform solution configuration.

* Understand supply chain industry trends and benchmark customer against the same.
* Ensure the customer is obtaining the business benefits as captured in the business case.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Support data management and data integration related activities.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.

* Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills.
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc

****What we are looking for****

* A passion for working in customer facing roles and you have great interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* 10 -15 years of relevant experience understanding manufacturing, production planning and demand management in Supply chain domain with software consulting exposure..
* BS/MS/PhD in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field with an excellent academic record.

#Intermediate #Senior

Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

4a6631f3.title: Solutions Engineer III
4a6631f3.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**About the Company:**
F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
  
  
**The SE Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.
  
  
Sounds interesting? Read on!
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives
* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.

**How you’ll do it:**

* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN, NGINX
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, CICD.
* Experience with SaaS vendor and able to articulate SaaS benefits
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Expert in one or more programming languages like Python, Golang, JavaScript. Linux Scripting

**What you’ll bring:**

* 10 + years of related industry experience
* 6+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus
* Relevant certifications a plus
* Hybrid Multicloud App Security & Delivery for the AI Era
* Unified delivery & security for applications, APIs, & AI workloads across any infrastructure, trusted by 85% of the Fortune 500.
* Secure your digital ecosystem.

* Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake

* Understanding of dimensional modelling concepts
* Clear written and verbal communication and a collaborative, curious approach to learning

1c472010.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, cloud infrastructure, agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a AI Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. 22671eaa.description:
**Job Title** Solutions Architect – HPC and container Platform.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Solution Architect with expertise in High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Container platforms in Linux-based environments to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting solutions including but not limited to installation, configuration, integration and implementation of HPC technologies and enterprise-grade container orchestration platform.

Candidate must have strong proficiency as a Solution Architect in at least three areas and proficiency in other areas.

1. **Leadership and Strategy:**

1. Develop HPC and container platform roadmaps and strategies for growth based on business needs.
2. Engage in and enhance the complete service lifecycle—from conceptualization and design to implementation and operation.
3. Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these in design activities.

2. **Solution Planning and Design:**

1. Gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and design integrated HPC and container solutions that align with business objectives.
2. Architect and optimize the technical solutions to meet the requirements of the customer.

1. Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and industry developments related to HPC, Kubernetes, containers, cloud computing, and Security.
2. Develop best practices, Accelerators and Show & Tell for HPC and container platform solutions and integrations.

5. **Customer-centric mindset:**

1. Strong focus on understanding customer business requirements and solving complex cloud technology issues
2. Be the trusted advisor, delight customers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences to drive customer success.
3. Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non-technical stakeholders

6. **Team Collaboration:**

1. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including system administrators, developers, data scientist and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.
2. Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources within the company
3. Mentor and train new team members and lead the way in participation in tech talks, forums, innovation.

**Required Skills:**

* Knowledge and experience with Linux System Administration, package management, scheduling, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance optimization, and networking concepts.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with HPC technologies, workload schedulers – Slurm, Altair PBS pro, and cluster managers – HPCM, Bright cluster manager.

* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with OpenStack cloud solutions.
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with virtualization technologies like KVM, OpenShift virtualization
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two various Linux distributions like RHEL, SLES, Ubuntu, Debian.
* Good Knowledge of GPU technologies, NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA vGPU technology
* Good knowledge of HPC networking stack (high speed networking), InfiniBand, Mellanox
* Good experience in performance optimization and health assessment of HPC components such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and container orchestration platforms.
* Must be good in any of the programming or scripting languages like python, bash
* Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, Routing and Load Balancing.
* Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Solid business acumen and ability to converse with client on issues and challenges.
* Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.
* Demonstrates a high-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, HPC and Container platform Specialist, or similar role, with expertise in designing and implementing complex solutions.

We are seeking a Cloud Architect to design, define, and govern cloud-native infrastructure for SD SL core network deployments. The role covers the cloud platform that hosts 5G and 4G core network functions, including Cloud Network Functions (CNFs), and ensures they meet performance, availability, security, and operational requirements. The architect works across network, cloud, and delivery teams to move solutions from design through deployment and into operation.

What will you do:

* Evaluate cloud vendors, platforms, and tools, and make technology recommendations with clear trade-off analysis.
* Support deployment planning, troubleshoot architecture-level issues during rollout, and provide guidance to delivery teams.
* Drive automation, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD practices for core network cloud environments.

* Strong knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including Kubernetes, containers, and service mesh concepts.
* Working knowledge of virtualization and NFV concepts, including OpenStack or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of 4G/5G core network architecture, including EPC and 5GC network functions and their interfaces.

047ae53f.title: Senior Staff Solution Architect
047ae53f.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
ServiceNow is seeking a Sr Staff Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of scalable, intelligent, and high-impact solutions across the Connected Customer Experience portfolio. This is a senior-level, hands-on architecture role focused on enabling seamless digital workflows, integrating platform capabilities with AI/ML and data-driven insights, and ensuring technical excellence across customer-facing applications.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of product, engineering, platform, data, and AI teams to architect solutions that enhance user experience, deliver personalized customer journeys, and drive measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in enterprise SaaS architecture, CRM systems, solution design, AI/ML integration, and data platform engineering within Digital Technology (DT) environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect scalable, secure, and compliant end-to-end solutions integrating platform capabilities with intelligent data-driven features across customer experience applications.
* Define architecture patterns for workflows, integrations, platform extensions, and API-driven services that extend ServiceNow capabilities while ensuring alignment with security and platform standards.
* Lead evolution of architectural standards, evaluate tools and frameworks, and partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business requirements into technical designs.

**AI/ML & Data Platform**

* Architect AI/ML capabilities for personalization, recommendations, semantic search, and conversational AI with service layers that enable easy consumption by product teams.
* Design unified data architecture bringing together customer signals across touchpoints, including data lakes, warehouses, real-time pipelines, and analytical products.
* Establish governance frameworks for data quality, privacy, security, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA) while ensuring data readiness and pipeline integration.
* Define architecture for model observability, performance monitoring, and continuous learning feedback loops.

**Technical Strategy & Leadership**

* Define multi-year architectural roadmaps and lead architectural reviews, governance processes, and critical modeling decisions across product verticals.
* Translate complex designs into accessible, secure services ensuring observability, performance, and operational excellence while mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies and foster a culture of technical excellence.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 15+ years in enterprise software architecture, solution design, or technical leadership with significant CRM and enterprise SaaS platform experience.
* Proven track record designing production-grade solutions across customer service, digital workflows, CRM, or customer experience platforms.
* Deep expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, API-first design, cloud-native technologies, and security best practices.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML systems with hands-on experience in personalization, NLP/NLU, semantic search, or conversational AI.
* Experience with data platform architecture including data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), and data governance.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face), MLOps tools, and data processing tools (Spark, dbt, Airflow).
* Excellent communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders across cross-functional, matrixed global organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ServiceNow platform and extending its capabilities through custom applications or intelligent services.
* Deep understanding of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow CSM) and their integration with customer experience ecosystems.
* Background in customer journey orchestration, personalized digital experiences, or recommendation engines in large-scale SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases for GenAI applications.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and experience in global, matrixed organizations.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role shaping customer experience architecture within one of the world's leading enterprise platforms.
* The opportunity to define architectural strategies for mission-critical applications serving millions of users.
* A collaborative, innovation-focused culture with organizational influence and visibility to senior leadership.

Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

ca9d938f.title: Solution Architect, Customer Experience
ca9d938f.description:
Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!
  
  
The DCTx brings together digital journey, platform, and delivery capabilities to create connected and scalable customer and dealer experiences across AGCO.  The CX Journey Team owns the end-to-end customer experience and outcomes, translating customer, dealer and business needs into journeys, priorities and measurable CX requirements. It works upstream with business, brands, regions, customers and dealers, and downstream with other Journey, Platform, Data and Technology teams that provide the capabilities and execution needed to deliver those experiences at scale. The Sr Solution Architect, Customer Experience owns the design and end-to-end architecture for the customer experience solutions covering architecture & solution designs, APIs, data models, NFRs and tech enablers that support customer listening, onboarding, ownership readiness, and AI-enabled engagement across AGCO's ownership journey. He partners with business and platform teams to define scalable, integrated, and reusable and globally aligned agentic capabilities that improve customer experience.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Lead solution architecture for major initiatives, platforms, applications, integrations and data flows, translating business and technical requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable designs.
* Define and govern architecture standards and documentation, including solution designs, architecture diagrams, decision records, integration patterns, APIs and implementation guidance, aligned with security, data, privacy and enterprise architecture principles.
* Evaluate solution options and guide delivery teams, balancing business value, feasibility, cost, risk, scalability, performance, resilience and maintainability throughout design, build, test and deployment.
* Drive technical improvement and modernization, identifying dependencies and risks, promoting reusable patterns and platform capabilities, and contributing to cloud adoption, architecture roadmaps, technical debt reduction and operational stability.
* Evaluate AI and automation opportunities, including generative AI and AI-enabled solutions, considering business value, data readiness, integration, responsible AI, security, privacy and governance while staying current with emerging AI and technology trends.

**Your Experience And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Business Informatics, Data, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered. Typically, 6–8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in architecture, solution design, software engineering, enterprise applications, integration, infrastructure, cloud platforms, data, cybersecurity, or digital platforms. Typically, 6–8 years of relevant software development experience, including complex enterprise applications, digital platforms, integrations, cloud, data, or IT delivery.
* Deep architecture and system design expertise across enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, cloud, data flows, infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity, and operational models.
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills, able to independently solve complex architecture challenges, evaluate alternatives, and lead architecture deliverables and workstreams.
* Practical AI expertise, including generative AI, AI agents, automation opportunities, data readiness, responsible AI, governance, privacy, security, and business-use-case evaluation. Security-by-design and business-oriented mindset, ensuring solutions address security, compliance, resilience, user needs, operational sustainability, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong communication and technical leadership, including architecture documentation, stakeholder influence, cross-functional collaboration, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across emerging technologies and AI.

**Your Benefits**

* GLOBAL DIVERSITY – Diversity means many things to us, different brands, cultures, nationalities, genders, generations – even variety in our roles. You make us unique!
* ENTERPRISING SPIRIT- Every role adds value. We are committed to helping you develop and grow to realize your potential.
* POSITIVE IMPACT – Make it personal and help us feed the world.
* INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGIES - You can combine your love for technology with manufacturing excellence – and work alongside teams of people worldwide who share your enthusiasm.
* MAKE THE MOST OF YOU – Benefits include health care and wellness plans and flexible and virtual work options.

**Your Workplace**
We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.
  
  
**Join us as we bring agriculture into the future and apply now!**

f5fd9a7d.title: Senior Software Architect ( AWS, .NET)
f5fd9a7d.description:
**Description**

We are seeking an experienced Cloud Native AWS Software Architect to lead the design and development of cutting-edge cloud-hosted solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in AWS, microservices architecture, SaaS product development, and modern web application frameworks. This role requires a hands-on leader who can drive architectural decisions, mentor engineering teams, and ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performance cloud applications.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of cloud-hosted web applications for the insurance industry from network infrastructure design to user experience, database schema, data models, workflow automation, and end-to-end integration testing.  
   • Define and own architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AWS-native SaaS products.  
   • Collaborate closely with product management, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.  
   • Drive domain-driven designs for data models, APIs, and data products.  
   • Architect and implement microservices using modern frameworks and container orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS).  
   • Oversee CI/CD pipelines and DevOps processes for rapid, reliable, and secure deployments.  
   • Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs with a focus on performance and scalability.  
   • Develop functional, responsive, and accessible front-end interfaces using HTML5, CSS/SCSS, TypeScript, Angular/React, and modern UI component libraries (e.g., Kendo UI, Infragistics).  
   • Ensure security best practices in application architecture, including IAM policies, encryption, API security, and compliance with industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2).  
   • Champion cloud-native principles and serverless architectures using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, and other AWS managed services.  
   • Work with AWS data services, including Redshift, RDS, Aurora, and S3, for building scalable data-driven applications.  
   • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives to evaluate emerging AWS services and architectural approaches.  
   • Mentor and guide development teams in architecture decisions, code quality, and performance optimization.  
   • Support UI automation testing alongside development activities to ensure high-quality deliverables.  
   • Collaborate with QA and DevOps teams for automated testing, monitoring, and application observability using tools like CloudWatch, X-Ray, and Open Telemetry.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field; Master’s preferred.  
 • 8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with 2+ years in an AWS cloud-native architect role.  
 • Proven experience designing and implementing AWS-native SaaS products and complex full-stack applications.  
 • Strong expertise in .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Core, and modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular, React, TypeScript).  
 • Experience with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway) and microservices deployed on ECS/EKS.  
 • Proficiency with SQL and database programming for both RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and AWS data solutions (Redshift, Aurora, DynamoDB).  
 • Experience designing secure, multi-tenant SaaS architectures.  
 • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working in cross-functional product teams.  
 • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK.  
 • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, AWS Code Pipeline, or similar tools.  
 • Experience implementing application monitoring and observability.

4d5bdb6f.title: Principal Engineer (Data science + AI architect)
4d5bdb6f.description:
**Company Description**

  

**We're Nagarro,** we are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000+ experts across 40 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

  

**Job Description**

  

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Total experience 11+ years.
* Must have experience to design, build and run GenAI and Agentic AI solutions inside enterprise systems, fitting AI into existing systems, security rules and budgets.
* Must have ability to translate ambiguous business problems into durable technical architectures.
* Must have strong ML fundamentals; how models are trained, tested and compared; spotting overfitting and weak data, deep learning basics; embeddings, classification, ranking models
* Should be able to architect and implement scalable ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions (LLMs, RAG, autonomous agents) aligned with business objectives.
* Must have experience in data science, ML engineering or AI architecture, with at least 5 years leading ML solutions from design to production.
* Should have expertise in Python, SQL and Solid statistics, including outlier detection and error metrics
* Should have exposure to time series forecasting.
* Should have production experience with regression and tabular ML: feature engineering, model selection, calibration, uncertainty (conformal or quantile intervals) and explainability (SHAP, coefficients).
* Must have experience with hierarchical forecasting or reconciliation, and prompt-injection testing.
* Should have hands-on experience with embeddings, vector search and hybrid retrieval, and with LLM applications: tool calling, retrieval-grounded generation, citations, guardrails and evaluation.
* Should have hands-on experience for building conversational agent, with multi-turn session memory and tool calling into the multiple engines and the semantic layer.
* Must have experience on a major cloud: pipelines, model registry, drift monitoring, retraining and low-latency serving.
* Should have experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Gemini, Vector Search), or equivalent on another cloud.
* Design retrieval-grounded generation with citations, input and output guardrails, human approval for actions, and layered, attack-tested prompt-injection protection.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Understanding the clients business use cases and technical requirements and be able to convert them into technical design which elegantly meets the requirements.
* Lead the design and implementation of complex GenAI workflows that combine LLMs, tools, APIs, structured data, and user context.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for prompt design, model integration, evaluation, and observability.
* Drive GenAI platform building reusable components, SDKs, and frameworks used across multiple teams or products.
* Partner with product, design, data, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions.
* Review critical designs and codebases, unblock teams on complex technical challenges, and raise the overall engineering bar.
* Lead technical discovery and solutioning for high-impact initiatives, including client or executive-facing workshops when required.
* Ensure enterprise readiness: security, privacy, compliance, governance, and responsible AI practices.
* Mapping decisions with requirements and be able to translate the same to developers.
* Identifying different solutions and being able to narrow down the best option that meets the clients requirements.
* Defining guidelines and benchmarks for NFR considerations during project implementation
* Writing and reviewing design document explaining overall architecture, framework, and high-level design of the application for the developers
* Reviewing architecture and design on various aspects like extensibility, scalability, security, design patterns, user experience, NFRs, etc., and ensure that all relevant best practices are followed.
* Developing and designing the overall solution for defined functional and non-functional requirements; and defining technologies, patterns, and frameworks to materialize it
* Understanding and relating technology integration scenarios and applying these learnings in projects
* Resolving issues that are raised during code/review, through exhaustive systematic analysis of the root cause, and being able to justify the decision taken.
* Carrying out POCs to make sure that suggested design/technologies meet the requirements.

2d6b1904.description:
**Project Role :**
Cloud Migration Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next-generation business outcomes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Oracle Database Architecture
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
Oracle Database Administration (DBA)
  
  
**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current systems and infrastructure to determine the best approach for transitioning applications and data to cloud environments. This role includes strategizing and executing migration plans that ensure scalability and high performance, utilizing both private and public cloud platforms. The position requires close collaboration with various teams to align migration efforts with business goals, ensuring seamless integration and minimal disruption during the transition process. Continuous monitoring and optimization of cloud solutions are also key aspects of daily activities to support evolving organizational needs.

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.

* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design migration strategies.
* Monitor and troubleshoot migration processes to ensure successful deployment.
* Document migration procedures and best practices to support knowledge sharing.
* Assist junior team members in understanding migration workflows and cloud technologies.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Oracle Database Architecture.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Oracle Database Administration (DBA).
* Strong knowledge of cloud computing concepts and migration methodologies.
* Familiarity with performance tuning and optimization of database systems.
* Ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues related to database migration.
* Experience working with both private and public cloud platforms to deliver scalable solutions.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Oracle Database Architecture.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for Senior Technical Consultants with strong domain depth in Revenue Cloud or Comms or Fins or Health. Depth in one of the four is what we require.
  
  
You will lead a work stream in sophisticated enterprise customer engagements as a hands-on advisor: designing the solution, guiding the build, and presenting and defending it with the customer. You will lead the evaluation of options, proactively manage risk, and see issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT: Responsibilities**
Lead the technical design and delivery of a work stream within your domain.
  
  
Drive application and technical design documents that follow Salesforce best practices and fit the customer's landscape.
  
  
Guide the team on integration, environment management, testing and platform standards.
  
  
Troubleshoot critical implementation issues through to resolution.
  
  
Manage customer expectations and negotiate solutions with the customer and third-party partners.
  
  
Mentor junior teammates and contribute to the growth of the Services Practice.
  
  
Up-skill on AI Fluency and AI-native delivery, using AI tools and developer assistants (e.g. Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, Claude).
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
2+ years hands-on Salesforce delivery in Revenue Cloud or Financial Cloud or Health Cloud or Communications Cloud
  
  
7+ years as a Lead Developer overall doing solution design in a mid to large-sized organization.
  
  
Experience with key areas of enterprise architecture - integration technologies, single sign-on and master data management.
  
  
Experience with Waterfall and/or Agile implementation methodologies.
  
  
Proven ability to analyze, design and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
  
  
Strong written and verbal communication, and strong presentation skills — able to present and defend a point of view to a variety of audiences.
  
  
Able to work independently and be a self-starter.
  
  
Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or in a related field.
  
  
Highly beneficial to have any Salesforce.com product certifications prior to joining.Expected to gain these certifications within the first 3 months:
  
  
Certified Platform App Builder
  
  
Certified Platform Developer I
  
  
Certified Agentforce Specialist
  
  
Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
  
  
Certified Integration Architect
  
  
plus the certification for your domain
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Leadership Qualities
  
  
PASSION: Passionate about Customer Success
  
  
BEGINNERS MIND: Always learning, approaches each interaction with an open mind, a great listener, and hands-on
  
  
THOUGHT LEADER: Strong point of view and executive presence. Confident, but not arrogant, a great storyteller
  
  
URGENCY: Ability to move fast and drive business value and results
  
  
OHANA: Embodies Aloha culture: A team player that everyone enjoys working with and has a generous heart
  
  
TRUST: Trust the company's core values
  
  
ADAPTABLE: Excels in high levels of uncertainty and change

The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility.
  
  
Application Solution Architect
  
  

* Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery.
* Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management.
* Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts.
* Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach.
* Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context.
* Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications.
* Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks.
* Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery.
* Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets.

Core Technical Capabilities
  
  

* Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design.
* Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development.
* Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions.
* Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls.
* Programming and frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, NativeScript, Angular, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, and Node.js.
* Analysis and delivery: Requirements elicitation, process and capability analysis, functional decomposition, NFR definition, dependency analysis, solution option assessment, backlog shaping, sprint planning, and Agile architecture governance.
* Architecture governance: Context, component, deployment, integration, data, security, and NFR views; decision records; traceability; architecture reviews; standards compliance; risk management; and handover criteria.

Leadership and Consulting Skills
  
  

* Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms.
* Strong analytical, estimation, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving capability, with clear articulation of trade-offs.
* Customer-focused and commercially aware, with an understanding of how architecture choices affect cost, risk, schedule, scalability, serviceability, and competitive positioning.
* Collaborative and credible across matrix teams, cultures, and time zones, with the ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities.
* Strong ownership, adaptability, resilience, quality orientation, and the ability to coach architects and engineers.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Significant experience in application solution architecture, bespoke software engineering, technology consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and modernising enterprise applications across web, mobile, API, integration, and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading architecture and solutioning across presales and delivery, including estimation, proposal development, and transition to implementation.
* Practical understanding of Azure solution patterns, security, resilience, integration, DevSecOps, operational readiness, and Agile delivery.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, Agile, project-management, or engineering certifications are desirable.

**Technology and Platform Exposure**

Angular, React, Flutter, NativeScript, TypeScript, JavaScript, responsive design and accessibility.
  
  
**Back end and APIs:**

API gateways, messaging, event streaming, enterprise integration patterns and service-to-service security.
  
  
**Engineering and delivery:**
Git-based engineering, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code and environment strategy.
  
  
**Operations:**

3b468c94.description:
**Customer**

The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.

**Position Summary**

**Level:** Genesys Cloud Manager(CCaaS), Technical Transformation

**Work you’ll do:**

Deloitte is seeking a Genesys Cloud Architect with deep expertise in cloud contact center platforms and a strong command of the latest AI capabilities. You will design and lead the delivery of intelligent customer engagement solutions that combine Genesys Cloud CX with generative AI, conversational AI, and advanced analytics. You will translate complex client objectives into scalable, secure, and AI-enabled architectures, and you will help organizations move from traditional contact centers to predictive, self-service, and agent-assist experiences that measurably improve customer outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Genesys Cloud CX engagements, including routing, IVR, digital channels, workforce engagement, and analytics
* Architect AI-driven experiences, including virtual agents, generative AI assistants, intent recognition, and self-service automation, integrated with Genesys Cloud AI capabilities (such as Genesys Cloud AI Studio, Agent Copilot, and Agent Assist)
* Design integrations with large language models and AI platforms (such as Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Anthropic Claude) using Genesys Cloud Data Actions, APIs, and middleware
* Define retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns and knowledge base strategies to ground AI responses in client content, with appropriate guardrails
* Establish governance frameworks for responsible AI in the contact center, covering data privacy, bias monitoring, human-in-the-loop escalation, and model performance tracking
* Design speech and text analytics pipelines, including real-time sentiment, quality scoring, and conversation summarization, to drive operational insight
* Partner with business stakeholders and delivery teams to translate requirements into AI-enabled technical designs and business cases
* Conduct solution reviews, performance assessments, and risk evaluations throughout the project lifecycle
* Guide migrations from legacy on-premise or other CCaaS platforms to Genesys Cloud
* Mentor consultants and developers on Genesys Cloud configuration, AI tooling, and architectural patterns
* Contribute to thought leadership, proposals, and AI-enabled accelerators within the CX practice

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of experience in contact center technology, with at least 5 years hands-on with Genesys Cloud CX
* Genesys Cloud certification (Architect, Admin, or Developer) preferred
* Deep knowledge of Genesys Cloud Architect, Data Actions, APIs, and Journey capabilities
* Hands-on experience with generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompt design, evaluation, and integration into production systems
* Familiarity with conversational AI platforms, NLU, and voice bot design
* Experience integrating contact center platforms with CRM and enterprise systems (such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics)
* Strong understanding of WFM, Quality Management, and reporting/analytics within CCaaS environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to executive audiences
* Willingness to travel to client sites as required

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with agentic AI workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Knowledge of AI security, responsible AI, and regulatory requirements (e.g., EU AI Act, PCI, HIPAA) in regulated industries
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, and knowledge retrieval architectures
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Genesys Cloud Platform API development
* Prior consulting experience in a client-facing role

**What You'll Bring**

* A consultative mindset and a passion for using AI to improve customer experiences
* Curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and the discipline to evaluate them against business value
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
* Leadership skills to guide cross-functional teams toward shared outcomes

**Manager-level success measures**

* Architecture connects business outcomes to implementable Genesys Cloud and AI capabilities.
* AI-enabled journeys have clear controls, escalation paths, and operational ownership.
* Delivery teams understand design decisions and dependencies, with limited avoidable rework.
* Client stakeholders have visibility into progress, risks, and readiness for launch and operations.
* Teams are coached effectively and contribute to sustained client relationships

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

13cefe90.title: Platform Product Delivery Manager
13cefe90.description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Location

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

  IT & Digital Solutions
* Deadline

  2026-11-18

  

Candidate profile (title) Who you are

Candidate profile (text) - Default language Are you a strong delivery leader within digital products and platforms, who enjoys leading cross-functional teams and creating real business impact through technology? Do you thrive in complex environments where you balance product vision, engineering excellence, and operational performance?
  
  
If yes – keep reading, as this might be your next role!
  
  
We are looking for a Platform Product Delivery Manager to join IKEA Group Digital. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of digital products within a platform subdomain, ensuring they are built and operated with quality, scalability, and business value in mind.
  
  
You are someone who inspires others, builds strong teams, and creates clarity in complex situations. You combine a strong customer focus with a deep understanding of technology and delivery, and you have the ability to translate insights into tangible product outcomes.
  
  
Above all, you take ownership, show initiative, and are passionate about delivering high-quality digital products that make a difference.
  
  
Furthermore, we believe that you bring:
  
Strong experience in leading cross-technical product and engineering teams
  
Good understanding of software engineering principles and modern development practices
  
Experience working with agile methodologies and outcome-oriented ways of working
  
Ability to define and measure success through KPIs and OKRs
  
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  
Understanding of cost drivers in software delivery and the impact of technical decisions
  
A passion for digital product delivery, innovation, and continuous improvement

Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us

Key responsibilities (text) As a Platform Product Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for driving the full lifecycle of digital products – from discovery and development to deployment and operations – ensuring they deliver value to the business and our customers. [
  
  
You will work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to secure alignment, remove obstacles, and ensure seamless delivery across teams and dependencies.
  
  
You will also play a key role in building strong, high-performing teams and enabling ways of working that support speed, quality, and continuous improvement.
  
  
To be concrete, you will:
  
  
Role and Responsibilities:
  
The SAP BASIS and Infrastructure Manager is responsible for managing SAP technical operations, infrastructure services, SAP Solution Manager, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), system availability, performance, security, roles and authorizations, and operational support across development, test, and production environments.
  
  
The role ensures that SAP systems and supporting infrastructure are stable, secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned with business requirements.
  
  
Scope of Responsibilities
  
  
SAP BASIS Management
  
Manage and support SAP landscapes, including development, quality assurance, and production systems.
  
Oversee SAP installations, upgrades, patches, kernel updates, system copies, refreshes, migrations, and decommissioning.
  
Manage SAP transports across system landscapes in accordance with change-management procedures.
  
Monitor SAP system health, availability, performance, and capacity.
  
Manage background jobs, interfaces, RFC connections, printers, certificates, and technical configurations.
  
Coordinate support packs, enhancement packages, SAP Notes, technical upgrades, and remediation activities.
  
Troubleshoot and resolve SAP system, database, integration, and performance-related issues.
  
Ensure effective incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
  
  
2. SAP Solution Manager
  
Manage and administer SAP Solution Manager environments and related technical components.
  
Support system monitoring, technical monitoring, application monitoring, and alert management.
  
Manage change and transport processes using SAP Solution Manager capabilities.
  
Support IT service management, incident, problem, and change-management processes.
  
Maintain system documentation, technical inventory, system relationships, and solution documentation.
  
Coordinate maintenance planner activities, upgrade planning, system validation, and technical readiness assessments.
  
Support root-cause analysis, business-process monitoring, and service-level reporting.
  
Ensure Solution Manager is integrated with the SAP landscape and relevant support processes.
  
  
3. SAP BTP
  
Manage and support SAP Business Technology Platform services and environments.
  
Administer BTP accounts, global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, subscriptions, and service assignments.
  
Manage BTP security, trust configuration, identity federation, destinations, certificates, and connectivity.
  
Support SAP BTP services such as Integration Suite, Cloud Connector, API Management, Extension Suite, and application runtimes, where applicable.
  
Monitor BTP applications, integrations, usage, performance, availability, and service consumption.
  
Coordinate BTP provisioning, configuration, upgrades, incident resolution, and lifecycle management.
  
Ensure BTP environments comply with enterprise architecture, security, governance, and cost-management requirements.
  
Work with application and integration teams to support cloud-based extensions and interfaces.
  
  
4. SAP Roles and Authorizations
  
Own the technical administration and governance of SAP roles, profiles, users, and authorizations.
  
Design, create, modify, and maintain SAP roles in accordance with approved business requirements and security policies.
  
Support composite, single, derived, and business roles as applicable.
  
Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning, access changes, and emergency access processes.
  
Coordinate role testing, approval, transport, and deployment across SAP environments.
  
Support segregation-of-duties analysis, critical-access reviews, and remediation activities.
  
Coordinate periodic user-access reviews and role recertification with business process owners and information security.
  
Maintain appropriate controls for privileged access, firefighter/emergency access, and technical users.
  
Ensure roles and authorizations are documented and aligned with the approved organizational and process structure.
  
Support audits and provide evidence relating to access controls, authorization design, and remediation activities.
  
  
5. Infrastructure Management
  
Manage the infrastructure supporting SAP applications, including servers, databases, operating systems, storage, networks, and cloud platforms.
  
Ensure infrastructure availability, resilience, scalability, and performance.
  
Coordinate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning.
  
Manage operating-system and database maintenance in line with SAP requirements.
  
Establish monitoring, alerting, capacity-planning, and performance-management processes.
  
Ensure appropriate backup, restore, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity arrangements.
  
Coordinate infrastructure support with internal teams, hosting providers, cloud providers, and technology partners.
  
  
6. Security and Compliance
  
Ensure SAP, Solution Manager, BTP, and infrastructure environments comply with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements.
  
Support vulnerability assessments, security patching, audit activities, access reviews, and segregation-of-duties controls.
  
Coordinate remediation of security findings, SAP vulnerabilities, authorization risks, and infrastructure issues.
  
Maintain appropriate system logging, monitoring, privileged-access controls, and technical evidence.
  
Ensure compliance with change-management, access-management, and operational-control requirements.
  
  
7. Service Delivery and Operations
  
Own the delivery of SAP BASIS, Solution Manager, BTP, roles and authorizations, and infrastructure services in line with agreed service levels.
  
Lead the resolution of critical incidents and coordinate cross-functional technical teams.
  
Establish and maintain operational procedures, support models, escalation processes, and knowledge articles.
  
Review service performance, recurring issues, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  
Maintain accurate technical documentation covering system architecture, integrations, dependencies, configurations, and operational procedures.
  
Coordinate production deployments, maintenance windows, cutover activities, and rollback planning.
  
  
8. Project and Change Management
  
Provide technical leadership for SAP implementations, upgrades, migrations, integrations, BTP initiatives, and transformation programs.
  
Review technical designs for SAP BASIS, Solution Manager, BTP, infrastructure, security, and authorization components.
  
Prepare technical estimates, resource plans, dependencies, risks, and implementation timelines.
  
Coordinate technical testing, security testing, role testing, cutover planning, go-live activities, and post-production support.
  
Ensure changes are assessed, approved, tested, documented, and implemented with minimal business disruption.
  
  
9. Vendor and Stakeholder Management
  
Manage relationships with SAP, infrastructure, cloud, hosting, security, and application-support vendors.
  
Review vendor performance, service quality, deliverables, and contractual commitments.
  
Coordinate with business stakeholders, application teams, information security, internal audit, enterprise architecture, and process owners.
  
Communicate system status, risks, incidents, planned maintenance, access issues, and improvement initiatives.
  
Manage budgets, licensing considerations, BTP consumption, resource requirements, and third-party services.
  
  
10. Team Leadership
  
Lead, mentor, and develop SAP BASIS, Solution Manager, BTP, authorization, and infrastructure team members.
  
Define roles, responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations.
  
Ensure appropriate support coverage, on-call arrangements, knowledge transfer, and succession planning.
  
Promote automation, standardization, role optimization, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  
Ensure the team follows IT service-management, security, compliance, and governance processes.
  
Must demonstrate strong People Leadership capabilities enabling teams to achieve individual and collective goals and ability to build high performing teams.
  
Must lead by example in line with IKEA values and leadership compass.
  
Should demonstrate strong rooting in relevant content, be it technology or function.
  
Is a strategic thinker and is able to translate organizational & domain objectives into subdomain level strategic and operational goals with clarity, focus while staying anchored on business value delivered.
  
Has demonstrated experience in working with senior stakeholders and ability to understand stakeholder expectations, build good relationships and maintain high stakeholder satisfaction.
  
Proven Problem solving and critical thinking skills to steer through complex or demanding scenarios with a positively and “can do” mindset.
  
  
Experience required:
  
Extensive experience (15+ years) in managing and implementing large-scale SAP projects, specifically within BASIS/Infra modules, preferably in a retail environment.
  
Proven track record of leadership with at least 5-7 years in a senior management or Director role, leading high-performing teams.
  
Deep functional and technical expertise in SAP BASIS/Infra. Experience with S/4HANA is highly desirable.
  
Strong understanding of retail business processes and how SAP applications can be leveraged to drive efficiency and competitive advantage.
  
Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management abilities, with a knack for influencing and collaborating across all levels of an organization.

Team vision ( title) Together as a team

Team vision (text) You will be part of Group Digital, where we set the digital agenda to keep IKEA leading in a fast-moving and uncertain world. We develop and operate digital products and platforms that support the entire IKEA value chain and enable better experiences for both customers and co-workers. You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingkas global organisation.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

eb713a34.title: Project Manager – Project Delivery (Intra-Logistics Warehousing Solutions)
eb713a34.description:
**Toyota Automated Logistics** is a part of the Toyota Industries Group and specializes in warehouse automation and material handling solutions. We work on innovative technologies and solutions such as automated storage and retrieval systems, conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, and other warehouse automation solutions that help businesses improve operational efficiency and productivity.

* **Methodology:** Waterfall (Phased Execution: Initiation, Design, Manufacturing, Installation, Commissioning, Closeout)
* **Travel Requirements:** Up to 30–50% (depending on phase of site commissioning)

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Waterfall Phase Gate Management:** Lead large-scale warehouse automation projects through structured Waterfall milestones (Engineering Sign-off, Factory Acceptance Testing, Mechanical/Electrical Installation, Commissioning, and Handover).
* **Scope & Change Control:** Manage highly detailed technical scopes. Prevent scope creep by strict documentation and pricing of Change Orders for any equipment or software modifications.
* **Project Schedule & Milestone Tracking:** Maintain the Master Project Schedule (e.g., Gantt charts). Forecast long-lead procurement items (conveyors, AS/RS cranes, racking) to avoid site delays.
* **Budget Tracking:** Manage multi-million dollar equipment and labor budgets, tracking progress payments and billing milestones tied to delivery phases.
* **Monitor & Control Supplier deliverables :** Coordinate with suppliers for complete deliverables from date of P.O issue till P.O completion, including warranty period. Ensure timely receipt of dispatch documents from suppliers and handover to Finance team for accounting. Coordinate with Finance team for timely supplier payment releases as per agreed terms.
* **Reporting:** Prepare & update project progress to customers and internal stakeholders on Weekly & Monthly basis
* **Payment Reconciliation :** Ensure payment collection from customers as per the deliverables and payment terms agreed with customers
* **On-Site Vendor & Subcontractor Coordination:** Supervise mechanical and electrical installation contractors on-site to ensure work adheres to engineering drawings and safety protocols.

**Technical & Professional Requirements**

* **Industry Experience:** 2–6 years of project management or coordination in **intra-logistics, warehouse automation, material handling, conveyor systems, or industrial construction**.
* **Methodology:** Proven experience executing capital expenditure (Capex) hardware/software integration projects using **Waterfall** methodologies.
* **Technical Skills:** Ability to read and interpret mechanical layout drawings, electrical schematics, and system sequence of operations.
* **Software Proficiency:** Strong skills in project scheduling tools like **Microsoft Project**. Should have hands on experience working in Microsoft Planner.
* **Preferred / Nice-to-Have:** Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering; PMP certification or equivalent field experience in material handling.
