31ee6f86.title: Delivery Manager
31ee6f86.description:
**Req ID:**
390371
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Delivery Manager to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
The Delivery Manager cum Scrum Master is responsible for ensuring successful end-to-end delivery of technology projects while facilitating Agile/Scrum practices across development teams. The role combines
**delivery ownership, stakeholder management, Agile leadership, team coordination, risk management, and continuous improvement**
.
  
  
The individual will work closely with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Architects, Engineering Teams, QA, DevOps, and Program/Portfolio Management to ensure that projects are delivered with the expected
**scope, quality, timelines, and business outcomes**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Delivery Management
* Own end-to-end delivery of assigned applications, projects, products, or programs.
* Develop and maintain delivery plans, milestones, timelines, and dependencies.
* Track project progress against agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
* Ensure timely delivery of features and releases.
* Identify delivery risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies and drive appropriate mitigation.
* Coordinate across development, testing, architecture, DevOps, infrastructure, and business teams.
* Ensure effective resource allocation and capacity planning.
* Monitor delivery metrics and provide regular status updates to management and stakeholders.
* Drive release planning and production deployment readiness.
* Ensure appropriate governance and delivery processes are followed.
* Scrum Master Responsibilities
* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including:

+ Daily Stand-ups
+ Sprint Planning
+ Backlog Refinement
+ Sprint Review/Demo
+ Sprint Retrospective

* Ensure the Scrum framework and Agile principles are effectively followed.
* Remove impediments and blockers affecting team productivity.
* Work with Product Owners to ensure the backlog is adequately prioritized and refined.
* Facilitate estimation and capacity planning.
* Monitor sprint progress and proactively identify potential delivery slippage.
* Promote self-organizing and cross-functional teams.
* Encourage continuous improvement through retrospectives and improvement actions.
* Coach teams on Agile/Scrum practices and ways of working.
* Protect the team from unnecessary external interruptions and scope changes.

**Metrics & Reporting**
Track and communicate relevant Agile and delivery metrics, including:
  
  

* Sprint velocity
* Sprint predictability
* Burndown/Burnup
* Release progress
* Defect trends
* Escaped defects
* Cycle time
* Lead time

2af21b79.description:
**Description**

Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.

This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.

221100

10044

Key job responsibilities

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
* Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.
* Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.
* Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.
* Establish reusable delivery mechanisms, best practices, and documentation standards that improve quality and efficiency across engagements, and mentor fellow engagement managers to raise the overall team capability.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.

**About The Team**

AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.

We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. Whether you are helping a customer adopt generative artificial intelligence or guiding a complex enterprise transformation, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in cloud technology and have the opportunity to shape how organizations innovate at scale.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **JOB DESCRIPTION –Engagement Manager Organic Growth (SEO & GEO)**

**Location:**

Bangalore - work on-site 3 days per week

**Reports To:**

Director -Engagements

**Role Overview**

The Engagement Manager – Organic Growth (SEO & GEO) will lead strategic organic growth engagements for enterprise clients, helping them maximize visibility, customer acquisition, and business outcomes across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms.

This individual will serve as the primary client-facing lead, partnering with clients and internal SEO, Content, Analytics, UX, Data Science, and Technology teams to develop and execute integrated search strategies. The role requires expertise in Enterprise SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Technical SEO, Content Strategy, Search Analytics, AI-driven search experiences, and digital business strategy.

The ideal candidate combines strong consulting and stakeholder management skills with deep search expertise and the ability to translate business challenges into scalable organic growth solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Client Leadership & Strategic Advisory**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients on SEO, GEO, search trends, AI-driven discovery, and evolving search ecosystems.
* Develop organic growth roadmaps aligned to client business objectives, customer acquisition goals, and revenue targets.
* Partner with senior client stakeholders to integrate organic growth strategies into broader digital marketing and business initiatives.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), strategic planning sessions, and executive-level client discussions.
* Build strong client relationships and become a trusted partner for search and organic growth strategy.

**Organic Growth Strategy (SEO & GEO)**

* Lead enterprise SEO and GEO strategies across:
* Technical SEO, Content Strategy & Optimization, Information Architecture, Authority Building, Entity Optimization, AI Search Visibility, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
* Develop strategies to improve visibility across: Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity
* Emerging AI-powered discovery platforms
* Identify growth opportunities through keyword, audience, competitive, market, and search behavior analysis.
* Drive forecasting, opportunity sizing, and business case development for organic growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with content, analytics, and data science teams to create AI-ready content and scalable search frameworks.

**Analytics & Problem Solving**

* Analyze organic traffic, rankings, conversions, engagement metrics, and business KPIs to identify growth opportunities.
* Translate complex business challenges into actionable SEO and GEO strategies.
* Utilize data from: GA4, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs Screaming Frog, Looker Studio, AI-powered search and content intelligence platforms.
* Conduct SEO/GEO audits and prioritize recommendations based on business impact and implementation effort.
* Present findings, recommendations, and growth opportunities to executive stakeholders.

**Program & Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end management of organic growth engagements from strategy through execution and measurement.
* Lead cross-functional teams comprising SEO specialists, content strategists, developers, UX teams, analytics resources, and data scientists.
* Drive implementation of recommendations and ensure timely delivery against agreed roadmaps.
* Monitor project health, identify risks, and proactively manage stakeholder expectations. Ensure delivery of measurable outcomes including traffic growth, AI search visibility, rankings, conversions, and revenue impact.
* Manage client escalations and drive resolution in partnership with delivery teams.

**Commercial & Account Management**

* Drive client satisfaction, retention, and long-term account health.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, upsell, and cross-sell of iQuanti capabilities.
* Support proposal development, solutioning discussions, and growth initiatives. Ensure scope, priorities, and client expectations remain aligned throughout the engagement.
* Partner with internal teams to maintain strong delivery quality and commercial performance.

**Team Leadership**

* Mentor and guide SEO specialists, analysts, and consultants.
* Foster a culture of analytical rigor, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Share best practices across teams and contribute to capability development.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development initiatives

**Who You Are**

* 8–12+ years of experience in SEO, Organic Growth, Digital Marketing Consulting, or related fields.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience managing enterprise SEO programs for large websites.
* Strong expertise in Technical SEO, Content Strategy & Optimization, Site Architecture, Keyword Research, Core Web Vitals, Indexation & Crawl Optimization, International SEO, and BFSI/E-commerce SEO.
* Experience managing client-facing SEO engagements and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills with expertise in GA4, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio.
* Proven experience driving measurable improvements in organic traffic, rankings, conversions, and revenue.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Experience leading cross-functional teams and mentoring junior team members.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-powered search ecosystems.
* Understanding of Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging AI search experiences.
* Experience leveraging AI tools for SEO analysis, content optimization, workflow automation, and insight generation.
* Familiarity with entity-based search, semantic search, and knowledge graph optimization.
* Experience working with enterprise clients in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail, Healthcare, or E-commerce sectors.
* Experience in consulting, digital agencies, or enterprise SEO environments

**Desired Qualifications:**

* MBA from a premier institute (preferred but not mandatory).

**Success Measures**

iQuanti is an independent performance marketing company that generates value for clients by utilizing data to drive better business outcomes through digital channels. f4ad4e74.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
f4ad4e74.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will own execution for large, cross-functional technical programs at Quince to help us scale and grow in existing geographies or launch new countries. You will work across product, engineering, business, and legal to align on scope, priorities, and dependencies. You will typically work with several engineering teams, product and business counterparts across the globe, and a commercial deadline.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will run several large, cross-functional programs at a time and be accountable for their delivery, on both timeline and impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end delivery, from scoping through launch and post-launch measurement.
* Work directly with engineering & product leads and architects on technical/business trade-offs.
* Drive alignment across US and India teams, including product and business leadership in Pacific time.
* Surface risks early and push for decisions when teams are stuck.
* Communicate status, risk, and asks to senior leadership in clear writing.
* Build the execution mechanisms this team needs as it scales.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 10-14 years of experience, with the last several as a TPM on product programs that shipped to customers.
* A bias for ownership. You take charge of ambiguous problems without waiting to be assigned, and you hold your ground with senior stakeholders when you believe the call is wrong.
* A record of owning launches end to end.
* Technical depth. An engineering background, or experience shaping architecture and design decisions.
* Experience running programs across time zones with US or headquarters stakeholders.
* Strong written communication with senior stakeholders.

****Good to have**
:**

* E-commerce, D2C, or marketplace experience
* Exposure to global expansion, localization, or regulatory programs

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We are hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to help customers across India turn complex data and AI priorities into measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical expertise, consultative discovery, and executive communication to shape secure, scalable solutions on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
  
  
**AS A SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**

* Lead technical discovery with customers and translate business priorities into architectures built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

* Partner with Account Executives, Product Management, Professional Services, and Snowflake partners to develop account strategies and remove technical barriers.
* Guide customer stakeholders on security, governance, privacy, and responsible AI patterns using Snowflake Horizon and related platform controls.
* Influence technical and executive decision makers through clear architecture narratives, workshops, demonstrations, and value-focused presentations.
* Mentor Solutions Engineering peers and contribute reusable field assets, reference architectures, and product feedback that improve execution across the region.

**OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in solutions engineering, data architecture, cloud platforms, analytics, or an equivalent customer-facing technical role.
* A strong foundation in data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, and enterprise security.
* Experience leading technical discovery and designing solutions for complex enterprise requirements.
* The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, business leaders, and executives.
* Hands-on proficiency with SQL and at least one major cloud platform as supporting capabilities for solution design and validation.
* A record of influencing customer decisions through consultative problem solving, demonstrations, and proofs of concept.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to lead across sales, product, services, partners, and customer teams without direct authority.
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:**

* Experience with Snowflake, Cortex AI, Snowpark, Streamlit in Snowflake, or native application development.
* Familiarity with GenAI architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, model governance, and AI-assisted solution engineering workflows.
* Experience supporting data platform modernization or migration programs in large enterprises.
* Knowledge of data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations relevant to customers in India.
* Experience mentoring technical presales professionals or leading cross-account technical initiatives.

How do you want to make your impact?

68c14de8.description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.
  
  
Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.

**Why Join Us?**
The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
  
  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment

**Location**
Bangalore or Mumbai, India (Field / Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience**
6 – 12 years
  
  
**Skills**

* HCM (Human Capital Management) solution consulting
* Functional pre-sales / solution consulting
* Discovery workshops and business requirements documentation
* Process mapping and process flow design
* RFP (Request for Proposal) response development
* Product demonstrations to enterprise prospects
* Value-based selling
* Solution design artefacts — context diagrams, functional/technical descriptions
* HR business processes and workforce management domain knowledge
* C-level stakeholder engagement
* Cross-industry enterprise solutioning

* HRBP (HR Business Partner) experience

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct discovery workshops with enterprise prospects to formulate and document business requirements, HR processes, procedures, and work practices.
* Design value-based HCM solutions to client problems and communicate them to customers, implementation partners, and internal stakeholders through process flows, context diagrams, and functional/technical descriptions.
* Lead RFP (Request for Proposal) responses and produce solution overviews that map customer business initiatives to the HCM solution.

* Develop solution expertise across multiple industries and present the HCM value proposition to enterprise customers in each vertical.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with key customer stakeholders, influencers, and decision-makers across the evaluation cycle.
* Produce competitive positioning content comparing the HCM platform against legacy ERP and competing SaaS HCM systems.
* Collaborate with the sales team to develop differentiated value propositions, themes, and customer messaging.

**Qualifications**

* 6–12 years of experience in HCM consulting or HRBP roles.
* Demonstrated experience in value-based selling within an HCM consulting environment.
* No HCM/HR certification required.

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

e4e79392.title: Solution Engineer, Manager
e4e79392.description:
**Overview**
***WELCOME TO SITA***
SITA is the leading specialist in air transport communications and information technology. We don’t just connect the global aviation industry, we apply decades of experience and expertise to address almost every core business, operational, baggage, and passenger process in air transport. As an organization, we cover 95% of all international air travel destinations and work with over 2,800 air transport and government customers in every corner of the globe. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of technology while embracing our collaborative, and inclusive culture.
  
  
**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role & Team**
As an Airport Solution Engineer, Manager, you will support the solution design by orchestrating the solution and technology choices within SITA Airport portfolio/product solutions used to meet the business requirements of SITA customers. This includes providing guidance/advise in the proposal implementation and deployment for any new or existing product developments as part of a customer solution.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide the technical qualification and own the technical parts of proposals submitted to customers through knowledge of SITA portfolio solutions and evolving technologies in ATI industry.
* Design / coordinate development of standard and complex solutions which may involve multiple parties both internally and externally including the selection of 3rd party vendor to meet customer requirements.
* Building business case that comprises of all the solution components that includes both software and infrastructure solution and pricing, and getting stakeholders’ concurrence on the same, and getting business approval.
* Handing over the solution to Delivery organization for the successful customer bid and supporting the delivery over a period to get the solution delivered as per the solution designed.
* Promote SITA by furnishing customers with comprehensive up-to-date information on current products product enhancements and new solutions through customer meetings and workshops. Facilitate designs to be efficiently implemented Right the First Time (RFT) and supported operationally.
* Support account team or competency centers during the pre-contract phases (qualification proposal and contract) with technical designs and advice.
* Participate in the development of technical account strategies with the sales team to ensure maximum account penetration and commercial benefits for SITA in the long term.

**Qualifications**
***EXPERIENCE:***

* Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering or Computer Technologies
* 10+ years of experience of experience in Information Technology Industry.
* 8+ years of experience in technical Pre-Sales or consulting (business and technical) role.
* 5+ years of experience in Airport Transport Industry technology.
* Well versed in Airport business solutions is mandatory, including Airport Passenger Processing Systems (such as Common-Use, Passenger Reconciliation, Passenger Flow Management, Self Service and Biometric Solution, DCS Integration, LDCS, etc.), Baggage Management Systems (such as Baggage Reconciliation, Bag Message, Lost & Found, etc.), and Airport Operation Systems (such as AODB, Fixed and Mobile Resource Management, ACDM, Airport Vision, Airport Voice, etc.).
* Familiar with Airport solution infrastructure, e.g., on-prem and cloud hosting, software stack, edge equipment, and airport common-use peripherals, etc.
* Having Airport certification (IATA/ICAO) is great plus.

**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Flex Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
  
  
⏰
**Flex Day:**
Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-Location:**
Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿
**Employee Wellbeing:**
We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀
**Professional Development:**
At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
**LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,**
and
**Airport Council International**
-available to all employees-to specialized solutions like
**Pluralsight**
for technology upskilling,
**Harvard Business Publishing**
for people leadership,
**Stanford**
for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
  
  
🙌
**Competitive Benefits:**
Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

Die Position
  
  
Job description
  
The Senior ERP Solution Consultant leads complex ERP product teams, shapes product strategy utilizing industry knowledge, and drives technical direction. In this strategic role, you will make high-impact decisions, solve complex cross-product issues, and expertly communicate with stakeholders at all levels. As a recognized leader and mentor, you will deliver significant impact across product lines, reporting at an enterprise level while applying deep ERP business process and analytical expertise to drive continuous value creation and organizational growth.
  
Description of the area
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads teams and squads (internal and external) and delivers on a diversity of products with significant complexity. Leads the development of approaches (e.g., Agile backlog management) and timelines across product teams/squads. Designs and documents solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards throughout the product life cycle. Researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies, while developing and maintaining the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for the product teams.
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently makes decisions with an impact at the process, organization, or product line level. Drives the successful completion of major programs within or across product lines as a lead. Responsible for leading collaborative team environments across products and product lines to solve unusually complex, ambiguous problems and provide highly innovative solutions.
* Stakeholder Management: Interacts with large/global teams across multiple product lines or chapter cluster squads. Takes a leading role in interacting directly and strategically with all stakeholders, including partnering with Senior Leaders. Communicates complex concepts and potential solutions across the enterprise or multiple portfolios and negotiates with others to adopt different points of view. Expertly tailors messaging to different target audiences and chooses appropriate communication channels.
* Impact/Strategy: Acts as a key contributor, thought leader, and go-to person for important stakeholders in specific areas. Provides consistent leadership and impact on a number of major products and at the product line level. Serves as a role model in teamwork, driving strong collaboration across products/product lines and between Informatics and the business. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, and mentors colleagues to help them develop their expertise and skills.
* Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates the ability to prioritize, plan, and report status at the enterprise or multi-product/product line level. Capable of acting as a Product Owner in large products. Contributes to talent acquisition and capability development (e.g., by screening CVs, interviewing candidates, and organizing trainings).
* Business / Technical ability: Applies a proficient level of ERP business process domain knowledge and architecture practices. Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in technical principles, theories, and concepts related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis, contributing to the development of new principles and concepts.

Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Demonstrated experience leading complex ERP product teams and driving the successful completion of major programs within or across product lines.
* Proven track record of acting as a Product Owner in large products and reporting status at an enterprise or multi-product level.
* Experience contributing to talent acquisition and capability development, including mentoring and training others.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Proficient level of ERP business process domain knowledge and architecture practices.
* Deep expertise in at least one Business Analysis / Consultancy capability.
* Expert-level knowledge in technical principles related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.
* Strong capability to design solutions, maintain product technology roadmaps, and drive the evaluation and adoption of new technologies.

Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging, negotiate, and influence Senior Leaders across multiple portfolios.
* Strong mentorship abilities and a proven track record as an identified role model for fostering collaboration between Informatics and business teams.

Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

29cbcea1.title: Consultant | D365 F&O - PMO | Mumbai | Emerging ERP Solutions
29cbcea1.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

  
  

As a Consultant within Deloitte's Enterprise Technology & Performance practice, you will support delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP transformation programs and D365 application support engagements by providing PMO, governance, reporting, project controls, and stakeholder coordination services across multiple workstreams.

  
  

The role requires strong coordination, reporting, governance, and project tracking capabilities. You will work closely with Program Managers, Project Managers, Functional Leads, Technical Leads, Client Stakeholders, Support Managers, and PMO leadership to ensure effective governance throughout the implementation, rollout, enhancement, and application support lifecycle.

  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  
  

Program Governance & PMO Support

  
  

* Support establishment and execution of project governance processes, standards, templates, and reporting mechanisms.

* Coordinate governance forums including project reviews, workstream reviews, operational reviews, and steering committee preparation.

* Maintain governance artefacts including RAID logs, decision logs, action trackers, and project documentation repositories.

* Support stage-gate reviews, project audits, quality reviews, and governance compliance activities.

* Ensure governance reporting deadlines and PMO standards are consistently met.

* Support PMO governance across implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support engagements.

  
  

Project Planning & Controls

  
  

* Support maintenance of integrated project schedules and milestone plans.

* Track project progress against approved plans and highlight schedule variances.

* Monitor key milestones and deliverables across business and technology workstreams.

* Support management of dependencies and critical path activities.

* Follow up with workstream leads on outstanding actions and deliverables.

* Support monitoring of project health indicators and governance KPIs.

  
  

D365 ERP Delivery Governance

  
  

* Support governance and tracking across D365 implementation workstreams including Finance, Supply Chain Management, Project Operations, Data Migration, Integrations, Technical, Testing, and Change Management.

* Track design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare activities against agreed plans.

* Monitor data migration readiness, integration milestones, and environment readiness activities.

* Track SIT and UAT progress, defect metrics, and readiness status.

* Support cutover planning by maintaining cutover trackers and readiness checkpoints.

* Assist with go-live readiness reviews and post-go-live stabilization reporting.

* Support transition activities from implementation to support and operations teams.

  
  

D365 ERP Support & Managed Services Governance

  
  

* Support PMO and governance activities for D365 ERP support, enhancement, application management, managed services, and operate engagements.

* Track incoming incidents, service requests, enhancement requests, defects, and support tickets against agreed service levels.

* Monitor SLA compliance, ticket aging, backlog trends, response times, resolution timelines, and support performance metrics.

* Prepare operational dashboards covering ticket volumes, backlog, SLA performance, and enhancement delivery status.

* Support governance reviews related to support operations, enhancement releases, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Coordinate with functional, technical, and support teams to ensure timely closure of incidents and service requests.

* Track release schedules, deployment activities, and enhancement delivery milestones.

* Support service transition activities following ERP go-live.

  
  

Reporting & Management Information

  
  

* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, executive packs, meeting minutes, and governance presentations.

* Consolidate reporting inputs from workstream leads and validate data quality.

* Track and report key performance indicators related to schedule, risks, issues, defects, dependencies, milestones, SLA compliance, and support operations.

* Support creation of management reporting using Excel, Power BI, and project management tools.

* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for client and internal leadership reviews.

  
  

Risk, Issue, Dependency & Change Control

  
  

* Maintain RAID registers and monitor mitigation and resolution actions.

* Support identification, tracking, and escalation of delivery risks and issues.

* Track cross-workstream dependencies and communicate potential impacts.

* Track change requests and support established change governance processes.

* Monitor overdue actions, unresolved risks, and critical dependencies and escalate through appropriate governance channels.

  
  

Financial & Resource Reporting

  
  

* Support budget tracking, effort tracking, forecast updates, and financial reporting.

* Prepare utilization and resource capacity reports.

* Support resource onboarding, offboarding, and resource tracking activities.

* Support vendor and implementation partner governance through reporting and action tracking.

* Provide reporting support for project and support engagement financial performance.

  
  

Stakeholder Management

  
  

* Coordinate activities between client teams, delivery teams, workstream leads, and project leadership.

* Ensure timely communication of key decisions, actions, risks, and governance updates.

* Support collaboration across business, functional, technical, testing, change management, and support teams.

* Support preparation of executive communications and steering committee materials.

* Build effective working relationships with client and internal stakeholders.

  
  

Continuous Improvement

  
  

* Contribute to PMO process improvements and standardization initiatives.

* Support project audits, compliance reviews, and lessons learned activities.

* Assist in development and enhancement of PMO templates, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.

* Support PMO maturity initiatives and knowledge management activities.

* Assist in onboarding and knowledge sharing for new PMO team members.

  
  

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

  
  

* 3-5 years of PMO, project controls, project coordination, governance, or transformation support experience.

* Experience supporting at least one end-to-end ERP implementation program.

* Experience supporting ERP implementation, application support, AMS, managed services, or operate engagements.

* Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP, SAP, Oracle, or similar enterprise applications preferred.

* Experience working in Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery environments.

  
  

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

  
  

* Project governance and reporting.

* RAID management and dependency tracking.

* Stakeholder coordination and communication.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Strong presentation and documentation capabilities.

* Understanding of project lifecycle and governance controls.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

  
  

**TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES**

* Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.

* Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Jira, or equivalent project management tools.

* Power BI reporting and dashboard exposure preferred.

  
  

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

* PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or equivalent certifications.

  
  

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Science, Commerce, CA, or related discipline.

* MBA preferred.

  
  

**SUCCESS METRICS**

  
  

* Timely and accurate governance reporting.

* Effective action, risk, issue, dependency, and decision tracking.

* Compliance with PMO standards and reporting requirements.

* Effective monitoring of project milestones and delivery governance.

* High-quality stakeholder communication and coordination.

* Successful support of D365 implementation, rollout, enhancement, and go-live activities.

* Effective tracking and reporting of SLA performance, ticket management, backlog trends, and enhancement delivery metrics.

* Positive feedback from client stakeholders and project leadership on PMO effectiveness.

65634824.title: M365 End User Computing Architect
65634824.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**
-----------------

The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and evolution of the organization's end user technology ecosystem. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for the Microsoft 365 platform and related productivity, collaboration, and security services — driving adoption, standardization, and innovation across the enterprise.

The EUC Architect partners closely with business stakeholders, IT operations teams, security, and enterprise architecture to ensure the end user environment is modern, resilient, and aligned with organizational objectives. This individual operates at both the strategic and hands-on technical level, owning architectural decisions from concept through implementation.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the end-to-end architectural vision and roadmap for the Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and the broader M365 suite
* Define and enforce tenant configuration standards, governance policies, and design patterns across all M365 workloads
* Lead architectural decisions for Microsoft Copilot adoption, including readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, and rollout strategy
* Design and maintain identity and access architecture in partnership with the IAM team, including Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and hybrid identity models
* Architect Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager solutions for device management, compliance policies, application delivery, and Autopilot provisioning
* Establish architecture for Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, eDiscovery, Compliance Manager) and advise on data governance posture
* Drive the strategy for Microsoft Viva, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), and low-code/no-code citizen development governance

**End User Computing Strategy**
-------------------------------

* Define the long-term EUC strategy spanning physical endpoints (Windows, macOS), virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365), and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) via Microsoft Intune
* Lead endpoint lifecycle architecture including OS imaging, patching strategy, hardware standards, and Windows 11 migration planning
* Architect solutions for remote and hybrid work scenarios, ensuring performance, security, and user experience parity regardless of location
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and communicate business value and architectural impact to leadership

**Governance & Standards**
--------------------------

* Develop and maintain EUC architecture standards, reference architectures, and design documentation
* Establish M365 governance frameworks including tenant policies, external sharing controls, Teams provisioning governance, and data residency requirements
* Define and socialize naming conventions, RBAC models, licensing optimization strategies, and change management processes
* Conduct architecture reviews for EUC-impacting projects and provide design authority sign-off

**Security & Compliance**
-------------------------

* Partner with the Information Security team to integrate Zero Trust principles throughout the EUC environment
* Architect solutions leveraging Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and the broader Microsoft Defender XDR suite
* Ensure EUC architecture aligns with regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, FINRA, GDPR) as applicable to the business

**Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on EUC and M365 capabilities, roadmap, and investment priorities
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, and application teams to ensure integrated, cohesive solutions
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to EUC engineers and administrators
* Represent EUC architecture in governance forums, architecture review boards, and vendor engagements
* Partner with Microsoft account teams and FastTrack resources to leverage available programs and stay ahead of platform changes

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in an architecture or senior engineering role focused on end user computing or Microsoft 365.
* Deep, hands-on expertise across the core Microsoft 365 workloads:

  + **Collaboration & Productivity:** Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Viva
  + **Identity & Access:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, MFA, Privileged Identity Management
  + **Device Management:** Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot
  + **Security:** Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365
  + **Compliance:** Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, eDiscovery
  + **Automation & Platform:** Power Platform, Microsoft Graph API
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M365 tenant architecture in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity models, Azure AD Connect, and cloud-only identity scenarios
* Experience with virtual desktop technologies (Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and their integration with M365 tooling (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, reference designs, and decision records

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* **Technical Depth:** Expert-level command of M365 platform capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns
* **Strategic Vision:** Ability to translate business requirements into a coherent, future-state EUC architecture
* **Communication:** Clear and compelling communicator to both technical and executive audiences
* **Problem Solving:** Structured thinker who can diagnose complex, cross-domain issues and drive resolution
* **Collaboration:** Builds trust across teams; effective in cross-functional and matrixed environments
* **Governance Mindset:** Proactively establishes guardrails and standards without creating unnecessary friction

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Microsoft certifications, including one or more of:

  + Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
  + Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
  + Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for M365 deployment planning and AI-readiness assessments
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and their application in enterprise EUC environments
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.)
* Background in enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman)

8748a6a7.description:

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

d1e8843d.title: Program Manager
d1e8843d.description:
Program Manager Job Description  
Oct 28, 2026 • @DIONCE AI  
About Dionce Technologies  
Dionce Technologies (DIOnce "Do It Once") is a Bangalore-based agentic AI start-up. We build autonomous AI agents that plan, decide and act across customer experience, knowledge management and business operations, carrying enterprise workflows through from start to finish rather than handing them back to a human queue.  
Our products include:  
AvaniCX an agentic AI customer experience platform combining cloud telephony, conversational AI and agentic automation. Its AI agents (Receptionist, Sales, Qualification, Booking, Hiring, Customer Support and Telemarketing) take a call, understand it and finish the job, with an agentic control layer for LLM selection, guardrails and audit trails, plus post-call analytics.  
  
We are a small, fast-moving team working with Technology leader, CX Transformation and operations leaders and growing businesses. Joining us means owning outcomes end to end, from the first customer conversation to a live deployment.  
About the role  
We are hiring a Program Manager with 4-8 years of experience to run the commercial and delivery engine of our AI products. You will drive pre-sales and sales enablement, open new business, and then own the delivery and coordination of the projects you help win.  
This is a start-up role with real breadth: one week you are shaping a proposal and demo for a contact-centre prospect, the next you are running a go-live with engineering and the customer's operations team. You will be the connective tissue between founders, sales, engineering, data science and customers.  
   
   
   
Role  
Program Manager  
   
Experience  
4-8 years  
   
Reports to  
Founder   
   
Location  
Remote  
   
Employment type  
Full-time  
   
Key responsibilities  
**Pre-sales and sales enablement**  
Lead discovery calls and solution workshops with prospects; map their customer-experience and operations workflows to AvaniCX and TrustWiz capabilities  
Build and deliver product demos and proofs of concept with engineering, tailored to the prospect's use case  
¢Own proposals, RFP/RFI responses, pricing inputs, effort estimates and statements of work  
¢Create and maintain sales collateral: pitch decks, case studies, battle cards, ROI calculators and demo scripts  
¢Train and enable sales partners and channel teams on product positioning and qualification  
**Business development**  
¢Identify and qualify new opportunities across contact centres, CX teams and growing businesses; build and manage a pipeline  
¢Develop partnerships with telephony providers, system integrators and resellers  
¢Represent Dionce at industry events, webinars and customer forums  
¢Feed market and competitor insights back into the product roadmap  
**Project delivery**  
¢Own end-to-end delivery of customer implementations from kick-off to go-live and hypercare: scope, plan, budget, timeline and quality  
¢Define delivery milestones, success criteria and acceptance plans with the customer  
¢Manage risks, dependencies and change requests; escalate early and resolve  
¢Run UAT, go-live and post-deployment reviews; track adoption and outcome metrics  
**Project coordination**  
¢Coordinate day-to-day across engineering, data science, QA and customer teams; run stand-ups, status reviews and steering meetings  
¢Maintain project plans, RAID logs and status reports for leadership and customers  
¢Manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritise shared engineering capacity  
¢Standardise delivery playbooks, templates and onboarding processes as the company scales  
Required qualifications  
¢4-8 years of experience in program or project management, pre-sales, solution consulting or delivery roles in a SaaS, AI or technology services company  
¢Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or business; MBA is a plus  
¢Proven pre-sales experience: discovery, demos, proposals, RFP responses and effort estimation for B2B software or AI solutions  
¢Track record of business development: building pipeline, closing or materially contributing to new deals, and managing partner relationships  
¢Delivered at least two end-to-end customer implementations, owning scope, schedule, budget and stakeholder management  
¢Working understanding of AI products: conversational AI, LLMs, agentic automation, cloud telephony or contact-centre technology, and the ability to explain them to business buyers  
¢Hands-on with project tools (Jira, Asana, MS Project or similar) and Agile/Scrum delivery  
¢Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfortable with C-level customers and engineers alike  
¢Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed  
Preferred qualifications  
¢Prior start-up experience in a role spanning sales, delivery and operations  
¢Domain exposure to digital transformation, IT/BPM, customer support or CX transformation  
¢Experience selling or delivering voice AI, chatbots, CCaaS or CRM-integrated solutions  
¢PMP, PRINCE2, CSM or SAFe certification  
¢Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integration concepts such as APIs and webhooks  
¢Experience with CRM and sales tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho)  
Skills and competencies  
Area  
What good looks like  
   
Pre-sales  
Runs crisp discovery, tells a convincing product story, and scopes solutions engineering can actually deliver  
   
Sales enablement  
Produces collateral and training that lets others sell without you in the room  
   
Business development  
Builds pipeline methodically, qualifies hard, and keeps partners engaged  
   
Delivery management  
Keeps implementations on time and on scope; surfaces risk before it becomes a fire  
   
Coordination

AI literacy

Commercial judgement  
Balances customer asks against margin, effort and roadmap  
   
Ownership  
Treats every deal and every delivery as yours from first call to renewal  
   
What we offer  
¢A front-row seat at an early-stage agentic AI company, with direct access to founders and customers  
¢Broad ownership across sales and delivery, and a clear path to leading a function as we grow

¢Learning budget for AI, sales and program-management certifications

Send your CV and a short note describing one deal you helped win and one project you delivered end to end, what went well and what you would do differently, to **hr@dionce.ai**

Application Security, Web Application Security, Mobile Application Security (Android & iOS), API Security, Cloud Security, Network Security, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT).

Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential.

15 years full time education

Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.

Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region

**What you have**
-----------------

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and support cloud-native platforms, Kubernetes environments, and containerized applications across the thinkorswim ecosystem.

* Deliver cloud modernization and developer enablement initiatives by improving platform capabilities, engineering workflows, and automation across the software delivery lifecycle.

* Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform, Ansible, and Python-based automation.

* Design, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance GitHub and GitHub Actions pipelines supporting build, test, security, compliance, and deployment workflows.

* Partner with Architecture, Security, SRE, CloudOps, and Application Development teams to resolve dependencies, align technical designs, and implement operational improvements.

* Troubleshoot complex issues across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, automation platforms, and production environments.

* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable platform services, operational best practices, and automation frameworks.

* Evaluate and implement emerging technologies in cloud engineering, AI-enabled development, developer productivity, and intelligent software delivery.

* Drive operational readiness and production support by resolving recurring issues, strengthening observability, and implementing reliability improvements.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of software engineering, cloud engineering, or DevOps experience.

* Strong hands-on experience with GCP and GKE; Kubernetes and Docker.

* Hands-on experience developing Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration-management solutions with Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Bash.

* Hands-on experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions supporting CI/CD, security, testing, and deployment automation.

* Hands-on DevOps support and SRE experience for large-scale, distributed enterprise Java applications across deployment, runtime operations, incident response, and reliability improvement.

* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, security, observability, and production operations.

* Experience working within Agile teams and collaborating across multiple engineering organizations.

* Practical experience with AI-enabled engineering, prompt engineering, LLM integrations, or MCP frameworks.

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer certification required.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
  

  

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

**Our base benefits, wellbeing, and total rewards include:**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

0b6d9dbb.title: Solution Architect, ISV, AGS-APJ-India-ISV-SA
0b6d9dbb.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
  
  
**About The Team**
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
  
  
**About AWS**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Job Title: Solution Architect – Application**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
EY is a global leader in Advisory, Assurance, Tax, and Transaction Services. In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the End User Technology Experience team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want.
  
  
The Solution Architect is a highly skilled senior role with industry leading architecture and design expertise to support one or more programs. He/she has a deep end to end understanding of architecture standards and platform solution
  
  
development expertise.
  
  
The End User Technology Experience requires a seasoned Solution Architect to provide technical guidance on Application development, Microsoft Platform solutions, and lead customer service applications. Candidate must be a self-starter with Agile framework experience and provide RISK/Technical architecture leadership.
  
  
**Essential Functions Of The Job**
**The Solution Architect:**

* Architect and Design platform solutions needed for a complex enterprise
* Manages the technical dependencies across the different products and services
* Provides guidance on complex production designs, applications or system problems.
* Solution design will include the creation of reusable, repeatable IP and artifacts
* Identify opportunities to innovate, extend and enhance O365/Azure services
* Own Root Cause Analysis and Problem Management for first of a kind solution implementation
* Lead Agile sprints in product owner capacity and mentor technical staff on newer design sprints
* Enforce adherence to architectural standards/principles, global product-specific guidelines, usability experience and design standards, etc.
* Identify, communicate and mitigate Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Decisions throughout the development lifecycle.
* Responsible for the solution planning, migration, architecture, development, and delivery; works with business stakeholders and technical teams to develop and implement solutions in agile environments, provides support for new SharePoint deployments and migrations from older platforms; builds Intranets, branding, enterprise applications and collaboration systems.
* Responsible to propose with a custom solutions & collaboration with business application owners, project managers, designers, engineers, and infrastructure teams to build a quality experience for users.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* History of working credibly with senior stakeholders
* Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications
* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Demonstrate excellent technical & architecture skills in the context of cloud-based platform/product design, service management and product lifecycle management
* Demonstrate ability to rapidly learn new and emerging technologies and developing a vision of their suitability
* Serves as the lead solution architect for customer service solutions
* Experience with Microsoft Teams and Dynamics 365
* Experience with ServiceNow, Azure IaaS and PaaS services
* Experience with Business Intelligence analytic tools
* Designed, validated, and implemented PowerApps and Power BI solutions
* Platform Expertise using Microsoft Graph, Power Apps, Flow and market place apps
* Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, BOT Framework, RPA and virtual agents
* Knowledge of python, AI stacks, CNN’s, RNN’s, AI Fluency, NLP, Digital Twins, Metaverse, Data preprocessing.
* Knowledge of UI/UX, branding, and document management, Custom solutions development, search and metadata configuration, business analysis, business process automation, and workflows. Microsoft PowerApps and Microsoft Flow, SharePoint Technologies (Windows SharePoint Services, SharePoint Server, InfoPath Forms
* Services, Forms, PowerShell scripts, Migration tools (Sharegate, DocAve, Cloudiway), Excel Services, Search,
* Business Data Catalog and Web Services), PowerApps, Flow, Power BI, Security & Compliance, Data Governance, Classic and Modern UI, PowerShell, PowerApps, Flow
* Knowledge of Intranets, public websites, applications, Proposal Management Systems, Project Management
* Information Systems, product or service sites, business development, process automation with forms and workflows.
* Knowledge of Classic and Modern UI, Power BI and SharePoint integration & so as building knowledge of automated process and workflows (using various tools & technologies).
* Knowledge of Agile Development, Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), System Development Life Cycle
* Methodology (SDLCM), Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF), Microsoft Solutions Framework (MSF)
* Build technical artifacts for Engineering and product owners
* Brings proven industry leading technical expertise of the product(s)
* Good understanding of the financial aspects of the product management
* 5-10 years’ experience in an Architecture role

**Other Requirements:**

* The role may require minimum travel, participate in workshops, coach/lead engineering teams and available in US/UK business hours

**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**

* Bachelor or Master degree in Information Technology or Business Management

**Experience:**

* Approximately 17 years of experience in a comparable executive leadership role.

**Certification Requirements:**

* TOGAF, O365, Azure Paas, IaaS or Analytics Certification

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
