222a828e.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Application Architect - Senior Manager**
**The opportunity**
The Application Architect (Senior Manager) is responsible for building the detailed solution(s) for Applications in Cloud Transformation context. This role works under the guidance of the Account/Engagement Partner and the Enterprise Architect. This role works 50% on new opportunities shaping in existing or new client context and has 50% involvement in Delivery.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work with the end client, engagement partners, and enterprise architects to understand client business requirements, priorities, and the business case of the Technology Transformation.
* Work with consulting teams to incorporate domain/sector specific solutions. Have an AI first approach in solutioning & Architecting.
* Build Application Architecture by choosing the right technologies and platforms, including Integration, API Management layers & AI infusion.
* Work with the Competencies and Practices to arrive at suitable project approach, provide estimates and inputs to staffing plan.
* Work with the Delivery Governance team to analyse project delivery risks and mitigations.
* Delivery involvement as the “Solution Architect” to bring to life the conceived solution. Build the architecture, and project implementation/development/delivery framework

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10-15 years of experience in Technology Consulting and System Integration projects
* 5+ years’ experience in Cloud Transformation projects – involving Cloud Application Architecture, Cloud Native Application principles
* Experience in working & managing global stakeholders.
* Should have driven significant business outcomes as a part of their role.
* Hands-on experience in driving Application migrations to cloud including a combination of Lift & Shit, Re-platform, Re-factor or Re-architecture
* Hands-on experience in building Cloud Native Applications, APIs; knowledge of Application and Integration design patterns.
* Experience in Application Architecture & Design for Microservices in Cloud platforms
* Expertise in at least one Cloud Hyperscaler (AWS or Azure preferred);
* Deep work experience in atleast one API platform (Apigee, Mulesoft, Boomi etc)
* TOGAF certification will be a plus
* Experience in any of these sectors will be a plus - TMT (Telco, Media, Technology), Public Sector, Energy & Utilities and Travel & Leisure

**What We Look For**

* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

1d75910d.title: Consulting Architect - Search
1d75910d.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

32ed0589.title: Senior AI Solution Architect
32ed0589.description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
We are seeking a Senior AI Solution Architect with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI (GenAI) to drive solution design, pre-sales engagements, and client delivery. The ideal candidate combines technical excellence with strong business acumen, enabling them to design innovative solutions, craft compelling sales collateral, and confidently engage with executive stakeholders. This role requires proven experience leading teams, shaping solution strategy, and responding to complex RFPs in enterprise environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Pre-Sales & Client Engagement
  
  

* Lead RFP/RFI responses with compelling technical and business narratives.
* Collaborate with sales teams to design and present solution proposals, demos, and workshops.
* Create sales collateral such as whitepapers, PoV decks, and solution blueprints tailored to industry needs.
* Engage with C-suite executives and business leaders to evangelize AI/GenAI solutions and shape client roadmaps.

Solution Architecture & Delivery
  
  

* Define end-to-end AI/GenAI architectures, including model selection, training pipelines, RAG, multi-agent systems, governance, and observability.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and compliant AI solutions.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure successful design-to-delivery handoff.
* Establish frameworks for AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Manage and mentor a team of solution architects, data scientists, and engineers.
* Drive knowledge sharing across practices through playbooks, reusable accelerators, and best practices.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (cloud, data, security, domain SMEs) to build integrated solutions.

**Key Skills:**

* 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, AI/ML, or data platforms, with at least 3–5 years in AI/GenAI initiatives.
* Demonstrated pre-sales experience: RFP responses, PoVs, workshops, and deal support. is a must
* Strong portfolio of sales/marketing assets (whitepapers, solution blueprints, reference architectures).
* Hands-on expertise with AI/GenAI stacks (e.g., LangChain /LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks).
* Understanding of AI governance and compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, Microsoft RAI Maturity Model).
* Proven team leadership experience, including mentoring and managing architects/engineers.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and client-facing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience in consulting, pre-sales, or solutioning for Fortune 500 clients.
* Exposure to industry verticals (finance, healthcare, retail, insurance, etc.).
* Familiarity with multi-agent architectures, advanced RAG, and LLMOps pipelines.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or AI/ML specializations.

Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidate Privacy Policy
  
  
Orion Systems Integrators, LLC And Its Subsidiaries And Its Affiliates (collectively, “Orion,” “we” Or “us”) Are Committed To Protecting Your Privacy. This Candidate Privacy Policy (orioninc.com) (“Notice”) Explains
  
  

* What information we collect during our application and recruitment process and why we collect it;
* How we handle that information; and
* How to access and update that information.

Your use of Orion services is governed by any applicable terms in this notice and our general Privacy Policy.

8772750c.title: Consulting Architect - Search
8772750c.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

bc4d9405.title: Solution Architect - Pharma R&D
bc4d9405.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**The Position**
**We are looking for a technically strong Solution Architect who is excited about building modern cloud and AI-enabled solutions for Pharma R&D.**
**You will work with senior architects, product teams, engineers, data scientists and business experts to design and deliver solutions that combine enterprise data and content, cloud technologies, Generative AI and emerging agentic capabilities.**
**This role is suited to someone with strong engineering and architecture foundations who can own architecture for defined solutions and grow into broader architecture responsibility over time.**
**The Opportunity**
**As a Solution Architect, you will:**

* Design end-to-end solution architectures for products, use cases and technical capabilities, working with senior architects on broader cross-product decisions
* Translate business and technical requirements into practical architectures across applications, APIs, integration, cloud, data, security and operational considerations
* Design and contribute to Generative AI and agentic solutions, including LLM applications, retrieval and grounding, agentic workflows, tool integration and human-in-the-loop patterns
* Apply strong cloud engineering principles across services, APIs, data stores, identity and access management, resilience and observability
* Define key non-functional requirements, interfaces, data flows and architecture decisions
* Contribute to evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, traceability and security for AI-enabled applications
* Participate actively in architecture reviews, prototypes, technical spikes and implementation discussions
* Help establish reusable architecture patterns and components across teams
* Collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, product teams and domain experts from solution discovery through deployment and production
* Identify technical risks early, communicate clearly and take ownership for helping teams resolve them

**Who You Are**
**You combine strong technical fundamentals with architectural thinking, curiosity and a desire to grow into broader technical leadership.**
**Required Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in enterprise software architecture, with at least 1+ years designing and deploying production-grade Generative AI / Agentic systems at scale
* Good practical understanding of cloud-native architecture, preferably AWS
* Practical experience building or integrating Generative AI / LLM-enabled applications
* Understanding of modern AI patterns such as RAG, vector/semantic search, agentic workflows, tool/function calling, prompt/context management and AI evaluation
* Strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns, distributed applications, data stores and security
* Familiarity with containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and observability
* Ability to consider reliability, scalability, performance, security and cost when making technical decisions
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical outcomes
* Demonstrated curiosity and ability to stay current with developments in Generative AI, agentic systems, cloud and modern software engineering

**Preferred Experience**
**Exposure to pharmaceutical, clinical, regulatory or other regulated environments, or experience with MLOps/LLMOps, enterprise retrieval/knowledge systems or Responsible AI would be beneficial.**
**Hands-on familiarity with GxP compliance, software validation, 21 CFR Part 11, and audit-trail implementations in pharmaceutical or healthcare software.**
**Technology Environment**
**Our landscape includes AWS, cloud-native services, Python, enterprise APIs, modern LLMs, agentic orchestration, retrieval and knowledge technologies, AI evaluation and observability, and modern DevSecOps.**
**Experience with the exact technologies we use is not required. We value strong technical fundamentals and the ability to learn and adapt as the technology landscape evolves.
  
  
Shift:**
CET time zone
  
  
#Hyderabad2026
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

39b20457.title: Network Architect /Cloud Architect
39b20457.description:
**Job Title: Network Architect**

**Location : Hyderabad-- Hybrid Role(2-Days onsite, 3- Days Remote**

**Shift Time : 11:00 PM to 8:00 PM**

**Job Description**

Insight Global is seeking a Network Architect, to support a large Software Development company out of Hyderabad, India. This will be a hybrid opportunity. This Network Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud-based network solutions. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and align the cloud network architecture to optimize performance, security, and scalability across Azure (primary), AWS, and private cloud environments.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in network architecture and design, with a strong focus on cloud environments.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation with Python or PowerShell, applying software engineering practices version control, code review, and testing — to network automation, with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Expert, in-depth knowledge of Azure (primary) and AWS cloud platforms.
* Expert-level cloud architecture knowledge, evidenced by Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert — or equivalent demonstrated experience designing enterprise cloud network solutions.
* Experience with networking protocols and technologies, and with network security practices and tools.
* Mastery of infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and Cloud Formation.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate, for specialized Azure networking depth (preferred).
* Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) or Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) (preferred).
* Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders; strong teamwork, collaboration, and problem-solving abilities; and a passion for mentoring others.
* Work flexibly as business priorities require, with availability for production-impacting incidents or key customer events affecting network services.
* Ability to deliver work meeting all minimum requirements of quality, security, and operability.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design and architect secure cloud network solutions across Azure (primary), AWS, and private cloud environments.
* Treat network infrastructure as software — build reusable, version-controlled IaC modules delivered through peer review, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop and enforce cloud network best practices, guidelines, and standards.
* Partner with other architects to define the technical strategy across the network and drive its execution with teams.
* Lead the use of automation to manage and maintain network infrastructure in public and private cloud environments, reducing manual toil across the estate.
* Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve.
* Monitor network performance and implement enhancements to optimize for speed, reliability, and cost efficiency across public and private cloud infrastructure.
* Ensure network security in alignment with industry-standard best practice — including firewalls, intrusion-prevention systems, and encryption — and regularly assess and remediate vulnerabilities and threats using automation.

* Define architecture standards, reusable patterns, security frameworks, ALM practices, development governance, and quality assurance processes.
* Architect and govern enterprise integrations using Dynamics 365 APIs, Dataverse APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, and REST services.
* Oversee data architecture, migration, modernization, release management, DevOps, environment strategy, and production support governance.
Act as the primary technical authority for stakeholders, driving architecture decisions, risk management, technical reviews, modernization initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 10–15 years of experience, including significant experience delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM/Customer Engagement solutions in Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Technical Lead, or Squad Lead capacities.
* Deep expertise in Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Platform architecture.
* Strong hands-on development experience with C#, .NET, Plugins, Custom APIs, JavaScript, TypeScript, Web Resources, and Dynamics 365 extensibility frameworks.
* Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using Dynamics 365 Web API, Dataverse APIs, REST APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, and Azure integration technologies.
* Strong expertise in Dynamics 365 security architecture, including Business Units, Security Roles, Teams, Hierarchy Security, Record Sharing, and Field-Level Security.
* Experience leading enterprise-scale data migration, transformation, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, and data modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, Power Platform Pipelines, Managed Solutions, Environment Management, Release Management, and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).
Proven leadership experience managing Agile delivery squads, conducting architecture reviews, mentoring technical teams, driving technical governance, and engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, Field Service, Omnichannel for Customer Service, Customer Service Workspace, or Contact Center solutions.
* Experience developing Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) controls, Power Pages solutions, and Microsoft Copilot Studio implementations.
* Strong knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience with enterprise migration and administration tools such as SSIS, KingswaySoft, XrmToolBox, Plugin Registration Tool, Ribbon Workbench, and Configuration Migration Tool.
Relevant Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure Solutions Architecture, or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert are highly desirable.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

2f43ce58.title: TechOps1-DE-CloudOpsAMS-SAP AMS SDM-Manager
2f43ce58.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP Team Manager - TechOps - Application Management - Consultant**
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an SAP Team Manager to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 8-10 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP functional areas preferably with Global client
* Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles
* Ability to manage cross functional and technical team, give them directions and drive functional and technical discussions with various stake holders
* Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi-platform environment
* Extensive in client management working with various regions in a global setting
* Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams
* Strong leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization
* Strong client management, analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions
* Responsible for providing support within the SAP domain expert module for incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
* Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
* Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onshore model.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* Experience with both S/4HANA and ECC
* Strong knowledge of SAP integration points with other SAP cross modules like FICO, MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
* SAP Certification in any functional domain
* Experience in good Team management skills, People skills, communication, soft skills etc
* Expertise in working with Onshore teams with good co-ordination and collaboration

**What you will do:**

* Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
* Lead and mentor the cross functional team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement
* Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP solutions and designs.
* Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
* Mentor and train junior SAP functional and technical Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of hundreds of professionals.
* Opportunities to work with EY SAP application maintenance, practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

**What working at EY offers:**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

0b64c660.title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2)
0b64c660.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational.
  
  
Through the proactive monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving of technical incidents and problems, the Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is able to restore service to clients.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity and focusses across two or more technology domains - Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.
  
  
This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyses issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and logs all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focussed on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Ability to work across various other resolver group (internal and external) like Service Provider, TAC, etc.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Provides Assistance to L1 Security Engineers for better initial triage or troubleshooting.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).
* Relevant certifications include (but not limited to) -

+ CCNP or equivalent certification
+ CCNA certification in must, CCNP in Security or PCNSE certification is good to have
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
+ AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Associate
+ Veeam Certified Engineer
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail
+ Google Cloud Platform (gcp)
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci)
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - OS DB Migration for SAP NetWeaver 7.4
+ SAP Technology Consultant
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA 2.0
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
+ IBM Certified System Administrator - WebSphere Application Server Network

**Required Experience:**

* Moderate level years of relevant managed services experience handling cross technology infrastructure.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.
* Moderate level working knowledge of ITIL processes.
* Moderate level experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

47be95ff.title: Program Manager – EdTech
47be95ff.description:
**About the job**

We are looking for a Program Manager to lead our K-12 Makerspace and Innovation programs from concept to classroom. You will guide a cross-functional team of developers, designers, and curriculum specialists to build engaging, hands-on learning experiences. You will also work directly with schools and educators to make sure the programs deliver real learning outcomes.

**Program & Team Leadership**

* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* Lead and coordinate the development team, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.
* Run regular reviews and report progress to leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* Lead and coordinate the engineering team of Full Stack, Frontend (FE), and Backend (BE) developers, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and keep FE, BE, and design work in sync.
* Manage releases, code review cycles, and QA handoffs with the engineering team.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.
* Report progress to leadership and stakeholders.

**Curriculum Design (K-12)**

* Design and oversee age-appropriate, project-based curriculum for Grades K-12 in areas such as robotics, electronics, coding, 3D printing, design thinking, and STEAM.
* Align curriculum with relevant frameworks (NEP 2020, NGSS, CBSE/ICSE, IB, or others, as applicable).
* Create lesson plans, project kits, assessment rubrics, and teacher guides.
* Review and update content regularly using classroom feedback and learning outcomes.
* **Lead the design function:** define design roles (UI/UX, learning material, and Makerspace/kit designers), set design standards, and manage design reviews and timelines.
* Work with designers to turn wireframes and prototypes into working features, keeping design and engineering aligned through handoffs in Figma and GitHub.
* Translate educational goals into clear user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria for Full Stack, FE, and BE developers.
* Oversee the development of learning platforms, dashboards, and digital tools, from prototype to launch.
* Own the product backlog and roadmap, balancing technical constraints, timelines, and classroom needs.

Customer Training & Enablement

* **Design the customer training framework** for schools, teachers, administrators, and students, including onboarding, certification, and ongoing professional development.
* Create training materials such as workshop decks, teacher guides, video tutorials, hands-on kit guides, quick-start manuals, and FAQs.
* Plan and deliver training in multiple formats: in-person workshops, virtual sessions, and self-paced modules.
* **Build and manage a trainer team** (internal trainers, master trainers, or partners), including training-the-trainer programs and quality standards.
* Schedule and coordinate training across schools, managing logistics, timelines, and resources.
* Track training effectiveness through attendance, feedback scores, teacher confidence, adoption rates, and student outcomes.
* Continuously improve training content using classroom observations and customer feedback.
* Set up support channels (helpdesk, community, office hours) to keep customers successful after training.

**Product & Design Collaboration**

* Work with designers on learning materials, digital platforms, and Makerspace layouts.
* Translate educational goals into clear requirements for the development team.
* Oversee the development of learning tools, platforms, or kits, from prototype to launch.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the main contact for schools, administrators, and educators.
* Conduct product demos, pilot programs, and workshops.
* Gather feedback from teachers and students and turn it into program improvements.
* Support Makerspace setup, teacher onboarding, and ongoing training.

Program & Team Leadership

* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* **Design and build the program team:** define roles and team structure across Full Stack, Frontend, Backend, design, and curriculum, and plan capacity as programs grow.
* **Lead hiring and onboarding** for developers, designers, curriculum designers, and trainers, working with HR and leadership.
* Lead and coordinate the engineering team, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Run agile ceremonies and keep FE, BE, and design work in sync.
* Set team goals and KPIs, conduct regular performance check-ins, and mentor team members.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.

Required Qualifications

* **Master's degree** (M.Tech, MBA, or equivalent) with a **B.Tech / B.E.** in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **12+ years of experience** in program or project management, ideally in EdTech, STEM education, or innovation programs, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven experience leading and scaling cross-functional teams of Full Stack, Frontend, and Backend developers and designers.
* Experience building and managing teams, including hiring, onboarding, and performance management.
* Working understanding of the software development lifecycle, web application architecture, APIs, and databases, with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience designing K-12 curriculum, especially for Makerspace, STEM/STEAM, or innovation labs.
* Experience designing and delivering training programs for teachers, educators, or enterprise customers.
* Strong understanding of project-based learning and design thinking.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience delivering product demos, client sessions, and leadership presentations.
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (Jira, Asana, Trello, Figma, GitHub, or similar).

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

b191299e.title: Technical Delivery Manager - WebOps - Core Maintenance
b191299e.description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
****Position Responsibilities****

* Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Team Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth.

958d2a59.title: Service Delivery Manager
958d2a59.description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**
**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**
**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
**Job Title:**
**Service Delivery Manager**
**Location: ETAP-Delhi**
**Employment Type:**
[ull-time
  
  
**The job**
We are looking for a Service Delivery Manager with deep expertise in utility operations, responsible for end-to-end delivery of RDSS/ADMS projects.
  
  
This role provides sole accountability for project delivery, technical compliance, and client/vendor interface. The Service Delivery Manager will coordinate with the Engineering Manager and engineering teams but remain the single point of ownership for delivery quality, schedule adherence, and technical compliance.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical knowledge of power distribution, grid automation, and SCADA/ADMS systems with strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery & Compliance**

* Full ownership of end-to-end delivery for RDSS/ADMS projects in utility/grid environments.
* Ensure strict adherence to:

+ Client-specific technical specifications
+ Distribution system automation standards and grid codes
+ Engineering drawings, SLDs, protection schemes, and compliance documents
+ Contractual obligations and quality standards

* Review and validate engineering deliverables including:

+ SCADA/ADMS system architecture, configurations, and network diagrams
+ ETAP / power flow / short-circuit / protection coordination studies
+ Communication network designs, telemetry integration, and automation logic
+ Technical reports, FAT/SAT documentation, and compliance certificates

* Identify risks, deviations, or non-compliances and drive corrective/preventive actions.

**Client & Vendor Interface**

* Act as primary client and vendor-facing technical lead for project delivery.
* Lead technical review meetings, progress discussions, compliance audits, and design clarifications.
* Manage client escalations, change requests, and technical queries efficiently.
* Represent the organization in FAT/SAT, compliance audits, and project acceptance reviews.

**Engineering Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with the Engineering Manager and internal teams to ensure:

+ Engineering execution aligns with project schedules, compliance, and quality standards
+ Clear technical expectations are communicated and delivered by engineering teams

* Track engineering progress against milestones and ensure timely availability of all deliverables.

**Project Planning, Reporting & Governance**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, and milestone trackers.
* Monitor project health across scope, schedule, quality, and risk dimensions.
* Prepare and present structured project status reports to clients and senior internal management.
* Maintain complete technical documentation, including:

+ Compliance matrices
+ Risk and issue registers
+ Meeting minutes and action trackers
+ Final handover documentation

Ensure adherence to internal delivery frameworks, quality systems, and audit requirements.
  
  
**Essential Requirements**

* Strong domain knowledge in utility/grid operations, distribution automation, RDSS, ADMS, SCADA, and smart grid technologies.
* Hands-on experience with ETAP, power system studies, protection coordination, and distribution network modeling.
* Ability to interpret and validate:

+ Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
+ Protection schemes and relay coordination
+ Telemetry and SCADA/ADMS configurations
+ Compliance with grid codes and utility standards

* Familiarity with power system automation, smart grid communication networks, and data analytics integration.

Proficiency in project management tools (MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet) and reporting tools
  
  
**Desired Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical / Power / Automation / Instrumentation Engineering. Master’s degree preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in utility or grid operations projects, with focus on RDSS/ADMS or SCADA/Automation projects.
* Proven track record as single-point delivery owner for technically complex, client-facing projects.

*I*

**Delivery Manager**

Projects are promised to clients before anyone has checked capacity, and delivery teams find out the commitment late. Projects are product rollouts for schools and colleges, with hard deadlines around the academic calendar.

A sixty-person ed-tech company selling to schools and colleges, hiring for its delivery office. The team is small enough that everyone knows what everyone else is working on. The company has partnered with Flexiple, a managed marketplace that helps global companies build strong teams in India. The role is remote, open across India.

The manager owns delivery of client commitments, balancing scope, people and timelines across several active projects. You would be running several client projects at once, keeping teams on plan and clients informed. The brief is wider than the title suggests, and the first few weeks are about learning how things currently work before changing them.

What we are looking for:

* 7 to 12 years in delivery or programme management
* Experience delivering client projects and leading project managers
* Strong planning, estimation and stakeholder skills
* Comfort with project tools and delivery reporting
* Calm handling of escalations

Screening call, case exercise, two conversations with leadership, final fit chat. One application is enough; it is also considered for similar roles we are hiring for.

ASP is seeking a **Senior Project Manager** based on-site at the Bangalore India Development Center (IDC) to lead software releases and medical device product development from planning through commercial release and lifecycle management. This role coordinates global, cross-functional teams and ensures products and releases meet business, customer, quality, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements.

**Location:** On-site, Bangalore IDC, India

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Software and medical device releases are planned and delivered predictably, with clear scope, ownership, readiness criteria, and decision points.
* Products are developed and released in compliance with applicable design controls, quality system procedures, risk management processes, and regulatory requirements.
* Risks, dependencies, defects, and resource constraints are identified early and actively managed.
* Local and global teams remain aligned through clear communication, effective governance, and shared accountability.

Facilitate documented go/no-go decisions with accountable stakeholders.

* **Provide Clear Governance and Communication:** Deliver concise, decision-ready updates on program and release health, readiness, risks, dependencies, and required actions to working teams and senior leaders.
* **Use Data and FBS Tools:** Use Jira, Confluence, dashboards, KPIs, Visual Project Management, risk management, and Kaizen or comparable tools to improve transparency and performance.

6f9e5518.title: Technical Program Manager - Engineering
6f9e5518.description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara is building the future of tax compliance infrastructure, operating at a massive scale that processes billions of transactions for hundreds of thousands of customers globally. As a Technical Program Manager in Engineering, you will bring disciplined, data-informed, and AI-enabled program leadership to our most critical initiatives.
  
  
You’ll act as a force multiplier for engineering velocity, connecting strategy to execution across our global teams spanning Product, Architecture, Platform Engineering, Security, and Cloud Operations. This role is essential to our ability to ship at scale with predictability and visibility, as you will build the analytical infrastructure that makes delivery reliable and communicate complex technical realities with the clarity needed for confident leadership decisions.
  
  
You will join the Engineering Operations team, reporting to the
**Sr Director, Technical Program Management**
. This role is
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Drive end-to-end planning, execution, dependency mapping, and delivery of mission-critical, multi-team engineering programs.
* Proactively surface hidden technical assumptions, resolve complex inter-service dependencies, and evaluate architectural trade-offs to sustain delivery predictability and unblock teams before risks become incidents.
* Own milestone governance and escalation frameworks that keep programs aligned across global time zones and competing priorities.
* Design and optimize Jira ecosystems (filters, JQL, Advanced Roadmaps, boards) to enforce rigorous SDLC hygiene and provide clear operational visibility.
* Prototype and build custom, interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Python, Streamlit, or low-code platforms, leveraging AI-assisted development to accelerate the creation of reporting infrastructure.
* Synthesize multi-layered technical complexity into crisp, executive-ready narratives and roadmaps for VP and C-level audiences.
* Champion the adoption of cutting-edge AI developer tools, intelligent agents, and LLM-assisted workflows to structurally improve planning, analysis, and execution velocity.
* Raise the bar for execution quality by identifying meaningful AI opportunities tied to delivery efficiency, and ensuring AI is applied responsibly, securely, and ethically.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 8 to 12+ years of Technical Program Management experience in fast-paced, product-based cloud or SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated track record of managing multi-team organizational initiatives across global time zones, with strong experience aligning US and India stakeholders.
* Deep fluency with Jira and Agile/Flow metrics, including expert-level ability to design JQL queries, CFD/Kanban workflows, and delivery KPIs.
* Hands-on experience prototyping and building dashboards, scripts, and data tools using Python, Streamlit, JavaScript, or low-code frameworks.
* Familiarity with modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitLab Copilot) for personal productivity, automated workflow generation, and applied AI problem-solving.
* Exceptional executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence senior leadership through clear, structured, and visually compelling communication.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, understand API design, and reason about scaling constraints in distributed SaaS systems.
* High standards of quality, ownership, and accountability, with a demonstrated ability to simplify complexity, drive measurable outcomes, and elevate the performance and AI capability of the teams around you.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
