This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls

* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

3f2c99a7.title: Cloud Engineering Specialist

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
As a Cloud Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, deploy, and maintain cloud-based solutions primarily on the Microsoft Azure platform. The ideal candidate will also have a solid understanding of ETL processes and technologies, as well as experience with a variety of data sources. You will work closely with our clients, development teams, infrastructure teams, data & analytics team, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation and operation of cloud services. Your role will involve designing and implementing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures, as well as troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise.
  
  
Additionally, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution.
  
  
**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to**
:
  
  

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)
* Identify & map source data in various commercial and custom systems
* Design, develop, test and maintain ETL pipelines
* Extract, transform, and load data from a variety of data sources

* Adapt to various industries and quickly learn the client’s context, language, and jargon to clearly document and translate business requirements to development plans
* Maintain a professional presence and be ready to interact with the client at all times
* Azure Solution Design: Collaborate with development teams and architects to design cloud-based solutions on the Azure platform. Evaluate requirements, propose design options, and recommend best practices for scalability, performance, security, and cost optimization.
* Azure Networking: Designing, implementing, and maintaining network infrastructure solutions based on Azure services i.e Configuring and managing virtual networks, subnets, routing tables, network security groups, and load balancers within the Azure environment, Configuring the IP-Sec VPN tunnels and troubleshooting network-related issues and providing timely resolution to minimize downtime.
* Azure Infrastructure Deployment: Deploy and configure Azure infrastructure components, such as virtual machines, storage accounts, virtual networks, load balancers and other azure services. Implement automation and infrastructure-as-code (IaaC) practices using tools like Terraform, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
* Azure Service Provisioning: Provision and manage Azure services, including but not limited to Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure SQL Database, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Active Directory (AAD).
* Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Set up monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the health and performance of Azure resources. Investigate and resolve issues related to application availability, performance, and security. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Security and Compliance: Implement and enforce security measures to protect Azure resources and data. Follow industry best practices and compliance standards. Conduct security assessments and vulnerability scans and implement necessary remediation actions.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery: Design and implement backup and disaster recovery strategies for Azure-based applications and data. Configure and manage Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and other relevant services.
* Collaboration and Documentation: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and support project delivery. Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, and deployment guides.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest Azure features, services, and industry trends. Continuously explore and propose new solutions, tools, and methodologies to optimize cloud infrastructure, enhance security, and streamline operations.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Strong experience in designing, implementing, and managing cloud solutions on the Azure platform (AWS and GCP is a plus)
* Previous consulting experience or experience working with external clients
* Strong understanding of ETL processes and technologies
* Experience with a variety of data sources, including relational databases, flat files, and web APIs
* Experience with Python, Java, or another programming language
* Experience with data warehouse technologies, such as Azure, AWS, and Snowflake
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
* Strong communication and teamwork skills
* Solid understanding of software development life cycle models as well as expert knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment
* Technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in enterprise solutions for different industries
* High-level knowledge of BI architecture or data warehousing
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Effectively managing multiple deliverables, clients and projects in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency in Azure services, including compute, storage, networking, and identity and access management (IAM).
* Proven experience in designing and implementing network infrastructure solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Strong knowledge of Azure networking services, including virtual networks, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, and Azure Load Balancer.
* Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards related to cloud environments.
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture patterns, scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaaC) tools like ARM templates, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in Azure cloud environments ((AWS and GCP is a plus).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with teams and stakeholders.

**Key Stakeholders This Role Interacts With:**
**Internal**

* Senior BI Analyst
* Data Product Manager
* BI Architect / Senior Architect
* Data Engineers
* Analytics Developers (Power BI, Tableau)

**External**

* Clients Operations Leads and Mid-Level Managers
* Data Owners, Data Stewards
* Enterprise Information Management and Data Governance Team
* IT Staff – Architects, DBAs, Developers, etc

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. b95d412e.title: Program Manager
b95d412e.description:
**Role: Program Manager, KickStart Girls, Mann Deshi Foundation**

**About Mann Deshi Foundation and KickStart Girls:**

Mann Deshi Foundation is a non-profit organisation working to empower rural communities through initiatives focused on financial inclusion, entrepreneurship & livelihood development. KickStart Girls, an initiative of Mann Deshi Foundation, focuses on empowering adolescent girls and young women through financial and digital literacy, employability and life skills, leadership development, and opportunities for self-expression, civic and community participation. Its programmes operate across four districts of rural Maharashtra, enabling girls and young people to build the knowledge, skills, confidence, and opportunities needed to shape their futures.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

1. Programme Planning, Implementation & Monitoring
2. Team Management & Capacity Building
3. Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning & Impact Reporting
4. Funder Relations, Partnerships & External Engagement
5. Communications, Documentation & Programme Visibility
6. Programme Events & Special Initiatives
7. Leadership Coordination & Internal Systems

**Compensation**

will be based on relevant experience.

**As an all-women team, this position is open exclusively to women. We work with colleagues and stakeholders from diverse age groups, genders, castes, religious communities, economic circumstances, educational backgrounds, and social contexts. We are looking for someone who values this diversity and can work collaboratively and sensitively with people from different walks of life.**

To read the full
**Job Description**
, click here - https://shorturl.at/5zjPO

For more details, email me at
**anagha@manndeshi.org.in**

101df267.title: Delivery Manager - .NET/Java
101df267.description:
We are seeking an accomplished **Delivery Manager with expertise in .NET/Java** to lead end-to-end project delivery, ensuring collaboration across teams, client satisfaction, and business success.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee end-to-end delivery across multiple teams to ensure client requirements and quality standards are met
* Track project milestones, deadlines, and deliverables, resolving any deviations
* Understand the technical and business aspects of the solutions being delivered
* Identify, track, and manage inter-team and external dependencies
* Escalate critical risks and issues to stakeholders with clear impact analysis and recommendations
* Provide regular updates, progress reports and risk assessments to clients and stakeholders
* Manage client expectations, gather feedback and ensure high client satisfaction
* Define and monitor software development processes for Scrum teams
* Act as a liaison between clients and teams for daily or weekly status updates, risks and issues
* Lead multiple cross-functional Scrum teams across Product, Design, Development and Sprint Demos
* Create and manage project plans with an understanding of SDLC phases
* Drive Agile estimation techniques and Agile Metrics implementation
* Execute projects from backlog identification to production deployment

**Requirements**

* 13 to 15 years of overall professional experience
* 10+ years of work experience in delivery management
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar; a Master's degree in Computer Science is preferred

* Successful experience in managing mid-sized to large projects and Agile transformations

* Flexibility to oversee cross-functional teams and program dependencies effectively
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies with competency in facilitation, conflict resolution and continuous improvement
* Capability to measure Agile metrics and drive transparency within Scrum teams
* Background in Financial Services or Wealth Management is preferred

5fee6ae8.title: Delivery Manager - GCP Cloud
5fee6ae8.description:
We're looking for a seasoned **Delivery Manager – GCP Cloud** who can spearhead extensive cloud transformation, migration, and modernization initiatives, overseeing complete delivery cycles through cross-functional teams, managing key stakeholder relationships, and delivering strong business results.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Take full ownership of programme delivery spanning discovery, assessment, landing-zone readiness, wave planning, migration execution, cutover, warranty, and transition to operations, holding overall accountability for Project/People/Account Management
* Direct multiple cross-functional and distributed teams, handling scope, schedules, budgets, staffing, dependencies, risks, issues, and executive governance, while staying mindful of Data Privacy, Security, IP & Responsible AI activities
* Assess solution architectures and migration strategies, confirming application dependency maps, migration waves, security, resilience, performance, operability, and cost assumptions
* Lead migration readiness and technical governance forums such as ARB, WAR, etc., driving Go/No-Go decisions and coordinating cutover, rollback, business validation, warranty, and service acceptance
* Collaborate with client business, security, infrastructure, application, data, and operations leaders to convert technical constraints into clear business impacts and decisions
* Set up delivery metrics covering migration throughput, schedule variance, defect leakage, cutover success, availability, performance, cloud spend, and benefits realization
* Champion adoption of cloud governance and FinOps practices, encompassing policy, tagging, cost allocation, budget controls, rightsizing, and optimization backlogs
* Contribute to presales, estimates, solution shaping, delivery assurance, account growth, and capability development, while mentoring delivery managers and technical leads
* Apply approved enterprise GenAI tools responsibly to enhance planning, reporting, risk analysis, knowledge management, and stakeholder communication while safeguarding data and intellectual property

**Requirements**

* Between 9 and 17 years of IT delivery experience, with at least 5 years leading substantial cloud transformation, application modernization, infrastructure, or migration programmes, plus experience overseeing multiple workstreams, senior stakeholders, and program execution through Agile & Hybrid methodologies
* Understanding of GCP resource hierarchy (organizations, folders, projects), IAM, VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, Cloud KMS, and backup/DR concepts
* Awareness of migration strategy patterns such as rehost, replatform, and refactor
* Capability to oversee identity, network segmentation, key management, logging, vulnerability remediation, backup/DR, business continuity, and regulatory requirements
* Proficiency in RAID management, financial governance, change control, and executive reporting
* Practical knowledge of project tracking systems (Jira/Confluence/ADO/Project) and application of Gen AI tools for Delivery Management
* Grasp of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), containers/Kubernetes (GKE), APIs, integration patterns, and SRE/observability fundamentals
* Skill in facilitating architecture reviews and communicating technical trade-offs, costs, risks, and migration decisions to both business and engineering audiences

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on exposure to Google Cloud Architecture Framework, Cloud Foundation Toolkit, and foundation/landing-zone build-outs, coupled with familiarity in Google's structured migration methodologies
* Holding a recognized Google Cloud credential such as Digital Leader or Professional Cloud Architect, or a comparable industry-accepted certification
* Possession of programme-management credentials like PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, ITIL, or similar recognized qualifications

21da01e6.title: Senior IT Delivery Manager - Life Sciences/Pharmaceuticals

**Responsibilities**

* Ensure compliance with project governance frameworks, SDLC/Agile methodologies, and regulatory requirements such as GxP

d00309b7.title: Delivery Management Leader – AI productivity solutions
d00309b7.description:
We are seeking a **Delivery Management Leader** for AI productivity solutions to drive the successful delivery of high-impact AI programs across diverse industries.

This role requires a strong background in application development (Java/.Net), expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), and the ability to lead large cross-functional teams in delivering scalable, efficient AI solutions that accelerate time-to-market and business value.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for client engagements, including strategic planning, implementation, governance and post-implementation support
* Ensure delivery metrics such as scope, schedule adherence, quality, budget compliance and operational KPIs are consistently met across all engagements
* Manage multi-project portfolios and large cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration across engineering, quality assurance, business analysis, architecture and DevOps
* Own the program governance model, engaging stakeholders at all delivery levels and maintaining alignment on key deliverables, risks and financial health
* Take full accountability for client portfolio financials, including revenue recognition, profitability, margin improvement, budget forecasting and corrective action planning
* Identify and drive cost optimization and OPEX reduction through automation, resource optimization and enhanced delivery models
* Monitor resource utilization, productivity metrics and workforce optimization strategies to align resources with program outcomes
* Serve as the primary client liaison for senior-level relationships, translating business challenges into actionable delivery strategies and maintaining alignment with client objectives
* Conduct Steering Committee sessions and executive-level communications to provide delivery updates, propose innovations and manage escalations
* Build, lead and mentor large distributed teams, cultivating high performance and driving talent development through mentoring and coaching
* Mediate resource conflicts, resolve escalations and ensure delivery deadlines are met, planning for contingencies with robust mitigation actions
* Identify, assess and mitigate program risks to ensure delivery schedules and client KPIs are not impacted, ensuring continuity of services during high-pressure situations
* Identify up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, develop strategies for expanding the organization’s footprint and partner with sales and pre-sales teams on RFPs, SOWs and business proposals
* Drive continuous innovation for client projects through automation, process enhancements and adoption of emerging technologies, promoting best practices in cloud-native applications, data platforms, AI/ML and DevOps pipelines
* Lead end-to-end AI program delivery, including execution of Agentic AI and AI productivity solutions, management of delivery roadmaps, implementation of AI accelerators, and establishment of KPIs to track and improve delivery efficiency

**Requirements**

* 13 to 15 years of IT experience, with 8+ years in delivery leadership roles and 3+ years in AI/ML projects
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise AI programs, including LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI and automation use cases
* Deep understanding of cloud-native AI services on AWS or Azure
* Expertise in large-scale enterprise programs across industries such as BFSI, Telecom, Healthcare, Retail or Life Sciences
* Strong ability to influence and manage senior-level client stakeholders, including Directors, VPs and CXOs, while building trusted relationships
* Pragmatic leadership approach to resolve escalations, handle conflicts within delivery teams and overcome program challenges effectively
* Familiarity with modern engineering technologies and delivery methods, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices and DevOps, data analytics platforms (Tableau, Power BI, BigQuery) and automation frameworks like RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism)
* Understanding of ITIL/ITSM frameworks and SLA-driven managed services delivery
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies (Scrum, SAFe) and traditional Waterfall-based delivery
* Exceptional leadership, negotiation and decision-making skills for managing high-pressure situations and improving delivery performance
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and deliver results under challenging timelines
* Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal abilities for fostering team and client collaboration

**Responsibilities**

4fa77a7a.title: Director, Solutions Builder (Builder Portfolio Leader)
4fa77a7a.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**The Experience**

  

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.

  

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

  

The Builder Leadership Experience

* Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale.
* AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.
Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.  

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.
* Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.
* Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.
* Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.
* Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.
* Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.  

  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.
* You Have Proven Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.
* You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.
* You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.
* You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

**Even Better If...**

* Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

The role aims to ensure smooth coordination and effective execution of AI initiatives within the organization.

* Facilitate transparent communication channels and regular status reporting between internal teams and external stakeholders
* Drive engagement and alignment with senior leaders on AI initiatives

* Track progress and report on key performance indicators related to AI practice operations
* Support the integration of AI knowledge into practice workflows and deliverables
* Identify and resolve operational challenges to ensure smooth practice functioning
* Define scope, objectives, and success criteria for initiatives during initiation and planning phases
* Oversee ongoing AI initiatives to ensure adherence to service level agreements and contractual obligations
* Evaluate and mitigate risks impacting program outcomes and stakeholder expectations
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating feedback, optimizing operational workflows, and maintaining dashboards and reports

**Requirements**

* Knowledge of artificial intelligence concepts, technologies, and AI tools at a foundational level
* Proven capability to coordinate cross-functional teams, manage complex workflows, and drive alignment and consensus among diverse stakeholders

LotusFlare is a provider of cloud-native SaaS products based in the heart of Silicon Valley. Founded by the team that helped Facebook reach over one billion users, LotusFlare was founded to make affordable mobile communications available to everyone on Earth.
  
  
Today, LotusFlare focuses on designing, building, and continuously evolving a digital commerce and monetization platform that delivers valuable outcomes for enterprises. Our platform, Digital Network Operator® (DNO™) Cloud, is licensed to telecommunications services providers and supports millions of customers globally.
  
  
LotusFlare has also designed and built the leading eSIM travel product - Nomad. Nomad provides global travelers with high-speed, affordable data connectivity in over 190 countries. Nomad is available as an iOS or Android app or via getnomad.app.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for all technical aspects of integrating and launching our offering, LotusFlare DNO Cloud with a customer from kickoff to go-live. You will have ownership of the technical relationship with customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, operational efficiency and best-practice architectures. Within LotusFlare, you are the advocate for your customers to ensure the successful progression of their project and advancement improvements to LotusFlare DNO Cloud, informing the roadmap of LotusFlare DNO Cloud capabilities and functions.
  
  
In your role, you ensure project goals are met and customer expectations are fulfilled. You will utilize your solid understanding of project management fundamentals and must be comfortable communicating with senior leadership (with customers and LotusFlare) verbally and in writing. Given your understanding of technology and project goals, you will connect technology to tangible project results in order to deliver valuable business outcomes to LotusFlare DNO Cloud customers.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 5+ experience in Project Management, Technical Program Management, or similar technical leadership role
* 3-5 years of experience with software development lifecycle from conception to delivery as a software engineer or a solution architect
* 5+ years of experience working in the telecommunications industry
* You are a digital-savvy individual who knows the latest digital technologies and trends; you enjoy experimenting and are open to integrating new digital technologies into everyday work.
* Proficient in API design, client-server interaction design, and cloud infrastructure architecture
* Telecommunication architecture experience; across IT and Core (OCS/PS/CS) domains to manage and design solutions at scale
* Experience in delivering products against a plan in a fast-paced, multi-disciplined, and often ambiguous environment
* Experience working independently to design, plan, and execute technical projects
* Able to distill data and articulate the rationale for making difficult trade-offs
* A solid foundation in service-oriented and digital technologies to be able to understand service inter-dependencies and drive technical solutions for multi-tiered systems
* Demonstrated understanding of systems within program space to include limitations, scaling, boundary conditions, and architectural decision-making process
* Demonstrated deep knowledge of technical program management and engineering best practices
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20% of the time
* Comfort and experience with cross-organizational communication; excellent written and verbal communication skills. Written and verbal fluency in the English language is required.

**Pre-sales**
**Required Skills:**

* Deliver customized pre-sales technical presentations and product demonstrations to customers
* Assist in the development of RFI/RFP responses and drive to close new opportunities
* Engage with potential customers to understand their business objectives and demonstrate the value proposition of LF DNO platform

**Solution**

* Work with LotusFlare’s engineering team and externally with customer technical teams to propose and help clients build solutions that unblock deployment

**Delivery**

* Drive project execution technical track; track delivery, take ownership of change management, proactively seek and resolve blockers.
* Manage UAT and production releases, and project handover to our support and operational teams.
* Act as a key interface between the customer and the LotusFlare organization including product, engineering, support and business.
* Support project management activities, ensuring issues are documented and addressed.
* Be a part of a Global Delivery Team, share experiences and develop the PM discipline: simplify processes, methods and tools with creative ideas
* Troubleshoot customer technical issues in real time
* Create documentation and develop best practices to help customers get the most out of using the system

**Benefits We Have For You**

* Competitive salary package
* Paid lunch (In the office)
* Training and workshops
* Top-of-the-class engineers to learn from and work with

**About Us**
At LotusFlare, we attract and keep amazing people by offering two key things:
  
  

* Purposeful Work: Every team member sees how their efforts make a tangible, positive difference for our customers and partners.
* Growth Opportunities: We provide the chance to develop professionally while mastering cutting-edge practices in cloud-native enterprise software.

From the beginning, our mission has been to simplify technology to create better experiences for customers. Using an “experience down” approach, which prioritizes the customer's journey at every stage of development, our Digital Network Operator™ Cloud empowers communication service providers to achieve valuable business outcomes. DNO Cloud enables communication service providers to innovate freely, reduce operational costs, monetize network assets, engage customers on all digital channels, drive customer acquisition, and increase retention.
  
  
With headquarters in Santa Clara, California, and five major offices worldwide, LotusFlare serves Deutsche Telekom, T-Mobile, A1, Globe Telecom, Liberty Latin America, Singtel, and other leading enterprises around the world.
  
  
Website: www.lotusflare.com
  
  
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/lotusflare

Twitter: https://twitter.com/lotus\_flare

Work Type: Hybrid  
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  
Qualification: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  
Practice / Domain: Digital Experience, API Integration & Retail/Lubricants Ecosystem

**Role Summary & Context**

We are seeking a visionary Solution Architect to lead the architectural design and global rollout of a next generation Unified Experience and Orchestration Platform for Lubricants Ecosystem program global indirect channel initiative partnering with independent auto workshops, distributors, and internal teams. Currently, regional markets operate across fragmented backend systems (SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow, and legacy dealer platforms), resulting in inconsistent workflows and disjointed user journeys.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architectural Vision & MACH Design**

. Headless Experience Architecture: Design a decoupled, composable frontend architecture (React / Next.js SPA) utilizing a unified Design System (WCAG 2.0 compliant) that eliminates i frames and system switching for Distributors, Workshops, and Internal client users.  
. Backend for Frontend (BFF) & API Strategy: Architect a robust BFF and API Gateway layer (Azure API Management / Kong) that abstracts regional backend schema variations ("API drift") into a globally standardized contract for the UI.  
. Hybrid Process Orchestration: Design the orchestration strategy balancing synchronous, low latency API orchestration with asynchronous event driven choreography using Camunda / Temporal and Apache Kafka / Azure Event Grid.

**2. Enterprise Integration & Guardrail Governance**

. Stateless & Transient Enforcement: Strictly enforce architectural guardrails ensuring no new System of Record (SoR) is created, and no business logic is duplicated in the experience layer. Design short term caching strategies (e.g., Redis) for slow legacy ERP reads while ensuring real time write backs to authoritative sources.  
. Heterogeneous System Connectivity: Define integration patterns across MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO, or SAP Integration Suite to seamlessly connect SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow, Client Lubricants DB, and regional third party distributor systems.  
. End to End Observability & Security: Implement enterprise security using Microsoft Entra ID (SSO, OAuth 2.0, RBAC) and establish end to end auditability via standardized correlation IDs across distributed transactions.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Architecture Patterns:** Proven expertise in MACH Architecture (Microservices, API first, Cloud native, Headless), BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns, Event Driven Architecture (EDA), and Domain Driven Design (DDD).  
**Frontend & UI Layer:** Strong architectural understanding of React, Next.js, or Vue.js, Micro frontends, Single Page Applications (SPAs), enterprise Design Systems, and WCAG 2.0 accessibility standards.  
**Orchestration & BPM:** Hands on experience architecting stateful/stateless workflows using Camunda (8/Zeebe), Temporal, or equivalent lightweight microservices orchestration engines.  
**Integration & Messaging**: Deep expertise in API Gateways (Azure APIM, Kong), iPaaS/ESB platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO, SAP Integration Suite), and event brokers (Apache Kafka, Azure Event Grid).  
**Backend & Caching:** Proficiency in Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/GraphQL APIs, and transient in memory caching (Redis) to mitigate legacy ERP latency.  
**Cloud, DevOps & IAM:** Production experience with Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) or OpenShift on Azure or AWS, CI/CD pipelines, APM observability tools, and Microsoft Entra ID (OAuth2/OIDC/SSO).

**Overall Experience:** 10+ years in Enterprise IT, with 5+ years as a Solution Architect designing large scale, multi market digital platforms and integration layers.

61737a2f.description:
**Company Description:**
Sentris is a privately held technology and cybersecurity firm founded in 2026, focused on cybersecurity, data privacy, artificial intelligence, and advanced technologies. The company helps organisations secure digital environments, protect critical data, and build intelligent, future-ready solutions. Sentris delivers its impact through a combination of services, privacy solutions, AI offerings, and custom technology development. Team members collaborate with clients across industries, working on complex, real-world security and technology challenges in a fast-evolving digital landscape.

**Role Description:**
We are looking for a
**Senior Solutions Architect**
to own the technical vision, strategy, and engineering roadmap for our global enterprise infrastructure.

In this role, you will act as the primary technical anchor for our modern workplace ecosystem. You will translate complex business goals into scalable, secure, and cloud-first technical blueprints. If you excel at bridging the gap between high-level architectural design and hands-on automation, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Design End-to-End Solutions:**
  Architect comprehensive, cross-platform infrastructure blueprints that unify diverse operating systems, cloud applications, and hardware environments.
* **Define Enterprise Baselines:**
  Establish global security, compliance, and configuration profiles, ensuring all corporate assets adhere to strict zero-trust principles.
* **Lead Modern Provisioning:**
  Build and scale automated, factory-to-user deployment frameworks to streamline device and software lifecycle management.
* **Drive Identity & Access Integration:**
  Partner with security teams to integrate system compliance data with central Identity and Access Management (IAM) tools to enforce context-aware access policies.
* **Champion Automation:**
  Lead the development of advanced scripting workflows (PowerShell, Python, Bash) and API integrations to eliminate manual overhead and orchestrate tasks at scale.
* **Provide Governance & Support:**
  Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for complex system failures and author detailed architectural documentation for engineering teams.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Architectural Experience:**
  5+ years of experience in enterprise systems engineering, cloud architecture, or infrastructure design.
* **Platform & OS Agnostic:**
  Proven track record designing solutions for diverse environments across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile operating platforms.
* **Identity & Security Fluency:**
  Deep understanding of modern identity protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth), single sign-on (SSO), and conditional access architecture.
* **Advanced Scripting:**
  Strong proficiency in using automation frameworks, scripting languages, and APIs to handle configuration management at scale.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to pitch complex technical architectures to executives while collaborating deeply with execution teams.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Recognised industry certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or CISSP).
* Experience architecting major legacy-to-cloud infrastructure transformations for global environments.

Microsoft Azure, AWS, Active Directory, Entra ID and Microsoft 365

75% Technical Leadership | 25% Business & Practice Management

**1. Role Summary**

Lead the technical architecture, solution engineering and delivery of global cloud and infrastructure consulting engagements. Drive enterprise cloud migrations, data center exits, hybrid cloud transformation, modernization, automation, security and FinOps across Azure and AWS.

The role requires a hands-on technical leader who can own complex architecture decisions, guide engineering teams, lead technical client discussions and support practice growth, pre-sales and P&L performance.

Own end-to-end Azure, AWS and hybrid cloud architecture for enterprise customers.

Design landing zones, cloud networking, identity, security, resilience and disaster recovery solutions.

Establish architecture standards, design reviews and technical governance.

Drive cloud-native, infrastructure and platform modernization initiatives.

Oversee large-scale data center exits, application, database, server and middleware migrations.

Drive Active Directory consolidation, Entra ID modernization and Microsoft 365 tenant migrations.

Govern cutover, testing, performance optimization, hypercare and operational handover.

Implement CI/CD, configuration management, reusable modules and automated provisioning.

Lead cloud cost optimization, rightsizing, observability, security automation and operational resilience.

Review solution designs, implementation plans, technical risks and delivery quality.

Lead architecture workshops, proof-of-concepts and complex technical escalations.

Ensure security, performance, availability and compliance requirements are met.

**E. Technical Pre-Sales & Solutioning — 10%**

Lead technical solutioning, RFP/RFI responses, effort estimation and architecture proposals.

Develop migration roadmaps, solution blueprints and reusable consulting accelerators.

Support client presentations, solution defense and Microsoft/AWS partner engagements.

**F. Practice & People Leadership — 20%**

Contribute to practice P&L, revenue growth, margins, utilization and pipeline conversion.

Lead, mentor and develop cloud architects and senior engineering teams.

Build technical capabilities, certification roadmaps, reusable IP and strategic partnerships.

Track delivery performance, customer satisfaction and practice growth.

**3. Required Qualifications**

15 years of IT experience with deep cloud and infrastructure expertise.

5+ years in cloud architecture, technical consulting or senior engineering leadership.

Strong hands-on expertise in Azure, AWS, hybrid cloud and enterprise migrations.

Experience with landing zones, networking, identity, security, DR/BCP and infrastructure modernization.

Practical knowledge of Terraform or equivalent IaC tools, CI/CD, automation and FinOps.

Experience with Active Directory, Entra ID and Microsoft 365 migrations.

Proven technical solutioning, architecture governance, client engagement and team leadership.

Exposure to commercial ownership, estimation, pre-sales and global delivery environments.

Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).

AWS Solutions Architect – Professional.

Terraform Associate, FinOps Practitioner or cloud security certifications.

TOGAF or PMP certification is desirable.

**5. Key Performance Indicators**

Cloud migration and modernization success, architecture quality and delivery outcomes.

Automation adoption, provisioning efficiency and cloud cost optimization.

Security, availability, resilience and reduction in technical escalations.

Technical proposal quality, estimation accuracy and pipeline conversion.

Practice revenue, margin, utilization, customer satisfaction and team capability growth.

A technically strong cloud consulting leader with deep Azure and AWS expertise, proven experience in complex enterprise migrations and modernization, and the ability to guide engineering teams through challenging technical engagements while contributing to business growth and practice profitability.

47cd7abf.title: Product security Architect
47cd7abf.description:
**About NeST Digital!**

NeST Digital, the core software division of the NeST Group, is one of the key global providers of technology solutions! With our extensive expertise spanning over two decades, we propel digital-driven innovation and have a remarkable track record of delivering cutting-edge solutions across different industry domains.

We are not just a company dreaming of the future we are shaping it! Step into our world and work with Fortune 500 companies on cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with industry experts, and constantly expand your skills and knowledge.

Its not just about the work it's about the community we build together, believing in cultivating a culture of camaraderie where teamwork, respect, and celebration are the norm.

So if you're a trailblazer, a boundary-pusher, or a true visionary with passion, you belong with us! Together, let us make a difference that will reverberate through time and redefine the infinite possibilities of this digital world!

Join us now, and let us embark on this extraordinary quest together!

  

**Position - Product Security Architect**

**Experience- 8+ years**

**Location- Bangalore**

  

**Responsibilities**

* Provide privacy and security technical expertise supporting the product team throughout product development, design change, and life-cycle management.
* Work with the Product Security Leader (PSL) to support the product team with process expertise for Healthcare Product Cybersecurity Standards and life-cycle management.
* Product cybersecurity development responsibilities:

+ Assess the privacy and cybersecurity state of the product and define product roadmap features/enhancements with stakeholder approval.
+ Responsible for security architecture and coordination of product development for cybersecurity features and enhancements.
+ Assess product components and SBoM are integrated into the product.
+ Perform defect management for cybersecurity issues.
+ Identify operational responsibilities and adherence to cloud standards for cloud-based products.
+ Responsible for Product and Security Manual and MDS2 documentation.

* In coordination with the PSL, own and deliver Product Cybersecurity Standard artefacts, which include:

+ Design input activities to identify, evaluate, roadmap, and drive cybersecurity and privacy features and enhancements within product development programs.
+ Create Design Engineering Privacy and Security (DEPS) artefacts for privacy and security risk assessments to engage in domain-specific product threat modelling, attack surface analysis, risk management and reduction.
+ Coordinates with the PSL to support the product team in scheduling and performing vulnerability scans and cybersecurity assessments.
+ Lead product Security Technical Design Reviews
+ Along with the product Lead System Designer (LSD), responsible for the Product Cybersecurity Standard compliance and other pertinent standards and processes.

* The released products shall comply with required regulatory standards & compliance (like FDA, HIPPA, GDPR etc.)
* Works with the Product Security team and Quality Assurance & Regulatory Assurance (QARA) on released product life cycle, including:

+ Participate in post-market product vulnerability monitoring.
+ Participate as a Subject Matter Expert to determine product vulnerability impact, investigation, and risk assessment.
+ Responsible for product vulnerability mitigation and design change.
+ Responsible for vulnerability tool updates to ensure accurate customer communication.
+ Address customer and Sales RFP privacy and security feedback/questions.

* Provide technical expertise on customer concerns, complaints, and CSO escalations.
* Create/Maintain responsible product records within product cybersecurity tools.

  

**Mandatory Soft Skills**

* Should be able to contribute as an individual contributor
* Should be able to execute his/her responsibility independently
* Focus on self-planning activities

  

**Mandatory Skills**

* **Security Engineering**

1. Globally recognized Cyber Security Certifications (Advanced/Expert Level).
2. Firm with knowledge of OWASP, CVSS, FIPS 140-2/140-3 and DoD RMF
3. **5+ years of full-time information security experience** with emphasis on technical assessment (system/web application vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, white-box secure code analysis, etc.) and security architecture (design of security controls, secure system design, understanding of identity and authentication management, etc.)
4. The Architect shall be capable of not only finding risks/issues but shall also suggest the best route to remediation, knowing the compensatory controls & guiding the product team for its closure.
5. Sound understanding of security technologies/techniques like

+ Cryptography, Algorithms, Public key Infrastructure (PKI) Certificate Authority (CA),
+ Hardware/embedded authentication, OAuth, 2-factor authentication, and
+ white-box code analysis.

6. Experience with a range of security tools related to

+ SAST (Static Application Security Assessment),
+ DAST (Dynamic Application Security Assessment),
+ Vulnerability Management,
+ SCA (Software Composition Analysis),
+ Penetration Testing
+ Threat Modelling Tools etc.

* **Product Engineering**

1. Experience in working in a Product sector environment
2. Knowledge of Cloud Infrastructure [Platform as a Service]

* **Medical Software/Device Engineering**

1. MDS2 documentation
2. Experience in the Healthcare domain.

* **Standard Software Engineering**

1. Experience in Micro Services using RESTful frameworks

* **Security Engineering**

1. Penetration Testing in Web Applications, Thick Clients, Mobile Applications, REST/SOAP
2. Infrastructure Penetration Testing
3. Experience in Red Teaming Activities (add-on)
4. Recognition for CVE or Wall-of-Fame through Bug-Bounty (add-on)

  

Interested candidates can share their updated CV to anjusha.mohan@nestgroup.net

  

Regards,

Anjusha Mohan

Talent Acquisition Team | NeST Digital

c0ff7547.title: Salesforce Omnistudio (FSC) Technical Architect
c0ff7547.description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Design & Solutioning**

* Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
* Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
* Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
* Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
* Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.

**Development Leadership**

* Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
* Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
* Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
* Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
* Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.

**Delivery Ownership**

* Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
* Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
* Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
* Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.

**Practice & People Development**

* Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
* Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

  

**Must-Have Skills**

**1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)**

* Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
* Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.

**2. OmniStudio Implementation**

* OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
* Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
* Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
* FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).

**3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)**

* Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
* Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
* Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.

**4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)**

* Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
* Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.

**5. Document Generation**

* Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.

**6. Salesforce Data Modelling**

* Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.

**7. Salesforce Design & Configuration**

* Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
* Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
* Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)

**8. Apex Development**

* Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
* Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
* Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
* Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.

**9. Code Quality & Reviews**

* Run structured code reviews.
* Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
* Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.

**10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership**

* Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
* Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

 assigned outcomes   
 Nice to have

 required   
 ¢  
 Experience reducing cloud spend measurably rather than only reporting it   
 What sets strong candidates apart

 You have been on call for a production platform and can describe an incident you diagnosed rather than   
 escalated.   
 ¢  
 ¢  
 ¢  
 You automate instead of repeating. Your infrastructure changes go through reviewed code, not the portal.   
 You treat cost as an engineering constraint. You have found waste and removed it.   
 You follow a problem to a verified outcome rather than to a closed ticket.   
 How we work   
 Cloud Engineering is part of Product Engineering, not a separate corporate IT support function. The Senior Cloud   
 & Security Engineer sets architecture, security, compliance and cost standards; Cloud Engineers implement,   
 operate and improve the platform within those standards.   
 Page 2 of 3

We value practical problem-solving, dependable execution, documented decisions, and process that prevents   
 avoidable failures. Ownership means following a problem through to a verified outcome, not just completing a   
 task.   
 What we offer   
 Day shift, no night rotation • fixed weekly offs • medical insurance • a real production SaaS platform rather than   
 internal IT • AKS, AI infrastructure and IaC work with a senior engineer to learn from • a defined path toward Senior   
 Cloud & Security Engineer.   
 About us   
 EmpClaims is a US healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) company that helps physician practices, urgent   
 care centres, and healthcare facilities across the United States get paid accurately and on time for the care they   
 provide. The company was founded in Illinois in 2008 and has run its India operations from Ahmedabad since 2009.   
 That gives it more than 15 years of experience in medical billing and coding, accounts receivable, payment posting,   
 and credentialing.   
 When you join EmpClaims, you build real expertise in US healthcare. We invest in structured training, buddy-   
 supported onboarding, and clear career progression across AR, Billing, Payment Posting, Coding, and Credentialing.   
 Our Product and Engineering team builds the software behind all of it. It is a deliberately small, ownership-heavy   
 group building an AI-native platform used by our own operations teams and by client practices across the US   
 which means engineers and product people here work directly with the domain experts who use what they build,   
 see their work reach production quickly, and are expected to understand the revenue-cycle problem they are   
 solving rather than just the ticket in front of them.

0579fa21.title: Senior Program Manager
0579fa21.description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
We are looking for an accomplished Senior Program Manager (SPM) to lead large-scale, complex telecom delivery programs across Packet Core and Cloud Native Infrastructure Solutions (CNIS) for a Tier-1 telecommunications customer.
  
  
This is a senior customer-facing leadership role responsible for driving end-to-end program execution, delivery excellence, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes. The role requires strong program governance, telecom technical understanding, commercial awareness, and the ability to lead cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex Packet Core and CNIS programs, from planning and mobilization through deployment, integration, migration, testing, acceptance, handover, and closure.
  
  
Act as a trusted customer partner, building strong relationships with customer executives, technical teams, operations, internal leadership, suppliers, and partners.
  
  
Translate customer requirements and contractual commitments into clear program roadmaps, delivery plans, milestones, governance models, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Lead cross-functional teams across Packet Core, CNIS, Network Management, integration, deployment, testing, and operations.
  
  
Own overall program performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risks, dependencies, change, and customer acceptance.
  
  
Establish strong program and financial governance through executive reviews, steering forums, forecasting, reporting, decision-making, and action tracking.
  
  
Proactively identify and manage technical, delivery, commercial, resource, security, and operational risks, driving mitigation, escalation, and recovery plans.
  
  
Manage changes to scope, timelines, resources, and commercial commitments through appropriate governance and approval processes.
  
  
Align resource demand and capacity with delivery priorities, ensuring the right capabilities are available at the right time.
  
  
Ensure quality, compliance, delivery readiness, customer acceptance, and a controlled transition into operations and support.
  
  
Partner with account, solution, product, commercial, and delivery teams to ensure continuity from solutioning and sales handover through execution.
  
  
Manage multiple delivery streams using Hybrid Delivery Models, including Factory Model and resource-based delivery.
  
  
Monitor and drive operational and delivery KPIs, including A&I, SSAT, SSP adoption, and CI/CD adoption.
  
  
**The Skills You Bring**
15+ years of experience leading large and complex customer-facing telecom delivery programs, preferably for Tier-1 telecommunications operators.
  
  
Strong knowledge of Packet Core, 4G/5G Core Network, Cloud Native Infrastructure/CNIS, and Network Management environments.
  
  
Experience across deployment, integration, migration, upgrades, testing, CI/CD, operational readiness, and service transition.
  
  
Proven ability to deliver against contractual commitments while managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risks, dependencies, and change.
  
  
Strong executive-level customer and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and drive fact-based decisions.
  
  
Strong program governance and financial management capabilities, including planning, forecasting, budgeting, performance reporting, risk management, and escalation management.
  
  
Experience leading matrixed, multicultural, cross-functional, and geographically distributed teams.
  
  
Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, or SAFe are preferred; equivalent practical experience is also valued.
  
  
Practical experience with program and project management tools such as SAP, Microsoft Project, estimation tools, Erimatch, GC, and related platforms.
  
  
**Why join Ericsson?**
At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
  
  
**What happens once you apply?**
Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.
