ee634a95.title: Technical Account Manager - 3
ee634a95.description:
**The Role:**

You own the technical success of Cashfree Payment’s largest merchants from first scoping call to scaled production. You're the person, merchant CTOs call when something matters and the person internal teams trust to bring order to complex, high-stakes integrations.

This role sits where engineering depth meets executive presence. You'll debug an API edge case before lunch and align a merchant's leadership on go-live readiness after it.

**What You'll Own:**

* **Enterprise implementations, end-to-end:**
  Scope, plan, integrate, launch, stabilize. You own the timeline, the risks, and the outcome.
* **Technical relationship:**
  You're the primary point of contact for merchant engineering, product and business stakeholders. You translate payment infrastructure into solutions that fit their architecture, growth stage and risk posture, not a standard playbook.
* **Program rigor:**
  Project plans with real dependencies. Risks surfaced before they bite. Internal coordination across Product, Engineering, Risk, Ops and Support to keep delivery on track.
* **Integration health, post go-live:**
  Monitor transaction performance and success rates proactively. Spot optimization opportunities before they become incidents and own resolution when they do.
* **Escalations:**
  You lead the response end-to-end. Root cause, stakeholder comms and resolution. Merchants walk away with the issue fixed and their confidence intact.
* **The merchant signal loop:**
  Patterns you see in the field, friction points, gaps, recurring asks! They become structured inputs into the product roadmap.
* **Launch readiness for high-stakes go-lives:**
  Scale tests, production readiness reviews, white-glove support during peak windows.
* **Solutioning from use case, not catalog:**
  You start with the merchant's business model and work backwards, mapping their use case to the right mix of Cashfree products, not the full suite.
* **SLA-grade resolution**
  When merchant revenue is on the line, you operate to stringent SLAs, coordinating engineering and ops in real time, holding the line on both speed and fixed quality.
* **Team leverage:**
  Better playbooks, sharper integration guides, faster onboarding for the next merchant and the one after that.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **4+ years**
  in technical account management, implementation engineering or solutions engineering, B2B SaaS or fintech, with end-to-end ownership of complex multi-stakeholder programs.
* **Trusted advisor on the highest-stakes integrations:**
  You're the TAM Cashfree puts on the launches that can't go wrong, new product lines, regulated flows & marquee logos.
* **Force multiplier for the team:**
  You mentor L1s and L2s through hard escalations, codify what works into playbooks the team actually uses and shape how Integration operates as a function.
* **Consultative with conviction:**
  You surface the unsaid constraints, challenge assumptions that don't hold and guide merchants to the right answer, not just the asked one.
* **Technically credible:**
  Strong fluency in REST APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns. You don't ship production code, but you read it, reason about it and hold your own in a technical war room.
* **Working knowledge of at least one modern language:**
  Go, Python or Java, with hands-on experience you can point to. Familiarity with mobile platforms (Android, iOS) is a plus, especially when integrations span SDKs.
* **Comfortable in the tools merchants live in:**
  Strong with SQL for slicing through transaction data and fluent with Postman (or equivalent) for testing and debugging APIs in real time.
* **Fintech context is a strong plus:**
  Payment flows, reconciliation, settlements or compliance frameworks, anything that lets you skip the ramp.
* **Range of audience:**
  You translate cleanly in both directions: technical complexity for business stakeholders, business context for engineering, without losing precision either way.
* **High ownership:**
  Merchant outcomes are your outcomes. You follow through without being chased and escalate with context, not noise.
* **Built for ambiguity:**
  Enterprise implementations rarely go to plan. You re-sequence, adapt and keep merchants confident through it.

08543136.title: Sr, Technical Program Manager, E-reader Products Team
08543136.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Kindle E-reader is a revolutionary reading device, the #1 best-selling product on all of Amazon, and one of the most innovative and fast growing businesses at Amazon. It is an iconic product and a thriving business adored by customers around the world – but it’s still “day one” in inspiring the world to read more and get more out of reading every day, across all their devices. As a Sr. Technical Program Manager, you will work closely with the Product Management, Software Development Engineering, User Experience Design, and Customer Support groups to understand the product vision, requirements and customer usage models and develop appropriate release strategies. You will be executing the TPM team’s technical vision and roadmap, developing and tracking project schedules.  
  
The role is inherently cross-functional: you will work closely with a high-energy team of software engineers, product managers, marketers, customer service leads as well as external partners (like Factory OEMs).  
  
This role is a good fit for someone who is organized, thrives in a dynamic environment, understands the diverse perspectives of stakeholders to deliver complex programs, raises the bar on technical excellence, shows thought leadership, and communicates well to different audiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

  You start with the merchant's business model and work backwards, mapping their use case to the right mix of Cashfree products, not the full suite.
* **SLA-grade resolution**
  When merchant revenue is on the line, you operate to stringent SLAs, coordinating engineering and ops in real time, holding the line on both speed and fixed quality.
* **Team leverage:**
  Better playbooks, sharper integration guides, faster onboarding for the next merchant and the one after that.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **2+ years**
  in technical account management, implementation engineering or solutions engineering, B2B SaaS or fintech, with end-to-end ownership of complex multi-stakeholder programs.
* **Technically credible:**
  Strong fluency in REST APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns. You don't ship production code, but you read it, reason about it and hold your own in a technical war room.
* **Working knowledge of at least one modern language**
  : Go, Python or Java, with hands-on experience you can point to. Familiarity with mobile platforms (Android, iOS) is a plus, especially when integrations span SDKs.
* **Comfortable in the tools merchants live in:**
  Strong with SQL for slicing through transaction data and fluent with Postman (or equivalent) for testing and debugging APIs in real time.
* **Fintech context is a strong plus:**
  Payment flows, reconciliation, settlements or compliance frameworks, anything that lets you skip the ramp.
* **Range of audience:**
  You translate cleanly in both directions: technical complexity for business stakeholders, business context for engineering, without losing precision either way.
* **Consultative by default:**
  You ask before you prescribe. Merchants can tell the difference.
* **High ownership:**
  Merchant outcomes are your outcomes. You follow through without being chased and escalate with context, not noise.
* **Built for ambiguity:**
  Enterprise implementations rarely go to plan. You re-sequence, adapt and keep merchants confident through it.
* **Builder's instinct:**
  You leave the playbook, the process and the team better than you found them.

**About Leadsquared**
LeadSquared is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the CRM space — trusted by 2,000+ customers and 2.5 lakh+ users globally. With a strong presence across the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa, LeadSquared is expanding its US vertical teams to drive growth in Education and Healthcare — two of our strongest market segments.

LeadSquared is expanding its US Education vertical and is looking for a senior PreSales Consultant with deep expertise in the Education sector to drive enterprise deal pursuits across Higher Education institutions, K-12 districts, EdTech platforms, and Workforce Training organizations. You will serve as the technical and solutions authority in the sales process — owning discovery, demo design, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept development — while acting as a trusted advisor to prospects and a strategic partner to the US Sales team.

**CRM**

b7d0080c.title: Solutions Consultant — Enterprise AI & Presales
b7d0080c.description:
**Solutions Consultant — Enterprise AI & Presales**

**Company: Assistents.ai**

Assistents.ai helps enterprises use AI agents to connect business systems, automate workflows, and support business decisions.

We are looking for a senior, client-facing professional who can lead discussions with business leaders, discover use cases, and deliver compelling product demonstrations.

You should be able to understand how a business works, identify where AI can help, and explain how Assistents.ai can address the need. We will provide product training. You will bring strong business judgment, clear communication, and the ability to earn trust with senior leaders.

**The role**

Our lead generation partner arranges prospective client meetings. You will lead these conversations and help turn initial interest into a clear solution opportunity.

A typical meeting may start with a broad question: “How can AI help our business?” Your role is to ask the right questions, understand the underlying problem, and connect it to a practical solution using Assistents.ai.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery meetings and product demonstrations with CEOs, CXOs, business heads, and technology leaders.
* Research each prospect’s business, industry, and likely priorities before the meeting.
* Understand current processes, systems, manual work, bottlenecks, and business goals.
* Identify use cases across functions such as sales, customer service, finance, operations, HR, and supply chain.
* Develop initial solution approaches during live discussions. Explain the proposed workflow, system connections, expected benefits, and areas that need further validation.
* Tailor demonstrations to the client’s priorities and adapt when new requirements emerge.
* Explain technical concepts in clear business terms. Handle detailed questions with confidence and sound judgment.
* Qualify opportunities by clarifying business impact, urgency, decision-makers, budget, and readiness.
* Prepare concise meeting summaries, use-case briefs, solution outlines, and follow-up presentations.
* Work with the founder, product team, and engineering team to define proposals and proofs of concept.
* Agree on clear next steps with the client and maintain progress after each meeting.

**What you bring**

* Proven experience in enterprise presales, solutions consulting, business consulting, or technology consulting.
* A strong record of leading discovery sessions and demonstrations for senior decision-makers.
* A professional presence, excellent spoken and written English, and strong listening skills.
* The ability to connect business problems, process changes, technology capabilities, and measurable outcomes.
* The ability to think clearly during live discussions and respond to questions beyond a prepared presentation.
* Working knowledge of enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, analytics platforms, and workflow tools.
* Enough technical understanding to discuss AI agents, integrations, APIs, and data requirements with technical teams.
* Sound judgment about what can be demonstrated, what can be proposed, and what needs technical validation.
* Strong preparation, documentation, and follow-through.

**Experience that would help**

* Selling or consulting on enterprise SaaS, AI, automation, analytics, or digital transformation.
* Working with clients across multiple industries.
* Designing business workflows or helping clients improve operational processes.
* Developing business cases, proposals, and proofs of concept.

**What success looks like**

Clients leave your meetings with a clear understanding of the problem, the proposed use case, and how Assistents.ai could help. Demonstrations address their actual needs. Follow-up documents give our delivery team enough detail to assess the solution. Qualified opportunities move towards an agreed workshop, proof of concept, or proposal.

**What we provide**

* Structured training on the Assistents.ai platform and its capabilities.
* Access to the founder, product specialists, and engineering team.
* The opportunity to shape enterprise AI solutions across industries.
* Ownership of discovery and demonstration conversations with senior business leaders.

**How to apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile with a brief example of a client discussion you led. Explain the business problem, how you developed the solution approach, and the outcome.

* As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates will lead a simulated executive discovery meeting and deliver a short demonstration after a product briefing.

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  
  
Job Title: Solution Architect – Composable Experience & Orchestration  
Experience: 10+ yrs.  
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai  
Position ID: J1026-1164  
Work Type: Hybrid  
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  
Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  
Practice / Domain: Digital Experience, API Integration & Retail/Lubricants Ecosystem  
  
Role Summary & Context  
  
We are seeking a visionary Solution Architect to lead the architectural design and global rollout of a next generation Unified Experience and Orchestration Platform for Lubricants Ecosystem program global indirect channel initiative partnering with independent auto workshops, distributors, and internal teams. Currently, regional markets operate across fragmented backend systems (SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow, and legacy dealer platforms), resulting in inconsistent workflows and disjointed user journeys.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
  
1. Architectural Vision & MACH Design  
  
. Headless Experience Architecture: Design a decoupled, composable frontend architecture (React / Next.js SPA) utilizing a unified Design System (WCAG 2.0 compliant) that eliminates i frames and system switching for Distributors, Workshops, and Internal client users.  
. Backend for Frontend (BFF) & API Strategy: Architect a robust BFF and API Gateway layer (Azure API Management / Kong) that abstracts regional backend schema variations ("API drift") into a globally standardized contract for the UI.  
. Hybrid Process Orchestration: Design the orchestration strategy balancing synchronous, low latency API orchestration with asynchronous event driven choreography using Camunda / Temporal and Apache Kafka / Azure Event Grid.  
  
2. Enterprise Integration & Guardrail Governance  
  
. Stateless & Transient Enforcement: Strictly enforce architectural guardrails ensuring no new System of Record (SoR) is created, and no business logic is duplicated in the experience layer. Design short term caching strategies (e.g., Redis) for slow legacy ERP reads while ensuring real time write backs to authoritative sources.  
. Heterogeneous System Connectivity: Define integration patterns across MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO, or SAP Integration Suite to seamlessly connect SAP ERP, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow, Client Lubricants DB, and regional third party distributor systems.  
. End to End Observability & Security: Implement enterprise security using Microsoft Entra ID (SSO, OAuth 2.0, RBAC) and establish end to end auditability via standardized correlation IDs across distributed transactions.  
  
Required Experience & Skills  
  
Architecture Patterns: Proven expertise in MACH Architecture (Microservices, API first, Cloud native, Headless), BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns, Event Driven Architecture (EDA), and Domain Driven Design (DDD).  
Frontend & UI Layer: Strong architectural understanding of React, Next.js, or Vue.js, Micro frontends, Single Page Applications (SPAs), enterprise Design Systems, and WCAG 2.0 accessibility standards.  
Orchestration & BPM: Hands on experience architecting stateful/stateless workflows using Camunda (8/Zeebe), Temporal, or equivalent lightweight microservices orchestration engines.  
Integration & Messaging: Deep expertise in API Gateways (Azure APIM, Kong), iPaaS/ESB platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, TIBCO, SAP Integration Suite), and event brokers (Apache Kafka, Azure Event Grid).  
Backend & Caching: Proficiency in Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/GraphQL APIs, and transient in memory caching (Redis) to mitigate legacy ERP latency.  
Cloud, DevOps & IAM: Production experience with Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) or OpenShift on Azure or AWS, CI/CD pipelines, APM observability tools, and Microsoft Entra ID (OAuth2/OIDC/SSO).  
  
Overall Experience: 10+ years in Enterprise IT, with 5+ years as a Solution Architect designing large scale, multi market digital platforms and integration layers.

Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.

50de8eca.title: Gen AI Architect || Noida and Pune
50de8eca.description:
Greetings!!!

  

Please find below Job Description:

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned Generative AI Architect with a strong foundation in enterprise and system architecture, combined with significant depth and breadth in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI application development. This is a senior cross-cutting role responsible for architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation of Industry AI Solutions (IAIS) across multiple teams.

The Generative AI Architect will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions within their assigned teams, working alongside embedded GenAI Developers (who report to this architect for technical direction), traditional software engineers, and business stakeholders. The architect bridges the worlds of robust enterprise system design and cutting-edge AI capabilities translating business goals into scalable, secure, production-ready GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

**Cross-team Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Architect and own the end-to-end Solution Design, working alongside a System Architect or alone for an Industry AI Solution Team, ensuring architectural consistency, pattern reuse, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Serve as the primary technical authority for GenAI and Agentic AI architecture decisions within assigned teams, providing direction to embedded GenAI Developers and guiding their implementation work.
* Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for GenAI and Agentic AI development across teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, proof-of-concept evaluations, and technical design discussions for AI features and components.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Solution Design**

* Design scalable, production-grade GenAI application architectures including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Agentic Workflows, LLM integration layers, prompt management systems, and response evaluation frameworks.
* Architect multi-agent systems and Agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration patterns, tool use, memory management, long-horizon task execution, and human-in-the-loop designs.
* Select and evaluate appropriate LLMs, embedding models, and AI frameworks (commercial and open-source) based on performance, cost, latency, and compliance requirements.
* Define LLM fine-tuning and adaptation strategies (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA, prompt tuning) where required, overseeing implementation by the developer team.
* Design LLMOps and AI observability pipelines including evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and feedback loops for deployed AI systems.

**Enterprise System Architecture**

* Apply deep system architecture expertise to ensure GenAI solutions integrate seamlessly into existing enterprise platforms including CRM, ERP, workflow automation tools, and analytics systems.
* Design robust, secure API layers, microservices, and event-driven integration patterns that connect AI components with enterprise backends.
* Ensure AI architectures meet enterprise non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, latency, security, and disaster recovery.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and cloud teams to architect AI workloads on cloud platforms (Azure preferred: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML) with appropriate cost and performance optimisation.

**Data Engineering & AI Data Architecture**

* Design and govern data pipelines supporting AI model inference and (where applicable) fine-tuning: ingestion, transformation, quality validation, and versioning.
* Define data architecture for AI: vector databases, knowledge graphs, embedding stores, and structured/unstructured data integration patterns.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data pipelines meet quality, freshness, and compliance requirements for AI use cases.

**Responsible AI, Governance & Security**

* Embed AI fairness, transparency, explainability, and accountability principles into solution designs from inception.
* Define and enforce AI security architecture: prompt injection protection, data leakage prevention, model access controls, and audit logging.
* Ensure compliance with applicable AI governance frameworks, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and enterprise AI policies.
* Conduct AI risk assessments for new solutions and advise teams on responsible deployment practices.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication**

* Collaborate closely with executive stakeholders, product managers, business analysts, and engineering leads to align AI architecture with business strategy and product roadmaps.
* Present complex AI architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences; produce architecture documentation, decision records, and design artefacts.
* Actively contribute to the broader IAIS architecture community sharing learnings, patterns, and innovations across teams and programs.

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills

**Architecture & Engineering Foundation**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect (5+ years), with a track record of designing large-scale, production enterprise systems.
* Strong command of system design principles: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, cloud-native patterns.
* Experience architecting across cloud platforms, with strong preference for Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure API Management).

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Expertise**

* Deep hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI application development — including RAG architecture, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and chain-of-thought design.
* Proven experience architecting Agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, and LLMOps practices — including tracing tools, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring.
* Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, FAISS, Chroma, or similar).
* Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning approaches (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA) and when to apply them versus prompt-based adaptation.

**Programming & Technical Skills**

* Strong Python proficiency — able to prototype, review, and guide implementation of GenAI components.
* Working knowledge of software engineering best practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, API design, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

**Responsible AI & Governance**

* Sound knowledge of Safe AI principles, AI security patterns, AI governance frameworks, and data privacy compliance.
* Ability to conduct AI risk assessments and embed governance into architecture decisions.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions and drive consensus across multi-disciplinary teams.
* Effective at communicating architecture decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience mentoring developers and guiding teams through complex AI implementation challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience leading AI architecture across multiple concurrent teams.
* Familiarity with MLOps tooling and platforms (MLflow, Azure ML Pipelines, Weights & Biases).
* Exposure to multimodal AI models (vision-language, speech-to-text, document AI).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance and compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or equivalent).
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows and coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or custom coding agents).
* Prior experience in a product architecture role delivering Industry AI Solutions at enterprise scale.

Job Title: Salesforce Data Cloud Technical Architect

**Experience:** 8+ Years

Budget: 2 LPM

**Working Hours:** 2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Data Cloud Technical Architect to lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise-scale customer data platforms using Salesforce Data Cloud.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Salesforce Data Cloud, Customer 360, identity resolution, data modeling, data ingestion, real-time integrations, and audience activation. The candidate should be capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing data architecture solutions.

This role involves working closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, Salesforce development teams, integration teams, and data engineering teams to deliver unified customer profiles, advanced segmentation, personalized customer experiences, and AI-driven business capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

**Architecture and Solution Design**

* Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of Salesforce Data Cloud solutions.
* Design scalable customer data platforms that consolidate customer information from multiple enterprise systems.
* Define Customer 360 architecture integrating Salesforce Data Cloud with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, and Agentforce.
* Establish architectural standards for data ingestion, transformation, harmonization, identity resolution, segmentation, and activation.
* Design batch, near-real-time, and streaming integration patterns based on business requirements.

**Data Modeling and Customer Identity**

* Design and implement Data Cloud data structures, including Data Lake Objects (DLOs), Data Model Objects (DMOs), and relevant calculated insight structures.
* Develop unified customer profiles by mapping and harmonizing data from multiple sources.
* Configure identity resolution rules, matching criteria, and reconciliation strategies.
* Implement data quality, governance, stewardship, consent management, and privacy controls.
* Optimize data models and processing strategies for performance, scalability, and data accuracy.

**Integration and Data Connectivity**

* Architect integrations between Salesforce Data Cloud and Salesforce CRM applications, Marketing Cloud Engagement, MuleSoft, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, and other enterprise platforms.
* Design API-based, event-driven, batch, and streaming integration solutions.
* Define data ingestion strategies using supported connectors, APIs, and external data sources.
* Collaborate with integration and data engineering teams to troubleshoot data mapping, ingestion, synchronization, and connectivity issues.
* Establish integration standards for reliability, monitoring, security, and scalability.

**AI, Analytics, and Customer Engagement**

* Enable AI-powered customer engagement and analytics use cases using Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Design data architectures that support Einstein AI, Agentforce, predictive analytics, and Next Best Action scenarios.
* Enable customer segmentation and audience activation across supported Salesforce and external destinations.
* Support personalization, customer insights, and data-driven decision-making initiatives.
* Ensure relevant, governed customer data is available to downstream AI and engagement applications.

**Technical Leadership and Governance**

* Lead architecture reviews, technical assessments, and design discussions.
* Translate business requirements into technical architecture documents, integration designs, and implementation roadmaps.
* Mentor Salesforce developers, technical leads, and solution architects.
* Define reusable architectural patterns, implementation standards, and technical best practices.
* Participate in client workshops, requirement discovery, solution estimation, and pre-sales discussions where required.

**Security and Compliance**

* Define secure data access, sharing, and governance models.
* Implement appropriate role-based access, permissions, consent, and data protection controls.
* Align architecture with applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA where relevant.
* Ensure sensitive customer data is handled according to organizational security and compliance policies.

* Strong hands-on implementation experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience designing Customer 360 solutions and unified customer profiles.
* Strong understanding of Data Streams, DLOs, DMOs, identity resolution, calculated insights, segmentation, and activation.
* Experience with data modeling, SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, and data quality concepts.

The SAP S/4HANA Design Expert will act as ARS's internal design authority for Materials Management, Procurement and Extended Warehouse Management within the S/4HANA transformation programme.  
  
The role will guide business stakeholders through S/4HANA process and design decisions, ensure alignment with fit to standard and clean core principles, and independently review and challenge the System Integrator's recommendations.  
  
This is a senior, hands on role requiring strong SAP MM and EWM consulting expertise, good knowledge of manufacturing operations, and the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders across Procurement, Manufacturing, Warehousing and Finance.  
  
1. Business Engagement and Guidance:
  
. Engage with BPOs, Domain Coordinators, process owners and key users to understand business objectives, operational constraints and improvement opportunities.  
. Guide the business through S/4HANA process changes and explain the operational impact in clear, non technical language.  
. Facilitate design discussions and help stakeholders make informed decisions.  
. Challenge requests that replicate legacy processes without sufficient business justification.  
. Distinguish between mandatory requirements, business preferences and unnecessary customisation.  
. Manage difficult discussions constructively and build alignment across stakeholders with different priorities.  
. Support the Business Process Expert in resolving cross domain dependencies and design conflicts.  
  
2. S/4HANA Design Authority
  
. Act as ARS's internal design authority for SAP MM, Procurement, Inventory Management and EWM.  
. Review and validate end to end designs proposed by the SI.  
. Ensure designs follow fit to standard, clean core, process harmonisation and architectural principles.  
. Challenge SI assumptions, estimates, customisation proposals and solution recommendations.  
. Evaluate solution options and clearly communicate their benefits, limitations, risks and business impacts.  
. Verify that approved requirements are correctly translated into functional designs and configuration.  
. Review process flows, functional specifications, configuration documents and WRICEF requirements.  
. Assess deviations from the global template and recommend approval, redesign or escalation.  
. Ensure traceability between business requirements, design decisions, build and testing.  
  
3. Functional Scope  
  
The role requires strong hands on expertise across:
  
. Procure to pay processes  
. Direct and indirect procurement  
. Purchase requisitions, purchase orders and approvals  
. Contracts, scheduling agreements and source determination  
. Inventory management and physical inventory  
. Goods receipt, goods issue and stock transfers  
. Subcontracting, external processing and consignment  
. Invoice verification and Finance integration  
. Material valuation and automatic account determination  
. Material master and organisational structures  
. Batch, serial number and traceability requirements  
. Embedded and decentralised EWM scenarios  
. Inbound, outbound and internal warehouse processes  
. Put away, picking, packing, staging and replenishment  
. Handling unit, warehouse task and warehouse order management  
. Production supply and receipt from production  
. RF and mobile warehouse operations  
. EWM integration with MM, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance  
. Assessment of basic and advanced EWM capabilities

fa2aa425.description:
**Senior Consultant | Oracle OVM/OLVM | Bengaluru | Engineering | Hybrid Cloud Engineering**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 113551
  
• **Location**: Bengaluru
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**Senior Team Lead | Engineering, AI & Data – Engineering | Oracle VM (OVM)**

  

**Location: Bangalore**

  

**The team**

  

Engineering helps empower and drive mission-critical solutions whether we need to modernize existing systems or implement new technology products and platforms. Through innovation, we improve financial performance, accelerate new digital businesses and fuel growth. Learn more about Engineering, AI and Data

  

**Your work profile**

  

We are seeking an experienced OVM/OLVM Administrator to manage and support Oracle virtualization platforms across enterprise environments. The role involves deployment, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Oracle VM (OVM) and Oracle Linux Virtualization Manager (OLVM) infrastructures. You will ensure platform stability, performance, and high availability while contributing to automation, incident resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  

Key Responsibilities Platform Administration

* OVM, OLVM, VMware

* Install, configure, and administer Oracle VM (OVM) and Oracle Linux Virtualization Manager (OLVM) environments.

* Manage Oracle VM Manager and OLVM Manager including patching, upgrades, and version lifecycle operations.

* Oversee hypervisors based on Xen (OVM) and KVM/oVirt (OLVM) technologies. Virtual Machine & Storage Management

* Provision and maintain virtual machines, pools, templates, repositories, and storage domains.

* Configure and manage storage backends including NFS, iSCSI, Fibre Channel, OCFS2, and other supported storage types.

* Implement backup, snapshot, and VM lifecycle management procedures. Networking & High Availability

* Configure virtualization networking components including bridges, VLANs, NIC bonding, and host network interfaces.

* Implement and support High Availability (HA), live migration strategies, and resource balancing across hosts/clusters.

* Optimize virtual network performance and troubleshoot connectivity issues within OVM/OLVM clusters. Operations, Monitoring & Troubleshooting

* Monitor environment performance and proactively tune compute, storage, and network resources.

* Troubleshoot L3 issues related to Xen/KVM, libvirt, vdsm, ovirt-engine, storage paths, or cluster configuration.

* Provide root-cause analysis (RCA) and collaborate with Linux, storage, and network teams for integrated issue resolution. Automation & Documentation

* Automate administrative tasks using Ansible, Bash, and REST APIs.

* Maintain detailed SOPs, configuration documents, architecture diagrams, and knowledge base content.

* Support operational audits, compliance checks, and security hardening requirements. Required Skills

* Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle VM (Xen) and Oracle Linux Virtualization Manager (OLVM/KVM/oVirt).

* Deep knowledge of Oracle Linux, virtualization networking concepts, and enterprise storage technologies.

* Proficiency in automation tools such as Ansible, and scripting languages like Bash; familiarity with REST APIs.

* Strong understanding of HA, clustering, VM migration, load balancing, and DR concepts.

* Excellent troubleshooting and performance tuning skills across compute, networking, and storage layers. Experience

  

**Key skills required:**

  

* Education-BE or Btech or MTech or ME

* 8+ years of experience in virtualization and Linux infrastructure administration.
* Solid hands-on experience managing OVM and OLVM environments in production.
* Experience in enterprise environments with multi-cluster and large-scale deployments. Good to have
* Certifications such as Oracle Linux Certification, RHCE, or equivalent.
* Prior experience in managed services, large-scale data centers, or multi-vendor environments. • Exposure to VMware, Hyper-V, or cloud-based virtualization platforms is a plus.
  

Good to have

* VCP/VCAP Certifications
* Oracle Linux / OLVM Certifications
* Veritas InfoScale Certification
* PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL
* Exposure to Azure, AWS or OCI

64ed3c6a.title: TechOps-DE-CloudOpsAMS-SAP FICO Group Reporting-Senior
64ed3c6a.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an SAP FICO – Group Reporting (GR) – Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS Team. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high-quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 3-7 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP FICO Group Reporting (GR) preferably with Global client
* Responsible for providing support for SAP FICO - Group Reporting (GR) module incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting Consultant to support AMS, enhancements, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives for SAP Group Reporting and Consolidation processes.
* Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
* Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
* Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite model.
* SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting, SAP FICO, Financial Consolidation, Consolidation Monitor, Data Monitor, Currency Translation, Intercompany Elimination, Ownership Management, Financial Close Processes, AMS Support.
* Defect resolution and defect analysis/Reporting related to Finance.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* Well versed with FICO module Group Reporting (GR) (Includes - G/L, Account receivable, Accounts Payable, Banking Accounting, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Project System, Results Analysis, Unsettled Costs, Month End & Year end close, Overhead assessment and settlement)
* Experience in FI integration points with other SAP modules like MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
* SAP Certification in SAP FICO is added advantage

**What you will do:**

* Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
* Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP FICO solutions and designs.
* Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
* Mentor and train junior SAP FICO Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
* Preferred Skills – S/4 Finance and Group Reporting (GR),SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, Central Finance, SAP BPC, Fiori.

**What working at EY offers:**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Technical Account Manager will lead and mentor a high-performing offshore team of approximately 30 professionals supporting an enterprise account. * Delivery & Account Management- Lead offshore delivery, ensuring quality, timely execution, resource optimization, KPI/SLA compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement while serving as the primary client contact
* Technical Leadership- Mentor technical teams, drive engineering best practices, DevOps and automation adoption, and support solution reviews, technical decisions, and issue resolution
* Operations & Performance Management- Oversee production support and operations, monitor performance metrics, and implement process improvements to enhance service delivery and operational excellence
* Client Engagement -Build strong client relationships, present delivery performance and risks, provide strategic recommendations, and align offshore execution with business objectives
* People Leadership- Lead and develop a team of ~30 associates, managing performance, career growth, succession planning, engagement, hiring, retention, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning

**What You Bring:**

* 10+ years of experience in software delivery, technical program management, or account management roles.
* Proven experience managing offshore delivery teams of 25-50 members.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and operational support models.
* Experience working with financial services or banking clients.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including performance management and career development.
* Experience working in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) environments, with hands-on exposure to Saviynt and Java-based solutions.
* Must be based in Bangalore and willing to work from the Bangalore office to effectively lead and manage the offshore delivery team

**Nice to Have:**

* Delivery quality and predictability
* Client satisfaction and stakeholder feedback
* Team productivity and operational efficiency
* SLA/KPI adherence
* Employee engagement, retention, and career progression
* Continuous improvement and innovation outcomes

**About Simeio And What We Do**
Simeio has over 650 talented employees across the globe. We have offices in USA (Atlanta HQ and Texas), India, Canada, Costa Rica and UK.
  
  
Founded in 2007, and now backed by private equity company ZMC, Simeio is recognized as a top IAM provider by industry analysts.
  
  
Alongside Simeio’s identity orchestration tool ‘Simeio IO’ - Simeio also partners with industry leading IAM software vendors to provide access management, identity governance and administration, privileged access management and risk intelligence services across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid technology environments.
  
  
Simeio provides services to numerous Fortune 1000 companies across all industries including financial services, technology, healthcare, media, retail, public sector, utilities and education.

If you require assistance with completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our recruitment team - recruitment@simeio.com.
  
  
**About Your Application**
We carefully review every application we receive. If your skills and experience match our needs, we’ll be in touch. If you don’t hear from us within 10 days, please don’t be discouraged. We may retain your application for future opportunities. We also encourage you to check our careers page for other openings.

**What awaits you/ Job Profile**

* BEV Module Lead, Program Manager, Assistant Chief Engineer – Passenger Car(M1)
Own the complete delivery of Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) programs, providing technical and strategic leadership from concept definition, vehicle architecture, target setting, development, validation, industrialization, and Start of Production (SOP).

  

Serve as the vehicle engineering leader responsible for achieving program objectives related to performance, cost, quality, timing, manufacturability, safety, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction.

  

Lead and align multidisciplinary engineering organizations across HV Battery, E-Powertrain, Charging Systems, Thermal Management, Chassis, Body Structures, Interior & Exterior Systems, Electrical & Electronics, Software, Connectivity, and Vehicle Integration.

Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Purchasing, Quality, Program Management, Finance, Suppliers, and Executive Leadership teams to ensure business objectives are fully aligned with technical delivery.

  

Champion innovation by identifying emerging technologies, industry trends, and competitive benchmarks, translating them into product and engineering strategies that strengthen market competitiveness.

  

Build and develop high-performing engineering teams through technical mentorship, talent development, succession planning, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

  

Act as the primary technical escalation and decision authority, balancing engineering trade-offs to optimize customer value, business performance, program timing, and product profitability.

  

Establish a high-performance engineering culture focused on ownership, execution excellence, rapid decision-making, and first-time-right delivery across all stages of vehicle development.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical, Automotive, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

  

15 to 20 years of automotive product-development and vehicle-engineering experience.

  

Proven delivery of at least 2 complete passenger-car

  

Proven track record in BEV product development, vehicle integration, and complex engineering program leadership.

  

Deep understanding of vehicle systems engineering, electrification technologies, battery systems, powertrain integration, functional safety, homologation, and validation.

  

Demonstrated success managing large cross-functional engineering teams and delivering products within aggressive quality, cost, and timing targets.

  

Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, commercial awareness, and strategic decision-making capabilities.

  

Ability to influence organizational direction and drive transformational improvements across engineering functions.

  

**Must have technical skill**

Skilled in optimizing BEV range, efficiency, performance, charging, driveability, thermal performance, and regenerative braking.

  

Program-level knowledge of BIW, trims, chassis, EE, software, CAS, PQ, service and manufacturing integration.

  

Ability to review and challenge CAE results for crash, HV safety, stiffness, durability, NVH, aerodynamics and thermal performance.

  

Strong command of M1 homologation, functional safety, electrical safety and BEV regulatory compliance.

  

Expertise in vehicle-level cost, mass, quality, complexity, energy budget and technical-risk management.

  

Strong in requirements, reviews, validation, releases, and change management.

  

Decisive leadership with strong prioritization, escalation, conflict resolution and technical trade-off capability.

Skilled in digital validation, virtual vehicle development, homologation, lightweighting, cost optimization, manufacturing readiness, supplier development, and global engineering collaboration.

  

* Professional experience with European organisation, contributing to product development, engineering execution, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Senior Tech Program Manager**

**Program & Delivery Expertise**

* 6-7 years of Technical Program Management experience, ideally in a fintech, SaaS, or capital markets environment
* Demonstrated ability to build project charters and drive programs from ambiguity to delivery with minimal direction
* Proficiency with program management tooling and artifacts: roadmaps, Gantt charts, risk registries, and milestone tracking (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent)
* Strong command of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and familiarity with waterfall delivery where applicable
* Solid understanding of SDLC and how software moves from concept to production

**Technical Fluency**

* Working knowledge of engineering fundamentals — infrastructure, architecture, and system design — sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams
* Familiarity with design principles, APIs, and cloud platforms
* Comfort with AI tools and a creative, curious approach to using them — especially for reporting, documentation, and program communication

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Strong cross-functional coordination skills — comfortable managing relationships across engineering, product, design, and business stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate technical complexity for executive audiences without losing the detail that matters
* High ownership mindset — you treat program outcomes as your own, not someone else’s responsibility
* Genuine team player who builds trust within your immediate team and across stakeholder groups alike

**Nice to Have**

* Direct work experience in capital markets, fintech, or front office environments (order management, portfolio management, or trading systems)
* Experience scaling a TPM function or standing up program management practices in a growing organization
* Familiarity with DevOps practices — useful for infrastructure or platform-adjacent programs
* Experience with budgeting and resource management at the program level
* Familiarity with OKR/KPI frameworks and how to connect program execution to business outcomes
* Technical background — prior development, platform, or systems experience, or active personal coding projects
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification

**Who You Are**

You thrive in ambiguity and build the structure others need. You ask the hard questions early, escalate with context (not just problems), and know the difference between coordinating work and owning it.

You lead with integrity. You show up for your team and your stakeholders with honesty, consistency, and a genuine desire to help them succeed — not just to check a box. You understand that trust is built through follow-through, and you take that seriously.

You are a team player in the truest sense — collaborative within your TPM team and a reliable partner to every stakeholder you work with. You bring people along rather than steamrolling, and you know that the best program outcomes happen when everyone feels heard and aligned.

You’ve operated in fast-moving environments where the org chart doesn’t tell the whole story — and you’ve figured out how to get things done anyway.

* Team focused culture that promotes innovation and ownership
* Access cutting edge investment reporting technology and expertise
* Defined and undefined career pathways allowing you to grow your own way
* Competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Personal Time Off and Volunteer Time Off to give back to the community
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year

8af622e4.title: Technical Program Manager - GIOC
8af622e4.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  
  
**Vultr Cares**

* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is expanding its India presence and building its first Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai — a 24x7 command center for monitoring, triage, coordination, and incident resolution across Vultr's global infrastructure and operations.
  
  
We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the end-to-end build and operational readiness of the GIOC. You will coordinate the onboarding of Systems, Network, Security, Platforms, and Tooling teams, while expanding the command center's scope to include DC Operations, Physical Security/GSOC, SRE, and Corporate IT.
  
  
You will drive cross-functional execution across monitoring, observability, automation, alert correlation, dashboards, operational processes, and team onboarding. Working closely with engineering teams, US-based Program Managers, India leadership, and executive stakeholders, you will ensure that dependencies are managed, decisions are made, risks are surfaced early, and the GIOC is delivered on schedule and ready for 24x7 operations.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The TPM is the program backbone of the GIOC build and transformation. You will own the integrated program plan across multiple technical and operational workstreams, translating strategy into executable plans and ensuring delivery against committed milestones.
  
  
This is a highly technical program-management role. You should understand infrastructure, monitoring, observability, alerting, incident management, and engineering delivery well enough to challenge assumptions, write credible requirements, participate in technical discussions, and identify dependencies and risks — without being responsible for hands-on engineering.
  
  
Success will be measured by GIOC launch readiness, on-time delivery of critical workstreams, successful team onboarding, quality and adoption of program artifacts, automation and dashboard adoption, and proactive resolution of risks and dependencies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**GIOC Program & Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end program management for the GIOC build, transformation, and operational-readiness roadmap.
* Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate multiple parallel workstreams across Systems, Network, Security, Platforms, Tooling, DC Ops, Physical Security/GSOC, SRE, and Corp IT.
* Track execution against committed milestones and proactively course-correct schedule, scope, and resource risks.
* Serve as the central point of accountability for overall GIOC program status.

GIOC Onboarding & Operational Readiness
  
  

* Coordinate onboarding of technical and operational teams into the GIOC.
* Define onboarding plans, milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and operational readiness gates.
* Establish clear handoff requirements between engineering teams and GIOC operations.
* Track monitoring, alerting, escalation, documentation, access, staffing, and operational readiness requirements.
* Drive cutover, go-live, and post-launch hypercare activities. Automation, Observability & Consolidated Monitoring
* Drive cross-functional programs for automation, alert correlation, observability, and operational tooling.
* Coordinate delivery of a consolidated monitoring and operational dashboard covering onboarded GIOC services.
* Track dashboard coverage, alert quality, automation adoption, and identified observability gaps.
* Partner with engineering teams to prioritize improvements based on operational impact.

**Technical Requirements & Documentation**

* Author clear and actionable PRDs for GIOC tooling, dashboards, automation, integrations, and operational capabilities.
* Translate operational requirements into engineering-ready requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain program plans, decision logs, RAID logs, requirements traceability, and operational readiness documentation.
* Ensure key architectural, process, and scope decisions are documented and communicated.

Agile Execution & Engineering Partnership
  
  

* Translate program priorities into sprint-level execution in partnership with engineering teams.
* Challenge estimates, dependencies, assumptions, and delivery risks when required.
* Ensure engineering deliverables remain aligned with operational requirements and GIOC objectives.

**Stakeholder & Executive Management**

* Partner with US-based Program Managers and engineering leaders to align priorities, dependencies, and timelines across geographies.
* Coordinate India-based stakeholders across Infrastructure Operations, Engineering, Security, SRE, DC Operations, GSOC, and Corp IT.
* Prepare executive-level program reviews covering progress, risks, decisions, dependencies, and required actions.

b1e8d426.title: Technical Program Manager
b1e8d426.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Technical Program Manager in GitLab’s R&D organization, you’ll lead cross functional initiatives that help teams deliver reliably, efficiently, and at scale. You’ll own programs that cut across multiple product stages and engineering teams, turning strategic priorities into clear plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving progress in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You’ll use GitLab issues, epics, and handbook-first documentation to create visibility, remove blockers, and keep complex work moving across time zones, while partnering closely with Engineering Leadership at all levels. In your first year, you’ll be expected to independently run a portfolio of programs from scoping through delivery and retrospectives, and to improve how R&D programs operate by contributing to and evolving Technical Program Management best practices.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead 1–3 strategic technical programs at a time spanning multiple engineering teams and product stages, ensuring clear scope, priorities, and outcomes.
* Partner with engineering leaders and other key stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and delivery milestones for cross functional initiatives.
* Own end-to-end program planning and execution, from initial discovery and scoping through delivery, measurement, and retrospectives.
* Drive asynchronous collaboration using GitLab issues, epics, and handbook updates so globally distributed teams stay aligned and informed.
* Identify risks and blockers early, coordinate resolution across teams, and escalate when needed to maintain momentum.
* Facilitate working group meetings and async discussions to support decision-making, surface tradeoffs, and keep programs on track.
* Track and communicate program health through metrics, dashboards, and regular status updates to provide visibility to the Engineering Division and partners.
* Contribute to evolving Technical Program Management practices by documenting processes, sharing learnings, and improving how R&D programs run across GitLab.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience in technical program management, project management, software engineering, or similar technical roles.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile ways of working, including how engineering teams plan, build, and ship.
* Skill in coordinating programs across multiple engineering teams or departments, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, and milestones.
* Strong written communication skills for asynchronous, documentation-first collaboration in a fully remote environment.
* Ability to work independently in a distributed setting, set priorities, and make progress with minimal supervision.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying blockers, and proposing practical solutions to keep programs moving.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or platforms like GitLab, with interest in deepening this knowledge over time.
* Openness to learning, iterating based on feedback, and applying transferable skills from varied backgrounds to technical program management.

**About The Team**
You’ll join the R&D organization as part of the Technical Program Management function, a small, cross-functional team that leads high-impact programs spanning multiple product stages and departments. The team focuses on driving clarity, alignment, and predictable delivery for complex initiatives that touch many parts of GitLab, using a handbook-first, asynchronous way of working with stakeholders across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and partners in other functions to improve how programs are planned, executed, and communicated, helping evolve shared practices, templates, and tooling for program governance across R&D.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

815bd148.title: Program Manager
815bd148.description:
**About The Business**
Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
  
  
Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group.
  
  
The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’
  
  
**Overview**
The Program Management will lead strategic and operational programs supporting the TEPL OSAT Assam plant start-up, ramp-up, and manufacturing operations. This role will partner closely with the Program Manager, Business Head, and cross-functional leadership teams to drive execution excellence, operational readiness, risk management, and stakeholder alignment across multiple business-critical initiatives.
  
  
The position requires a seasoned professional capable of independently managing complex workstreams, driving accountability across functions, resolving escalations, and ensuring timely delivery of key business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership & Execution**

* Lead and drive multiple cross-functional programs and strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
* Develop, maintain, and govern integrated project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Ensure alignment of project objectives with business priorities and operational requirements.
* Lead reviews, governance forums, and leadership discussions when required.

**Strategic Planning & Decision Support**

* Drive program reviews, executive updates, and governance mechanisms for leadership.
* Conduct scenario analysis, capacity assessments, and decision-making support for critical business initiatives.
* Prepare executive-level presentations, business cases, and strategic recommendations.

**Risk & Issue Management**

* Establish and maintain comprehensive risk registers and mitigation plans.
* Proactively identify program risks, resource constraints, and execution challenges.
* Lead escalation management and coordinate timely resolution across stakeholders.

**Operational Readiness & Factory Ramp**

* Drive manufacturing readiness activities for plant start-up, equipment qualification, new product introduction (NPI), and volume ramp.
* Monitor operational KPIs and readiness metrics across Engineering, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Facilities, and EHS functions.
* Ensure smooth transition from project execution into sustained operations.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Coordinate and influence cross-functional teams to achieve program goals.
* Drive accountability through structured action tracking and management reviews.
* Facilitate alignment between Projects, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Facilities, and Business teams.

**Governance & Performance Management**

* Establish program dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting systems.
* Conduct regular project health reviews and critical path assessments.
* Support development and implementation of PMO best practices and governance frameworks.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support customer reviews, audits, business visits, and executive presentations.
* Manage communication with internal and external stakeholders.
* Represent Program Management in customer discussions and operational reviews as needed.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead initiatives focused on operational excellence, process improvements, and productivity enhancement.
* Drive lessons learned, standardization, and implementation of best practices across programs.
* Support digitalization and automation of program management processes and reporting.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
* 10-15+ years of experience in Program Management, Manufacturing Operations, Plant Start-up, Industrial Engineering, PMO, or related leadership roles.
* Experience in Semiconductor, Electronics Manufacturing, Automotive, EMS, OSAT, or other high-technology manufacturing environments preferred.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Power BI, and data analysis tools.
* PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Proven experience managing complex cross-functional programs with executive stakeholder engagement.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, commissioning, risk management, NPI, ramp-up, and operational readiness processes.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
* Excellent leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to independently drive initiatives with limited supervision.
* Executive-level communication and presentation skills.
* High ownership mindset with strong execution focus.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-changing environments.
* Proven ability to lead through influence rather than direct authority.
* Results-oriented, resilient, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously
