**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
We are looking for an accomplished Senior Program Manager (SPM) to lead large-scale, complex telecom delivery programs across Packet Core and Cloud Native Infrastructure Solutions (CNIS) for a Tier-1 telecommunications customer.
  
  
This is a senior customer-facing leadership role responsible for driving end-to-end program execution, delivery excellence, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes. The role requires strong program governance, telecom technical understanding, commercial awareness, and the ability to lead cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex Packet Core and CNIS programs, from planning and mobilization through deployment, integration, migration, testing, acceptance, handover, and closure.
  
  
Act as a trusted customer partner, building strong relationships with customer executives, technical teams, operations, internal leadership, suppliers, and partners.
  
  
Translate customer requirements and contractual commitments into clear program roadmaps, delivery plans, milestones, governance models, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Lead cross-functional teams across Packet Core, CNIS, Network Management, integration, deployment, testing, and operations.
  
  
Own overall program performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risks, dependencies, change, and customer acceptance.
  
  
Establish strong program and financial governance through executive reviews, steering forums, forecasting, reporting, decision-making, and action tracking.
  
  
Proactively identify and manage technical, delivery, commercial, resource, security, and operational risks, driving mitigation, escalation, and recovery plans.
  
  
Manage changes to scope, timelines, resources, and commercial commitments through appropriate governance and approval processes.
  
  
Align resource demand and capacity with delivery priorities, ensuring the right capabilities are available at the right time.
  
  
Ensure quality, compliance, delivery readiness, customer acceptance, and a controlled transition into operations and support.
  
  
Partner with account, solution, product, commercial, and delivery teams to ensure continuity from solutioning and sales handover through execution.
  
  
Manage multiple delivery streams using Hybrid Delivery Models, including Factory Model and resource-based delivery.
  
  
Monitor and drive operational and delivery KPIs, including A&I, SSAT, SSP adoption, and CI/CD adoption.
  
  
**The Skills You Bring**
15+ years of experience leading large and complex customer-facing telecom delivery programs, preferably for Tier-1 telecommunications operators.
  
  
Strong knowledge of Packet Core, 4G/5G Core Network, Cloud Native Infrastructure/CNIS, and Network Management environments.
  
  
Experience across deployment, integration, migration, upgrades, testing, CI/CD, operational readiness, and service transition.
  
  
Proven ability to deliver against contractual commitments while managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risks, dependencies, and change.
  
  
Strong executive-level customer and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and drive fact-based decisions.
  
  
Strong program governance and financial management capabilities, including planning, forecasting, budgeting, performance reporting, risk management, and escalation management.
  
  
Experience leading matrixed, multicultural, cross-functional, and geographically distributed teams.
  
  
Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, or SAFe are preferred; equivalent practical experience is also valued.
  
  
Practical experience with program and project management tools such as SAP, Microsoft Project, estimation tools, Erimatch, GC, and related platforms.

To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

4b7211f1.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 5 years of experience with carbon accounting and methodologies or energy markets.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience in climate science, Green House Gas (GHG) Standards and accounting, or the energy industry.
* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience leading and executing complex strategic and operational initiatives for large organizations.
* Experience developing data-driven insights and translating and presenting these into meaningful recommendations for multiple audiences, including the C-Suite level.
* High-sense of organization and oriented towards execution.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
APAC is a key region of focus for our operational and value chain decarbonization roadmap, as well as other climate-related goals.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for leading strategic projects and provide clear, high-impact analysis and deliverables that help to evolve our regional strategy and accelerate carbon reduction. As part of these efforts, you will turn strategic insights/recommendations into action by working with various stakeholders, including key cross-functional leadership. You will partner with external experts to shape our perspective on carbon, energy, and other efforts and enable the broader decarbonization ecosystem.
  
  
The Global Sustainability team enables Google to build a more sustainable future for everyone by driving strategy and solutions. We drive the development and implementation of Google’s global sustainability strategy to further empower action, ensure alignment and prioritization, identify leadership opportunities, and mitigate risks. We drive sustainability strategy and programs on carbon, circular economy, water, product integration, reporting, and employee engagement, while serving as a sustainability leadership advocate internally and externally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic and technical oversight for our carbon reduction, clean energy, and water strategy in APAC.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to develop and execute strategic initiatives in pursuit of Google’s net zero and related sustainability commitments.
* Lead efforts with external experts and industry partners to drive progress on regional climate priorities.
* Manage an evolving portfolio of strategic projects and initiatives that advance the climate operations organization and enable its core objectives.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. 00001c50.title: Solutions Engineer
00001c50.description:
**Meet the Team**
You will be in Global Enterprise Segment (GES) where we lead Cisco's top 500 strategic accounts. Our responsibility to Cisco’s business is phenomenal, and our responsibility to each other and our culture is greater. We have a dedicated focus on our customers' success, we are Cisco's growth engine and shape the company’s future. Our values customer focused Always, Show Up to Win Every Day, and Harness the Power of Cisco is how we get the job done, and our Win As One mentality embodies the spirit of the journey and how we will show up with each other, partners, and customers.
  
  
**Your Impact**
We are looking for a Solutions Engineer (SE) with Enterprise Networking, Data Center, Collaboration, Security, Automation, and Cloud background. The SE role is a customer focused technical sales professional who ensures that technical information and guidance is provided to the customer, delivering meaningful outcomes based on Cisco’s product and services portfolio. You will partner with your Account Managers in a pre-sales technical function, showcasing Cisco solutions, providing customer presentations, performing technical demonstrations, creating BoM’s, and running proof of concept activities. SE’s partner, consult, influence and design solutions to allow the customer to meet their desired outcomes. In addition to technology proficiency and the ability to learn quickly and stay ahead of; the ideal candidate's interpersonal, presentation and troubleshooting skills should evoke passion and confidence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technology solution consultant to the customer and the Cisco account team.
* Leverage an array of Cisco technology, services, and support specialists.
* Collaborate closely with Account Manager on account planning activities.
* Educate the customer on Cisco differentiation, creating demand.
* Set brand preference to Cisco.
* Align Cisco’s product and services capabilities to customers business drivers.
* You are determined and have a long history in the Networking field.
* You will also have a strong background in large enterprises and/or large service provider IT accounts and understand how to engage new lines of business to drive understanding and preference to Cisco's Routing & Switching, Data Center, Security, and Internet of Things solutions.
* Strong business acumen and customer presence.
* Experience and comfort conversing with network and telecommunications managers as well as customer lines of business on Data Center, Security, and Retail solutions.
* As a Solutions Engineer, you'll be responsible for driving customer activities and discussions that lead to preference of Cisco's Routing & Switching, Data Center, Security, and Automation solutions.
* The focus of this position is to uncover business benefits for a customer by consulting on Cisco solutions and applications to solve business problems, working with multi-functional teams to design and present appropriate technical solution, and building joint plan of record for multiple engineering systems using Cisco products.
* You'll plan sales strategy, develop proposals, deliver customer presentations and demonstrations to close business and generate revenue.
* While customer facing engagements will be the primary role, other duties will include training colleagues on Data Center, Virtualization and MOCA topics and practices. Developing best practices in sales approaches and technical execution.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering or the broader computing/IT industry, with a strong focus on Cisco Enterprise Routing & Switching, Data Center, and Security solutions.
* In-depth knowledge of large IT environments and applications.
* Deep understanding and operational experience with a routed and switched data/voice network.
* Cisco product experience or relevant experience in key competitor offerings in technology area of emphasis required.
* Minimum CCNP or similar vendor certification required.
* Knowledge of Cisco's Solutions, networking fundamentals required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pre-Sales experience preferred.
* Typically requires BS/BA (EE/CS) or equivalent.
* Customer intimacy skills

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

c2ca3125.description:

When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM
  
  
Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Solution Architect – EMEA is responsible for designing innovative, scalable, and commercially viable IT solutions for enterprise customers across the EMEA region. Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Technology Partners, and Customers, this role drives solution design, presales strategy, proposal development, and customer presentations to help secure new business and accelerate growth.
  
  
What you’ll do as the [Solution Architect – EMEA]:
  
  
The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of the duties and responsibilities of the position, and the duties and responsibilities may change without notice.
  
  

* Create the Solution Design and Offering pitch.
* Work with technology vendors and create a collaboration plan & execution plan.
* Work with the internal delivery team for solution review and signoff.
* Work with the sales team for account identification and planning.
* Run the sales enablement initiative to educate the sales and presales team.
* Qualify incoming opportunities based on capabilities, risk, timelines
* Understand all dimensions of scope of the opportunity in its minutest detail – hardware, software, services, geography, time.
* Clearly identify variables that impact the solution and elicit all required clarifications from the client.
* Work with the proposal team to ensure that the solution that has been architected and priced is articulated in a compelling manner in the appropriate submission/presentation format.
* Participate remotely or in person in solution presentations / walk-throughs with clients.
* Develop/improve processes, tools, and metrics that enhance the quality, speed, and productivity of the solutioning processes.
* Craft solution design and effort estimation for Smart hands and feet support, (Installation, Commissioning, and Testing) of EUC, Audio - Visual and Video Conferencing Systems.
* Knowledge of products and systems such as EUC, Audio - Visual, Video Conferencing , Digital signage, POS devices, UPS, etc
* Work with field services partners for solutions and pricing.
* Knowledge of products and systems such as Audio - Visual Systems, Video walls, Digital signage, POS devices, UPS, etc.
* Eye for detail and competitive intelligence in ensuring that effort estimation, pricing, scope, and assumptions strike the right balance between the ability to win it as well as the ability to deliver it.
* Ability to create competitive proposals that reflect thought leadership and alternate creative options (when required).
* Strong presentation, public speaking and written articulation skills

**What You Will Bring To The Team**

* 10+ years of professional experience in information technology pre-sales or solution architecture with leading Technology Consulting firms
* Experience should span Hardware, Software, and Services – Professional Services and Managed Services ranging from small quick turnaround proposals to those that can span a few hundred million dollars
* Ability to articulate the solution in a compelling manner in written responses, solution presentations, and when necessary presenting the solution in an oral presentation to the client
* Deep understanding of cost and price benchmarks for products and services
* Ability to price proposals competitively thru global delivery coupled with a thorough understanding of cost-to-win and price-to-win benchmarks
* Strong knowledge of the product vendors and services providers in the IT space as well as strong knowledge of the competitive landscape.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills
* Experience working in a globally distributed team.

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.

cf588bc0.title: Principal Solution Consultant
cf588bc0.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is an AI-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market-leading company with double-digit growth and a blue-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
  
  
As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
  
  
In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

What You'll Need
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21), and Advanced Process Control (APC) & Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals & Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food & Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Power Generation, and Water & Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning & Scheduling - Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies. Regional travel up to 35%.

Job requirements include but are not limited to the following activities; RFI/RFP preparation, opportunity & account planning, technical liaison (representing Sales) to Professional Services / Partners and APAC TEs / Product Management teams, demonstrations, joint partner solutions etc. Solution Consultant plays a vital role in establishing and supporting the technical sales relationship with prospects & clients. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

7c632d47.title: Program Manager – Identity & Access Management (IAM)
7c632d47.description:
Seeking a results-driven **Program Manager – Identity & Access Management (IAM)** to lead and coordinate enterprise IAM programs for clients in India and global markets.

The ideal candidate will combine strong program and project management capabilities with a solid understanding of enterprise identity security solutions, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM).

This role requires ownership of program planning, governance, delivery execution, risk management, financial tracking, vendor coordination, stakeholder engagement, and client reporting. The successful candidate will work closely with IAM architects, engineering teams, business analysts, security leaders, and external partners to ensure programs are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives and security requirements.

Candidates should demonstrate the ability to manage multiple workstreams, maintain executive-level visibility, resolve delivery challenges, and translate complex IAM initiatives into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

1. IAM Program and Project Delivery

* Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise IAM programs across multiple clients, business units, and geographic regions.
* Define program scope, objectives, delivery roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, and success metrics.
* Manage multiple IAM workstreams and ensure alignment between technical implementation, business requirements, and security objectives.
* Monitor delivery progress, identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and implement corrective actions to maintain timelines.
* Drive program execution using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies, depending on project requirements.

2. IAM Technical and Functional Oversight

* Provide program-level oversight across core IAM, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM) initiatives.
* Coordinate implementation and integration activities involving SSO, MFA, identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, access certification, and privileged access controls.
* Work with technical teams implementing platforms such as Okta, Ping Identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, and BeyondTrust.
* Ensure technical deliverables, integration dependencies, and implementation milestones align with the approved solution architecture.
* Facilitate communication between business stakeholders, security teams, architects, engineers, and platform vendors.
* Identify technical delivery risks and coordinate resolution with the relevant subject-matter experts.

3. Program Governance and Performance Management

* Establish and maintain program governance frameworks, reporting structures, delivery reviews, and escalation mechanisms.
* Track KPIs, milestones, deliverables, resource utilization, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, steering committee updates, and status presentations.
* Maintain RAID logs and ensure risks and issues have clear owners, mitigation plans, and resolution timelines.
* Drive accountability across workstream leads and ensure adherence to governance standards and delivery commitments.

4. Financial Management and Commercial Oversight

* Monitor program budgets, resource costs, financial forecasts, and delivery performance against approved plans.
* Track financial performance, commercial commitments, and project profitability in coordination with relevant teams.
* Support client invoicing milestones, billing coordination, and timely validation of completed deliverables.
* Identify potential budget overruns, scope changes, and resource constraints, recommending appropriate corrective actions.
* Ensure financial reporting and commercial documentation remain accurate and up to date.

5. Client and Stakeholder Management

* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, including senior management, security leaders, business owners, and operational teams.
* Lead program review meetings, stakeholder workshops, steering committee discussions, and executive updates.
* Communicate progress, delivery risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Manage expectations, resolve escalations, and ensure alignment on scope, timelines, priorities, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and strengthen client confidence through transparent delivery management.

6. Resource, Vendor and Team Coordination

* Coordinate cross-functional teams comprising IAM engineers, solution architects, business analysts, project managers, and vendor partners.
* Support resource planning, allocation, capacity management, and delivery prioritization across multiple workstreams.
* Monitor vendor performance, delivery commitments, dependencies, and contractual obligations.
* Facilitate collaboration between internal teams, client organizations, and third-party service providers.
* Promote accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across delivery teams.

7. Risk, Compliance and Delivery Assurance

* Identify and manage program risks relating to delivery timelines, integrations, dependencies, resources, costs, and stakeholder expectations.
* Ensure IAM initiatives align with organizational security policies, access governance requirements, and applicable compliance obligations.
* Coordinate audit readiness, evidence collection, control validation, and remediation tracking where required.
* Ensure appropriate change management, issue escalation, and quality assurance processes are followed.
* Drive lessons learned and improvement initiatives to enhance future program delivery.

**Mandatory Skills and Experience:-**

Candidates should possess the following skills and capabilities:

**Program and Project Management**

* 6–8 years of relevant professional experience, with substantial experience in project or program delivery.
* Experience managing complex technology initiatives, multiple workstreams, project plans, milestones, and dependencies.
* Strong program governance, risk management, financial tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
* Proven stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and escalation management skills.
* Practical experience with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

**Identity & Access Management**

* Strong understanding of enterprise IAM concepts, architectures, and implementation lifecycles.
* Knowledge of SSO, MFA, identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, and access governance.
* Understanding of IGA platforms such as SailPoint and Saviynt.
* Understanding of PAM solutions such as CyberArk and BeyondTrust.
* Familiarity with SSO and MFA platforms such as Okta and Ping Identity.
* Ability to coordinate technical teams and track IAM implementation deliverables, risks, integrations, and dependencies.

**Communication and Leadership**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to engage with senior client stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and maintain delivery focus in a dynamic environment.

**Preferred Certifications:-**

Candidates with one or more of the following certifications will be preferred:

* Project Management Professional (PMP)
* PRINCE2 or Program Management Professional (PgMP)
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or SAFe certification
* ITIL certification

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you hold PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, CSM/SAFe, or ITIL certifications?
* What hands-on or program-level experience do you have with IAM, IGA, and PAM solutions? Please specify your exposure to Okta, Ping Identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, and/or BeyondTrust, including SSO and MFA implementations.
* How many years of experience do you have in program or project management, particularly in enterprise IAM initiatives?
* What are your current and expected annual CTC (in LPA)?
* What is your current notice period, and what is your earliest possible joining date? Are you available to join within 15–30 days?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* in managing and delivering large-scale (IAM) programs. : 6 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

5c808fef.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training ,Speech AI ,Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI . As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing agentic and RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on Speech AI, LLMs, Agentic and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of speech AI , LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs) ,Speech AI
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM ,Speech AI models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Proven ability to optimize LLM models ,Speech models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. **Job Summary:**

We are seeking a
**Senior Solution Architect**
to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers. This is a customer-facing, consulting-oriented role where you will engage with CDOs, Data Architects, and Engineering leaders to design and deliver scalable, future-ready Lakehouse solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

You will be the trusted technical advisor — translating business problems into architectural blueprints, guiding customers through EDW modernization programs, and championing the adoption of Databricks' most advanced capabilities including Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP), Lakeflow Connect, Serverless Compute, Unity Catalog, and AI/BI workloads.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Lead pre-sales and delivery architecture conversations with enterprise customers, owning the technical narrative from discovery through solution design and through implementation oversight.

2. Design end-to-end Databricks Lakehouse architectures spanning ingestion, transformation, governance, ML, and consumption layers — aligned to Medallion Architecture principles.

3. Drive EDW modernization engagements, including migration strategies from legacy platforms (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, SAS, Greenplum, Synapse, Snowflake,

on-prem Hadoop) to Databricks, with clear wave planning, risk mitigation, and TCO/ROI articulation.

4. Advise customers on the adoption of advanced Databricks features.

5. Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP / formerly DLT) for production-grade ETL with

built-in data quality and lineage.

6. Lakeflow Connect for managed ingestion from SaaS, databases, and file sources.

7. Serverless Compute (SQL warehouses, jobs, notebooks) for cost and operational efficiency.

8. Unity Catalog for unified governance, lineage, and fine-grained access control.

9. Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB) for CI/CD and environment promotion

10. Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self-service analytics

11. Expertise in Data Bulid Tool (DBT) and Databricks Autoloader

12. Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self-service analytics

13. MLflow, Model Serving, and Mosaic AI for ML and GenAI workloads

14. Conduct architecture deep-dives, PoCs, and workshops — including cost modelling roadmaps, runbooks and executive presentations.

15. Produce Client ready deliverables. HLD / LLD documents, reference architecture, migration road maps, runbook and execution presentations

16. Partner with sales, delivery, and Databricks field teams to shape proposals, SoWs, and bid responses.

17. Stay ahead of the Databricks product roadmap and evangelize new capabilities internally and with customers.

18. Mentor data engineers, platform engineers, and junior architects on Databricks best practices.

**Qualifications**

• 8+ years in data engineering / data platform architecture, with 3+ years hands-on on Databricks in a customer-facing or consulting capacity.

• Demonstrated experience leading at least 2–3 large- scale EDW modernization or Lakehouse migration programs end to end.

• Strong, fundamentals-level understanding of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

• Delta Lake internals (transaction log, OPTIMIZE, Z- order, Liquid Clustering, Deletion Vector, Predictive Optimization)

• Spark execution model, Photon, cluster sizing, and performance tuning.

• Unity Catalog object model (metastore, catalogs, schemas, volumes, external locations, stor age credentials).

• Workspace, account, and identity architecture across AWS / Azure / GCP.

• Handson experience designing and deploying Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Conn ect, and Serverless workloads in production.

• Solid grounding in Medallion Architecture, dimensional modeling, and data governance fra meworks.

• Strong SQL and PySpark skills; comfort reading and reasoning about Spark execution plans.

• Cloud fluency on at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP

including networking, IAM, and storage layers (ADLS Gen2 / S3 / GCS).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills able to engage equally with engineers and C- suite.

• Willing to travel and stay overseas for Solutioning and Delivering projects.

**Required Skills**

• Databricks certifications: Certified Data Engineer Professional, Certified Machine Learning Pr ofessional, or Databricks Certified Solutions Architect Professional.

• Experience with DR architectures (Delta Deep Clone, cross-region replication, RPO/RTO design).

• Exposure to MLOps / GenAI patterns on Databricks (MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Mosaic AI Agent Framework)

• Familiarity with legacy ETL/ELT platforms (Informatica, ODI, SAS DI, DataStage, Talend) for migration credibility.

• Experience with Terraform / Databricks Asset Bundles for IaC and CI/CD.

• Working knowledge of Immuta, Collibra, Purview, or Alation for governance integration.

• Industry depth in BFSI, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, or Healthcare.

d52f68cb.title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor_Cloud Service Activation and AWS
d52f68cb.description:
**Req ID:**
382894
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor\_Cloud Service Activation and AWS to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Position Summary- Total 8 Years’s of experience is needed**
We are seeking a
**Senior Cloud Engineer**
to architect design, build, and operate a secure, scalable, and highly automated multi-cloud platform leveraging
**Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**
,
**Amazon Web Services (AWS)**
, and
**Microsoft Azure.**
As a key technical leader, you will drive the evolution of our multi-cloud engineering, enabling resilient, cloud-native services that support mission-critical enterprise workloads.
  
  
This role requires deep expertise in
**cloud architecture, infrastructure as code (IaC), and distributed systems engineering**
, with a strong focus on
**Terraform-driven automation**
and platform standardization. The ideal candidate brings
**strong Kubernetes**
, IAM, networking, and policy management experience, along with a disciplined approach to security, reliability, and cost optimization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Engineering, Design & Architecture**
Architect, engineer, and implement scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions across
**GCP and AWS, with Azure as a plus**
. Engineer multi-region, highly available architectures aligned with enterprise standards and best practices.
  
  
**Infrastructure Automation & IaC**
Lead engineering, adoption, and development of
**Terraform-based infrastructure as code**
, ensuring consistency, compliance, and reusability. Build and maintain modular Terraform frameworks for provisioning cloud infrastructure. Integrate IaC into CI/CD pipelines to enable fully automated provisioning and deployment workflows.
  
  
**Containerization & Kubernetes Platforms**
Direct knowledge and engineering leveraging Kubernetes platforms (
**EKS, GKE**
) and associated ecosystems. Implementation of container orchestration best practices including scaling, observability, and security.
  
  
**Identity, Access & Security Governance**
Experienced working knowledge architecting and designing robust
**IAM strategies**
across GCP and AWS including least-privilege access models. Implement policy frameworks for access control, resource governance, and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Networking & Connectivity**
Direct knowledge and experience architecting, designing, and engineering cloud networking solutions including
**VPC/VNet design, routing, peering, VPNs, and private connectivity**
. Ensure secure, high-performance connectivity between cloud environments and on-premises systems.
  
  
**Policy Management & Governance**
Deep understanding of policy management, policy-as-code frameworks to ensure consistent governance of resources, tagging strategies, and compliance controls. Collaboration with governance, policy, and security teams to ensure cloud environments meet enterprise and regulatory standards.
  
  
**Modernization & Mentorship**
Champion cloud-native and platform engineering best practices across the organization. Drive the evolution of platform engineering practice by incorporating infrastructure-as-code (IaC) principles. Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership for complex cloud initiatives. Serve as an escalation point for critical cloud infrastructure and platform issues.
  
  
**Required Qualifications & Skills**
**Cloud Platforms & Architecture**

* Extensive firsthand experience with AWS and GCP in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in cloud architecture, including high availability, disaster recovery, and multi-region design.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native services and distributed systems principles.
* AWSControl tower and landing Zones.

**Infrastructure as Code & Automation**

* Advanced proficiency in Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management.
* Experience designing reusable modules and managing Terraform state at scale.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tooling and Git-based workflows.

**Kubernetes & Container Platforms**

* Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS, GKE) and container ecosystems.
* Knowledge of Helm, service meshes, and container security best practices.

**Identity & Access Management (IAM)**

* Deep understanding of IAM concepts in AWS and GCP, including roles, policies, and federation.
* Experience implementing RBAC and least-privilege access models at scale.

**Networking & Core Infrastructure**

* Strong knowledge of cloud networking concepts: VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience designing secure network architectures across multi-cloud and hybrid environments.

**Policy Management & Governance(382993)**

* Direct experience with policy enforcement frameworks and governance models in AWS and GCP.
* Familiarity with policy-as-code tools and compliance automation practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* At least 8 to 10 years' experience engineering infrastructure in a multi-cloud environment, experience with modern cloud-native technologies, such as container orchestration platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes,) and public cloud experiences are an advantage.
* Experience operating within highly regulated environments, with a strong grasp of data privacy, compliance frameworks, and disaster recovery architectures.
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD).

cf1fd870.title: Application Architect-AWS Cloud Migration
cf1fd870.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Architect specializing in AWS Cloud Migration, you will lead the design and delivery of cloud migration solutions for multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and ICP. You will guide the development of migration strategies, tools, and network requirements for hybrid cloud platforms.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Lead Migration Architecture Design: Develop and implement migration architecture solutions for multi-cloud environments, ensuring seamless integration with AWS and other cloud platforms.
* Design Migration Strategy: Collaborate with the team to create effective migration strategies, selecting the right tools and methods for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.
* Adopt Migration Methodology: Lead the adoption of migration methodologies, tailoring approaches to client environments and industries, and providing expert guidance on method adoption workshops.
* Provide Technical Expertise: Offer significant contributions to Migration Project Managers on technical elements, including WBS, estimation, migration risk, dependencies, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
* Map Client Requirements: Utilize deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Migration Solution Design: Experience with designing and delivering cloud migration solutions for multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and ICP, with a focus on hybrid cloud platforms.
* Migration Strategy Development: Experience in developing effective migration strategies, including selecting the right tools and methods for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.
* Migration Methodology Adoption: Experience leading the adoption of migration methodologies, tailoring approaches to client environments and industries, and providing expert guidance on method adoption workshops.
* Technical Expertise in Migration: Experience providing significant contributions to Migration Project Managers on technical elements, including WBS, estimation, migration risk, dependencies, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
* AWS Platform Knowledge: Deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Deep Knowledge of Azure: Experience with Azure platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into Azure-specific services and configurations.
* Familiarity with ICP: Exposure to ICP platform and service catalog, with understanding of how to integrate ICP with other cloud platforms.
* Containerization Expertise: Experience with containerization methods and tools, including selecting the right approach for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.

8e1202d3.title: Tech S and T-Cloud AI Platform Architect-ISR-Manager-GDSF02
8e1202d3.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description – Manager (Cloud AI Platform Architect)**
**Experience:**
10–13 years
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy & Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands-on cloud and AI platform architect expertise with consulting excellence, driving end-to-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering and Architecture Leadership

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
+ Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
+ Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
+ Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
+ Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
+ Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.

* Client & Stakeholder Management

+ Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
+ Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
+ Build trusted relationships through hands-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption

* Cloud, Automation & Deployment Engineering Leadership

+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
+ Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
+ Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

* MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

* Asset and Accelerator Development

+ Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
+ Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

* Business Development & GTM Initiatives

+ Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
+ Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
+ Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

* Program Governance & Delivery Excellence

+ Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
+ Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
+ Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

* Practice Development & Team Leadership


+ Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
+ Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
+ Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**
**Education:**

* B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).

**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming & APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security & Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

**AI and Data Science Certifications (Good to have):**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect
* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications

**Consulting & Leadership Experience:**

* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi-cloud architecture programs.

**Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.
* Leadership of diverse technical teams with clear delivery focus.

**Portfolio Requirements:**
Hands-on experience in building production-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

a0e5953c.description:

These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. Youll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

**Position Summary**

**Level: Associate Architect**

As an Associate Architect at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

As a Cloud Strategy practitioner, you will be responsible for working collaboratively within integrated cross functional teams to deliver comprehensive strategies that enable Cloud and Infrastructure Transformations.

**Work youll do:**

Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.

* Expertise in J2EE and Spring Boot:
* Strong proficiency in Java/J2EE frameworks, with a focus on Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Cloud.
* Extensive experience in developing scalable, high-performance enterprise applications using J2EE.
* Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure):
* Deep understanding and hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation) or Azure (App Services, Kubernetes Service, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Azure Functions).
* Proficiency in designing and deploying microservices architectures on cloud platforms.
* Microservices Architecture:
* Strong expertise in building and managing microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Netflix (Eureka, Hystrix, Zuul, Ribbon), and REST/GraphQL APIs.
* Experience with inter-service communication using gRPC or Kafka.
* Performance Optimization:
* Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, and optimizing applications for performance using tools like JMeter, Java Flight Recorder..
* Expertise in JVM tuning, memory management, and SQL query optimization.
* DevOps Practices and CI/CD:
* Hands-on experience with DevOps tools and methodologies, including:
* CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline.
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible.
* Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk.
* Database and Data Storage:
* Expertise in relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server.
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, DynamoDB, or Cosmos DB.
* Code Reviews and Best Practices:
* Expertise in conducting thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry-standard best practices.
* Proficiency in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using tools like SonarQube or PMD for static code analysis.
* API Management and Security:
* Experience in designing and managing APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or API Gateway.
* Knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2, JWT, and SAML.
* System Architecture and Design:
* Strong experience in architecting scalable, distributed systems using microservices, event-driven architectures, and domain-driven design (DDD).
* Proficiency in creating technical design documents and architectural diagrams using tools like Visio, Lucidchart, or Archimate.
* Continuous Learning and Collaboration:
* Commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in Java, J2EE, and cloud-native technologies.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps) to ensure alignment and deliver high-quality solutions.

**The team:**

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

d5fdd8a6.description:
**Overview**
TekWissen is a global workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world. The below job opportunity is to one of our clients who is a part of a trusted global innovator of IT and business services headquartered in Tokyo. We help clients transform through consulting, industry solutions, business process services, IT modernization and managed services. This client enables us to move confidently into the digital future. This client committed to Long Term success and combine global reach with local client attention to serve them in over 50 Countries.
  
  
**Position: Agile Delivery Manager**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Work Type: Hybrid**
**Job Type: Full Time**
**Job Description**

* Finance AI Strategy & Innovation | Brief Job Description

**Role Intent**

* A hands-on delivery leader who can shape a new squad, turn an undefined AI opportunity into an executable plan, and own delivery outcomes while continuing to lead core Scrum activities.

**Role purpose**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of a Finance AI Strategy squad operating in a complex and evolving environment.
* The role will establish the squad, delivery approach, governance and working rhythm, translating business problems into prioritised, measurable outcomes from discovery and experimentation through implementation and adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own delivery from problem definition and discovery through planning, build, testing, release, adoption and outcome tracking.
* Shape the squad from the ground up, clarifying purpose, roles, accountabilities, decision rights and ways of working.
* Translate ambiguous business and AI opportunities into a clear roadmap, prioritised backlog, milestones and achievable delivery plans.
* Manage scope, capacity, risks, assumptions, dependencies, blockers and trade-offs, escalating early with clear options and recommendations.
* Lead stakeholder alignment across Finance, Product, Data, Architecture, Engineering, Risk and third-party suppliers.
* Facilitate Scrum activities including refinement, sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews and retrospectives, applying Agile practices pragmatically rather than mechanically.
* Maintain delivery transparency through Jira, dashboards, milestone reporting, decisions, delivery confidence and measurable outcomes.
* Create a culture of ownership, experimentation, learning and continuous improvement in a setting where no established playbook may exist.

**Essential Experience And Capabilities**

* Proven ownership of complex technology, transformation, data or AI-enabled delivery, with clear evidence of personal contribution and business impact.
* Experience establishing a new squad, delivery model, product initiative or programme from an early or undefined starting point.
* Ability to operate confidently in ambiguity, structure complex problems and progress decisions with incomplete information.
* Strong delivery management across planning, governance, risk, dependencies, stakeholder communication and execution.
* Practical Scrum and Agile expertise, supported by delivery judgement rather than ceremony-only facilitation.
* Credibility with senior business and technology stakeholders, including the ability to challenge constructively and influence without formal authority.
* Working knowledge of AI, data, automation or emerging-technology delivery is strongly desirable; deep technical development expertise is not mandatory.
* Basic delivery-level understanding of the SAP Finance landscape is advantageous, including exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW and Finance processes such as Record to Report (R2R), together with awareness of other relevant SAP modules. This is desirable rather than mandatory; deep SAP functional or technical expertise is not required.

**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

**Senior HR Business Partner – Provation & Fluke Health Solutions**  
**Location:** Bangalore, India (hybrid)

**Role Summary**  
We are looking for a strategic, hands-on Senior HR Business Partner to support Provation and Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) in Bangalore. You’ll be a trusted advisor to site and business leaders. The role shapes talent, organization, and culture strategies that support business growth, while making sure HR runs well and stays compliant across the employee lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of India labor law and strong business acumen. You should be able to influence senior leaders in a matrixed, multi-entity global organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Partner with site and business leaders to understand their priorities and turn them into people strategies and action plans.
* Act as a thought partner on organization design, workforce planning, and change management.
* Use people data and insights to spot trends, risks, and opportunities, and bring clear recommendations to leaders.
* Represent the Bangalore site in global HR forums so local needs shape broader programs.

**Talent Strategy & Development**

* Lead talent reviews, succession planning, and calibration, building strong pipelines for critical roles.
* Find and develop high-potential talent, and partner with leaders on development plans, career paths, and retention.
* Drive annual performance and rewards processes, including goal setting, reviews, and merit planning, and coach managers through each cycle.
* Build manager and leader capability through coaching, targeted development, and consistent leadership expectations.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition on workforce planning, hiring strategy, and building a strong employer brand in the Bangalore market.

* Manage employee relations matters fairly and consistently, from investigation through resolution.
* Keep HR policies and practices compliant with India labor laws and aligned with Fortive and OpCo standards.
* Support policy changes and their rollout, keeping the employee impact in mind.

**Engagement, Culture & Onboarding**

* Pick up on colleague sentiment and team dynamics early, and partner with leaders on engagement and retention.
* Build a culture of belonging and connection to Provation, FHS, and Fortive values.
* Shape an onsite onboarding experience that complements global and OpCo programs and helps new hires get productive quickly.

* Make sure core HR processes run smoothly at the site level, in partnership with the HR COEs and shared services.
* Use Fortive Business System (FBS) tools to improve HR processes, the colleague experience, and outcomes.
