2c46492a.description:
Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.
  
  
Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.
  
  
Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.
  
  
This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.
  
  
**Job posting end date:**  
Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC
  
  
Introduction
  
  
We are looking for a Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC to join our Network Service Delivery team in Information Technology. In this role, you will ensure reliable, secure, cost-effective and business-aligned network services across the Asia-Pacific region. You will be the regional link between business stakeholders, Country IT teams, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, project teams and external service providers, and you will make sure regional needs – including offices, manufacturing plants and service locations – are well represented in our global network operating model.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram, India, and includes regional travel as required.
  
  
Team you will belong to
  
  
You will join our Network Service Delivery community, working closely with the Network Service Delivery Team Lead and regional service delivery managers to keep ways of working and service delivery practices consistent across regions. We collaborate with Country IT teams, global network service owners, Information Security, Procurement, Finance and external service providers. Our work spans APAC time zones and includes participation in agreed major-incident escalation and planned maintenance arrangements.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Oversee the delivery and performance of network services across APAC sites, including local and wireless networks, software-defined WAN (SD-WAN), internet connectivity and secure remote access, aligning resilience with global site criticality standards.
  
Manage service performance against agreed service-level and operational-level agreements, working with internal teams and service providers to maintain availability, capacity and readiness.
  
Act as the regional escalation point for critical network incidents, coordinating restoration, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and govern network changes and resilience testing.
  
Serve as the regional focal point for network demand, ensuring business and site requirements are documented, prioritized and progressed with Country IT, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, Operational Technology (OT) and project teams, in line with global standards and approved designs, including IT/OT network segmentation where applicable.
  
Represent APAC priorities in global network service, governance and roadmap discussions, and drive regional improvement opportunities.
  
Coordinate service provider relationships, monitor supplier performance and escalations, and partner with Procurement, Global Service Owners and Country IT Managers on service requirements, renewals, budgets, costs and cost optimization.
  
Coordinate network needs for new site setups, expansions, relocations, closures and integrations of acquired businesses, and communicate service performance, risks, outages and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
Ensure new or changed network services move into operations with accurate service records, monitoring and documentation, and drive improvements in monitoring, reporting, automation and operational analytics.
  
  
What you’ll bring
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Network Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
Typically 8–10 years of experience in enterprise network services, infrastructure operations or IT service management, including service delivery, vendor management or regional coordination across multiple countries.
  
Solid understanding of enterprise networking, including local and wireless networks, SD-WAN, internet connectivity, routing, VPNs, IT/OT network segmentation, high-availability architectures and network security fundamentals.
  
Demonstrated experience managing service-level agreements, major incidents, problem resolution, service transitions and supplier performance.
  
Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication and commercial skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  
ITIL Foundation certification or higher, or other relevant networking, infrastructure or IT service management certifications (nice to have).
  
Experience managing network services in a global, multi-vendor environment, ideally in manufacturing, industrial, mining or other operationally critical multi-site settings, and experience within APAC (nice to have).
  
Familiarity with enterprise SD-WAN, switching, wireless and network monitoring platforms such as Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN, HPE Aruba or SolarWinds, or equivalent (nice to have).
  
  
What’s in it for you
  
  
At Metso, you will combine meaningful work with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact in a supportive and inclusive environment. You’ll be part of a global team where collaboration, wellbeing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work.
  
  
**We support your growth and wellbeing by offering:**  
**Purpose-led work:** Contribute to enabling sustainable modern life and transforming the industry.
  
**Wellbeing:** Access to wellbeing programs, occupational healthcare, and supportive services.
  
**Rewards:** Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
  
**Growth:** Learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and global collaboration opportunities.
  
**Culture:** A caring, collaborative, and inclusive workplace committed to helping you thrive.
  
  
Get in touch
  
  
Want to rise above the possible with us? Click “Apply now” to submit your application.
  
  
We recognize that highly capable candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification. You may be exactly the right candidate for the role.
  
  
**Hiring Manager:** Shiji Nambiar
  
  
Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

* Coordinate data product, analytics and insights platform, data architecture, and engineering teams.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – APIGEE Platform Architect Position**
Over the last decade, API-led connectivity, cloud-native modernization and digital transformation have become critical for ensuring scalability, security and resilience across enterprise ecosystems. To support this evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Google Apigee, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and DevOps automation to deliver secure, high-performance and highly available API management platforms for mission-critical business applications.
  
  
As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Manager APIGEE Platform Architect supporting large-scale API management environments across hybrid and multi-cloud deployments.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Google Apigee, Kubernetes, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Automation, API Security and Enterprise Architecture to deliver secure, scalable and highly available solutions for mission-critical enterprise integrations and API ecosystems. This position provides opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders and support API modernization, cloud transformation and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee Apigee platform architecture and implementation.
* Act as the primary escalation point for Apigee and platform issues.
* Design and support end-to-end platform migrations and modernization programs.
* Drive infrastructure automation, governance and security standards.
* Collaborate with networking, cloud, security and DevOps teams.
* Define HA, DR, scalability and resiliency requirements.
* Establish observability, monitoring and operational readiness standards.

**Strong Understanding Of:**

* Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid architecture
* Kubernetes platforms (GKE, EKS, AKS, and On-Prem Kubernetes)
* Cloud platforms including GCP, AWS, and Azure
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
* API Security concepts including OAuth2, JWT, TLS, and mTLS
* CI/CD pipelines and APIOps implementation
* Monitoring and Observability using Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, and Splunk
* Disaster Recovery (DR), High Availability (HA), and Resiliency design
* Networking, Load Balancing, DNS, and Traffic Management
* Platform Governance, Security Controls, and Compliance Frameworks

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Effective stakeholder and client management skills
* Strong architecture and technical documentation expertise
* Presentation and solution demonstration skills
* Team-player mindset with collaborative working style
* Self-motivated and proactive attitude
* Ability to lead architecture reviews and design workshops
* Experience driving Proof of Concepts (POCs) and innovation initiatives
* Strong decision-making and technical leadership capabilities
* Ability to work across global and cross-functional teams

**To Qualify for the Role, you must have**

* 8 to 14 years of relevant experience in API Management, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or Enterprise Architecture
* Extensive hands-on experience with Google Apigee (Apigee X and/or Apigee Hybrid)
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes operations and platform architecture
* Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions on GCP, AWS, or Azure
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, IAM, and infrastructure services
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or equivalent tools
* Hands-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and APIOps practices
* Expertise in enterprise security controls, API security, and compliance requirements
* Experience leading architecture design sessions, workshops, and technical governance reviews
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale API platform implementations
* Ability to drive platform modernization, migration, and transformation initiatives
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, or Apigee certifications are preferred

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* IBM API Connect (APIC) and DataPower migration experience.
* Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD, Flux CD, Helm, and Kustomize.
* Experience with security scanning and vulnerability management tools.
* API Developer Portal, API Monetization, and API Analytics expertise.
* Experience defining SLA/SLO, KPI dashboards, and operating models.
* Relevant certifications such as:

+ Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
+ Google Apigee API Engineer Certification
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud-based solutions for the company.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

c44a4988.title: Data Platform Architect – Data & AI Practice - Remote - FS463
c44a4988.description:
Profile: Senior hands-on architect who can design solutions, explain architectural choices, build prototypes, and guide teams through implementation.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on Data Platform Architect to help establish and scale our Data & AI Practice. The role combines modern cloud data architecture, technical solutioning, client advisory, and engineering leadership to deliver enterprise data modernization and AI-ready platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Obsession: Work backwards from customer and end-user needs to design solutions that deliver measurable business value. Build trusted advisory relationships with customers, guiding technology decisions and long-term architecture strategy.
* Platform Architecture: Design scalable, cloud-native data platforms covering ingestion, integration, lakehouse/warehouse, processing, governance, analytics, and AI enablement.
* AI-Ready Architecture: Design data integration patterns supporting enterprise AI, including RAG, LLM integration, agentic workflows, and MCP-based connectivity.
* Hands-on Solutioning: Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, POCs/MVPs, and guide engineering teams through implementation.
* Modernization: Architect migration and integration of legacy enterprise data into modern cloud platforms, incorporating MDM, Data Quality, and Governance.
* Practice Development: Build reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and implementation patterns, and contribute to technology partnerships and client proposals.

**Required Expertise & Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience architecting and implementing enterprise data platforms on AWS, with a solid understanding of Azure and GCP architectures, comparative strengths, trade-offs, and evolving technology roadmaps.
* Deep expertise in Databricks and Snowflake, including lakehouse architecture, data engineering, pipelines, integration patterns, and native AI capabilities. Strong architectural familiarity with both platforms is expected.
* Working knowledge of GenAI architectures, including RAG, LLM integration, agentic AI, and MCP.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data management, including MDM, Data Quality, Governance, security, and production operations. Familiarity with leading platforms such as Reltio, Informatica, Collibra, and Alation, including their integration into enterprise data architectures.
* Ability to translate business requirements into architecture, develop working prototypes, and provide technical leadership during delivery.
* North American Customer Experience: Minimum 5 years of direct engagement with North American customers, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution advisory, and stakeholder management.
* Strong client-facing communication, solution architecture, and technical thought-leadership skills.

Preferred: Experience in enterprise modernization programs, AI-ready data platforms, and consulting or practice-building environments.
  
  
Apply Today: freschesolutions.com/careers/
  
  
Follow Us: LinkedIn

-----------------

The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

  

As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will design and implement machine learning solutions for customer use cases, leveraging core Google products including TensorFlow, DataFlow, and Vertex AI. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Lead comprehensive artificial intelligence initiatives through strategic thought leadership, while identifying agentic workflows and designing robust architectural solutions for advanced agentic implementations.
* Deliver effective big data and machine learning solutions and solve complex technical customer challenges.
* Identify new product features and feature gaps, provide guidance on existing product challenges, and collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to influence the roadmap of Google Cloud Platform.
* Provide expert guidance on architectural data strategies to ensure optimized utilization across different AI models. Deliver best practices recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, and technical presentations adapting to different levels of key business and technical stakeholders.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. 6701ad1e.title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
6701ad1e.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* 4+ years of project management experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
* Knowledge of mission critical systems (data centers, hospitals, power plants, military facilities, etc.)

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Johnson & Johnson is recruiting for a
**Technical Product Owner, GSINC Contracting Solution**
, based in India. We are searching for top talent to join the Global Simplification and Innovation in Contracting program, GSINC.
  
  
Do you seek big, complex, and ambiguous challenges? Are you passionate about transforming enterprise contracting through simplified processes, modern technology, intelligent data, and responsible AI? Do you want to help build a capability that improves how Johnson & Johnson works with its employees, suppliers, customers, healthcare professionals, and research partners?
  
  
GSINC is building an integrated, AI-enabled contracting capability designed to make contracting faster, simpler, more consistent, and more valuable to the enterprise! The program brings together process, policy, templates, technology, data, and intelligence to establish a scalable, modern contracting foundation across Johnson & Johnson.
  
  
The
**Technical Product Owner, GSINC Contracting Solution**
will be responsible for translating the product strategy into an executable technology roadmap and scalable delivery model. This role will be responsible for the product backlog, shape priorities, coordinate dependencies, and establish the Agile and release practices required to support
**multiple concurrent deployments and continuous product evolution across the enterprise**
.
  
  
This is not simply a backlog-management role. The Technical Product Owner will help define
**how GSINC technology is built, released, scaled, and continuously improved**
, working across business, product, engineering, architecture, implementation partners, and platform teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Ownership and Roadmap
  
  

* Own and continuously refine the product roadmap and backlog for the GSINC Contracting Solution, aligned to business priorities and enterprise strategy.
* Translate business capabilities, process requirements, and user needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical priorities.
* Drive prioritization based on value, user impact, technical dependencies, risk, scalability, and delivery capacity.
* Maintain a clear view of product health, technical debt, platform enhancements, integrations, defects, and innovation opportunities.

Agile Delivery and Product Management
  
  

* Lead Agile product practices across backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization, release planning, demos, retrospectives, and improvement.
* Balance near-term deployment requirements with the long-term integrity and scalability of the enterprise product.
* Use product metrics, user feedback, adoption data, and operational performance to continually refine priorities.

Concurrent Release and Deployment Model
  
  

* Design and operationalize an innovative delivery model that enables multiple GSINC deployments, enhancements, and product releases to progress concurrently.
* Establish release trains, development pathways, environment strategies, dependency management, testing approaches, and governance needed to move from sequential implementation toward continuous, parallel delivery.
* Define how enterprise product capabilities and business-specific deployments can advance simultaneously without creating unnecessary customization, fragmentation, or release conflicts.
* Create repeatable delivery patterns that allow GSINC to increase deployment velocity as adoption expands across business units, functions, and geographies.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks and continually improve the operating model to increase throughput, predictability, quality, and speed.
* Lead solution architects and engineering teams to ensure product decisions align with enterprise architecture, security, data, and technology standards.
* Champion reusable enterprise capabilities and configuration over unnecessary customization.

Performance and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define and monitor product and delivery measures including adoption, release velocity, cycle time, quality, defects, stability, user experience, and business value.
* Use data to identify bottlenecks, prioritize improvements, and increase delivery throughput.
* Provide concise leadership updates on roadmap progress, releases, risks, dependencies, product health, and outcomes.
* Continuously evolve the GSINC product and delivery model as the program scales globally.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in technical product ownership, product management, Agile delivery, enterprise technology, or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a Product Owner or Technical Product Owner for a complex enterprise platform or product.
* Strong experience with Agile product development, backlog management, release planning, dependency management, and cross-functional delivery.
* Experience designing or operating delivery models that support multiple parallel workstreams, release trains, or concurrent deployments.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical capabilities, epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working across engineering, architecture, business, testing, integration, data, and implementation teams.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms, workflow technology, integrations, APIs, data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Contract Lifecycle Management or enterprise contracting experience preferred.
* Experience with platforms such as Azure DevOps or Jira and modern Agile/product management practices preferred.
* Agile, Product Owner, Scrum, SAFe, or product management certification preferred.

Leadership Capabilities
  
  

* Product mindset: Owns outcomes and product health, not simply requirements, ceremonies, or delivery activity.
* Technical fluency: Connects business needs with architecture, engineering, data, integration, and platform capabilities.
* Enterprise thinking: Builds reusable capabilities that scale across businesses and geographies while managing legitimate local requirements.
* Delivery orchestration: Creates the structure, cadence, and discipline required for multiple teams and releases to move concurrently.
* Bias for action: Works through ambiguity, removes obstacles, and moves teams toward decisions and outcomes.
* Strong judgment: Understands when to standardize, when to sequence, when to escalate, and where technical debt or complexity could constrain scale.
* Influence: Builds alignment across business, technology, vendors, and leadership without relying on direct authority.
* Data-driven communication: Uses evidence to prioritize decisions and provides leadership with clear, decision-ready recommendations.
